title: Documentation Coordinator and IT Support
description:
Salary: $60,000 – $65,000 + superannuation

Documentation Coordinator and IT Support - Fixed-Term Parental Leave Cover

Position Purpose:

Provide Level 1 and Level 2 technical support while maintaining clear, accurate and controlled IT documentation. The role supports users, servers, business systems and IT infrastructure, and works with the IT team and relevant stakeholders to keep SOPs, runbooks, user guides and operational records current and fit for purpose.

Key Responsibilities:

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 support for user queries and incidents involving computers, software, Microsoft 365, printers, mobile devices and related technology.

• Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, account-access and business-system issues, resolving where possible and escalating complex matters to the appropriate team member or vendor.

• Install, configure and maintain end-user hardware and software, and assist with Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy and Microsoft 365 administration.

• Perform routine server and infrastructure checks, including system health, storage, services, event logs, backups, UPS equipment, network devices, CCTV and access-control systems.

• Assist with employee onboarding and offboarding, account creation and removal, permissions, equipment preparation and return of company assets.

• Maintain accurate IT asset, licence, inventory, incident and support records, and ensure completed support work is documented appropriately.

• Provide operational support for company business applications and regulated systems, including Pronto, MasterControl and electronic document-management systems, subject to training and access.

• Draft, review and update IT SOPs, work instructions, policies, forms, user guides, troubleshooting guides, technical runbooks and other operational documents.

• Coordinate the IT document lifecycle, including preparation, review, approval, version control, periodic review, distribution, archival and retirement.

• Work with IT subject-matter experts to convert technical processes into clear, accurate and practical English documentation.

• Identify outdated documents, process gaps and inconsistencies, and follow up document owners to keep IT procedures aligned with current operations.

• Assist with system testing, user acceptance testing, change-control documentation and collection of supporting evidence when required for system changes or validation activities.

• Support internal or external audits by locating IT records, preparing requested evidence and following up documentation actions.

• Follow company information-security, quality, safety and compliance requirements and contribute to continuous improvement of IT support and documentation processes.

• Perform other reasonable IT support and documentation duties as directed by the IT Manager.

Qualifications and Requirements:

• A Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline.

• Experience providing Level 1 or Level 2 IT support in a business environment.

• Hands-on knowledge of Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365, computer hardware, software and networking fundamentals.

• Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, user accounts, permissions and common infrastructure support tasks.

• Excellent professional written English, with the ability to prepare clear, structured and accurate SOPs, user guides and technical documentation.

• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with attention to detail and accurate record keeping.

• Ability to organise multiple support requests and documentation tasks, manage priorities and follow work through to completion.

• Clear verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively with users, IT team members, managers and vendors.

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively while handling confidential information appropriately.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience with Windows Server, VMware or Hyper-V, backup and disaster recovery, SharePoint and help desk or ticketing systems.

• Experience preparing or maintaining SOPs, runbooks, work instructions, controlled documents or knowledge-base content.

• Experience in a pharmaceutical, manufacturing or other regulated environment.

• Current Australian driver licence and ability to travel between company sites when required.

• Full Australian working rights with no current or future employer sponsorship requirement.

title: Sr Analyst-Business Intelligence
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing...


We are seeking an experienced Senior Analyst for Business Intelligence, Reporting & Analytics to transform raw data into actionable insights that drive strategic decisions within the Verizon Consumer Group. In this role, you will design enterprise dashboard solutions, model complex business data, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to elevate our analytics capabilities, specifically supporting our transition from legacy systems to modern cloud environments.


  • Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable dashboards and reports using Looker and Tableau.
  • Architect executive-level scorecards (e.g.,Team Scorecards) that tie active Jira tickets and operational metrics to core business priorities.
  • Writing complex SQL queries for BigQuery and optimizing data pipelines to ensure reporting efficiency.
  • Performing table access dependency audits and resolving environmental blockers between production and non-production datasets.
  • Mapping internal datasets (e.g., Retail C2C, Automerge cohort call activity) to unified reporting views.
  • Partnering with business leaders for Mobile and Fios to translate requirements into precise KPIs.
  • Delivering rapid-response data analysis for senior leadership, including call volume trends and credit intelligence.
  • Explore and deploy AI agents on the VZ AI Platform (Agent Builder/Fleet) to automate routine workflows and project timeline tracking.
  • Train end-users and stakeholders on Looker interfaces (explorers) and new data structures within the GCP environment.
  • Using SQL (BigQuery) for optimizing complex data pipelines and resolving environmental blockers between production and non-production datasets.
  • Using Looker (LookML) and Tableau, focusing on migrating mission-critical reporting from legacy systems to Google Cloud Platform.
  • Establishing and maintaining Jira governance for project tracking, including the organization of ad-hoc SQL documentation and internal vs. stakeholder-facing repositories.
  • Managing the full project lifecycle with high confidence, ensuring that all metrics are reported with absolute accuracy.
  • Aligning with Associate Directors and stakeholders through clear, intentional communication to eliminate ambiguity in project movement and delivery.
  • Actively participating in Performance Guide (PG) sessions to align technical output with organizational KPIs and executive scorecards.
  • Mentoring junior analysts on data storytelling, visualization standards, and Jira governance processes.

In this role, you'll have a defined work location that includes assigned office days by your leader.


What we’re looking for...


You have a gift for taking unstructured data, coordinating it, finding the valuable takeaways, and making it understood by others—in just the right way for that audience. Your attention to detail ensures you’ll get the job done accurately. You thrive in a fast-paced environment where new challenges come up every day but you are organized so no balls are dropped. You view problems as puzzles you’d like to tackle. You are comfortable working on your own but you also enjoy collaborating. You are a good listener and able to translate a business question into just the right analysis to find the answer.


In this role, you'll have a defined work location and assigned office days


You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience.
  • Three or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience.
  • Experience in SQL (window functions, CTEs) and major BI platforms, specifically Looker and BigQuery.
  • Experience with modern cloud warehouses like GCP/BigQuery; experience with Teradata migrations is a plus.
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive-ready presentation capabilities.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent experience.
  • Proficiency in the use of Teradata SQL and MS SQL servers (SSIS/SSAS/SSRS).
  • Familiarity with AI platforms (e.g., NotebookLM, VZ Agent Builder/Fleet) and Jira for project governance
  • Experience with statistical software like SAS or SPSS.
  • Programmed in R or Python.
  • Familiarity with data visualization software. Ideally, COGNOS or Tableau.
  • Managed projects and delivered results for multiple partners.
  • Exposure to Compliance and Risk Management.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits and Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $68,000.00 - $123,000.00.

The annual salary range for the Illinois location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full-time schedule is: $75,000.00 - $123,000.00.

Delivery Technician – Duncan, SC

Required

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • No experience required!
  • 21 years of age or older

Top Attributes for Success:

  • Willingness to learn
  • Dependability
  • Adaptability
  • Strong customer service and bedside manner
  • Mechanical aptitude
  • Comfort entering patient homes

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • You make a meaningful impact on patients' lives
  • Supportive small‑team environment
  • Transparent and hands‑on leadership
  • Predictable schedule with some flexibility
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Independent work with strong team support

Teammate Benefits

As an Accendra Health employee, you have choices to fit your life. Our comprehensive benefits program is designed to meet you where you are — through all of life’s stages. We’ve got you and your family covered with benefits that support your health, finances, and overall wellness.

title: Senior Engineer, Safety-Critical Software (R5788)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

Shield AI is seeking a Senior Engineer to help design, develop, and integrate a safety critical Run-Time Assurance (RTA) product. The Hivemind Foundations team is responsible for a suite of core products and capabilities that brings resilient autonomy and intelligence to aircraft and other platforms operating in complex environments. The RTA product that the Foundations team develops is a real-time safety capability that helps keep autonomy safe, predictable, and effective at the edge.

As a member of the Foundations team, you will be responsible for C++ software development, integration of reusable safety capabilities into production systems, defining clean interfaces and tests, and turn safety-critical designs into reliable software that can fly, including support for X-BAT, Shield AI's flagship Group 5 Collaborative Combat Aircraft (CCA) UAV.

What you'll do:

  • Develop, integrate, and test configurable Run-Time Assurance (RTA) components that monitor autonomy behavior and support safe operation across representative platforms and scenarios.
  • Adapt reusable C++ safety capabilities into production runtime components, including interface integration, configuration wiring, and unit, component, and integration tests.
  • Implement real-time C++ code at the boundary between mission autonomy, high-assurance middleware, and flight-control interfaces.
  • Integrate safety-critical software with aircraft hardware for hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and flight-test campaigns, scaling from single-aircraft test points to multi-agent collaborative CONOPS.
  • Strengthen engineering evidence through CI, static and dynamic analysis, focused code reviews, software documentation, software designs, ICDs, system models, test results, and traceability artifacts.
  • Share safe software practices through code reviews, design discussions, and clear technical write-ups.

Required qualifications:

  • Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 4 years with a Master’s degree; or 2 year with a PhD; or equivalent work experience.
  • Strong C++ development experience, including modern C++, testing, debugging, and performance-aware design.
  • Experience building software for real-time, embedded, robotics, autonomy, aerospace, or similarly constrained systems.
  • Experience integrating software with hardware, simulation, Hardware in the Loop (HIL), or production-like test environments and diagnosing reliability or performance issues.
  • Familiarity with C++ software design patterns and the ability to work effectively within an existing architecture.
  • Strong Git and Linux development skills, along with modern software development practices such as CI/CD and test-focused development.
  • Ability to write clear technical documentation and collaborate across software, systems, test, and platform teams.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with autonomy middleware, interface definitions, Python-based configuration tooling, CMake, Conan, or reusable C++ library integration.
  • Familiarity with high-reliability or safety-critical development practices, such as static analysis, coding standards, traceability, and requirements-based testing.
  • Experience developing against strict C++ coding standards such as MISRA C++ or JSF AV C++.
  • Hands-on experience with airworthiness or software assurance frameworks such as MIL-HDBK-516, DO-178C, or equivalent safety standards.
  • Experience taking a software component through verification, qualification, or certification evidence review.

title: Research Scientist, Liquid Process Development and Innovation - Bagsværd
description:
Interested in a career that matters?




Are you passionate about applying science to create innovative biosolutions that make a real impact? Join Novonesis' Formulation Development organization and help shape the next generation of enzyme and protein products that excite customers around the world.

As part of Formulation Development, you will work in a highly engaged, multicultural, and cross-functional agile team focused on developing enzyme and protein liquid products and their associated production processes. Working closely with colleagues across fermentation, recovery, formulation, production, marketing, application, and R&D, you will contribute to bringing new technologies and products from concept to commercialization while supporting and continuously improving our existing portfolio.


The Role & Your Impact

As a Research Scientist, you will play a key role in developing innovative liquid enzyme and protein formulations that deliver value to customers and support Novonesis' growth. This role combines scientific expertise, hands-on laboratory work, innovation, and project leadership, allowing you to contribute across the full development lifecycle from early-stage concept development to commercial scale-up.

You will apply your scientific curiosity to deepen our understanding of enzyme and protein formulations and translate that knowledge into practical solutions. Working closely with colleagues across multiple functions, you will drive projects forward, support production and customers, and help bring new technologies and products to market.


What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • Master's degree or PhD in Physical Chemistry, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, Biotechnology, or a related scientific discipline.
  • Strong passion for applying fundamental science to solve real-world challenges.
  • Ability to translate scientific insights into practical and commercially relevant solutions.
  • Experience planning, designing, and executing scientific experiments.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Motivation to take ownership, drive progress, and contribute to project leadership.
  • Ability to thrive in a cross-functional and international environment.
  • Appreciation for close collaboration with laboratory technicians and scientific colleagues.

Additional Skills & Interests We Value

Experience with protein stability studies or formulation development would be an advantage, as would an interest in product scale-up, manufacturing processes, customer support, or digital and data-driven development approaches. These experiences are not required but may help you create value more quickly in the role.

What We Offer

At Novonesis, you will join an ambitious and collaborative team of scientists who share a passion for innovation and product development. We offer the opportunity to work with cutting-edge enzyme and protein technologies while building a broad network across research, development, production, marketing, and application functions.

You will have the freedom to take ownership of your work, contribute to impactful projects, and grow both scientifically and professionally in an environment that values curiosity, teamwork, and continuous learning.


Ways of Working

This position is based in Bagsværd, Copenhagen, Denmark. We work in an office-first environment with flexibility to work from home when appropriate. The role also includes occasional collaboration from other Novonesis sites in the Copenhagen area and close interaction with colleagues across functions and geographies.


Relevant Information

Location: Bagsværd, Copenhagen, Denmark

Application deadline: 4 October 2026

Contact: Inge Sarup Kjærbølling – IGK@novonesis.com



Our purpose guides the way

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.

title: Equipment Engineer
description:
KEMET de México, with over a century of experience, is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of multilayer ceramic capacitors that power tomorrow’s technologies. We are recognized for our unwavering commitment to quality, reliability, and advanced solutions that meet the rigorous demands of a wide range of industries. We offer solutions based on advanced materials science and cutting-edge manufacturing, ensuring maximum performance and sustainability. As part of the YAGEO Group Company, KEMET leverages shared expertise and resources to drive innovation in the electronics industry.


As a Equipment Engineer you must be able to evaluate, inspect, maintain, design, analyze, and improve various types of equipment, including electronic and mechanical equipment, ensuring their optimal performance. This is a full-time, on-site position located at our offices in Guadalupe, NL.


Requirements

  • Bachelors’ degree in Sofware, Electronic, Mechatronic, Electrical, Computer, Automation & Control or Industrial Engineer, or related field.
  • 3+ years' experience in Industrial Maintenance, Instrumentation or Manufacturing Robots and Staff Managing.


Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, maintain and troubleshoot manufacturing equipment and automated systems.
  • Develop, test, and implement software solutions for equipment control and process automation.
  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on production machinery.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize equipment performance and reduce downtime.
  • Analyze equipment data to identify improvement opportunities and implement corrective actions.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including SOPs, work instructions, and equipment specifications.


Qualifications and Skills

  • Advanced English level.
  • PLC Programming: Ladder Logic, Structures Text (ST), Function Block Diagram (FBD).
  • HMI/SCADA Development: WinCC, FactoryTalk, Ignition.
  • Industrial Communication Protocols: OPC-UA, Modbus, Profinet, EtherNet/IP.
  • Programming Languages: Python, C/C++, C#, Java, SQL.
  • Scripting: VBA, PowerShell, Bash.
  • Database Management: SQL Server, MySQL, Oracle.
  • Data Analysis Tools: MATLAB, LabVIEW.
  • Version Control: Git, SVN.
  • CAD/CAE Software: AutoCAD, SolidWorks (basic knowledge).
  • Microsoft Office Suite & Excel VBA for reporting and automation.


We Offer

  • Collaboration in an international environment with strong recognition of people and talent.
  • A pleasant and people-centered work environment, with a highly motivated team where you can showcase your skills and dedication.
  • Training and continuous learning opportunities.
  • A comprehensive benefits package above legal requirements.

They move faster, last longer, go farther—with a spark of us inside.

Headquartered in Taiwan, YAGEO Group brings together multiple trusted brands, including YAGEO, KEMET, PULSE, and Telemecanique Sensors, among others, into a cohesive force for innovation. Over 40,000 employees. Over 100 locations. 20 R&D centers. Over 2,000 patents. More than 273,000 customers.

title: Sr. Manufacturing Specialist
description:
Make your mark at the world's largest HVAC company!

Why You’ll Love Working for Daikin:

  • We’re a group who operates with a people-centered mindset, believing in the unlimited potential of each employee, with a goal of driving our company to its fullest potential.

  • Our goal is to “Perfect the Air”. We do this through cutting edge innovation & sustainability efforts while meeting the HVAC needs of thousands of customers - expanding over 160 countries!

  • Our culture is unrivaled. Daikin operates under 8 Core Values which are embedded into every aspect of our business. It’s through these values that we continuously strive to build a place where everyone can be authentic, feel valued and heard, and have a sense of purpose and belonging.

Especialista de Manufactura Sr. / Factory Master Plan

Objetivo del puesto

Desarrollar, documentar y mejorar procesos productivos y proyectos de manufactura, asegurando su correcta implementación en términos de Seguridad, Calidad, Entrega y Costo.

La posición será responsable de coordinar proyectos de manufactura, administrar presupuestos de capital, desarrollar rutas y métodos de fabricación, impulsar iniciativas de mejora continua y brindar soporte técnico a las áreas productivas.

Esta posición también puede desempeñar funciones como Especialista de Factory Master Plan (FMP), participando en el desarrollo de estrategias de largo plazo para la fábrica mediante el análisis de capacidad, demanda, tecnología, infraestructura y oportunidades de inversión.

Principales responsabilidades

  • Desarrollar, documentar y mejorar procesos productivos y métodos de fabricación.
  • Crear y mantener rutas de procesos productivos en Oracle, incluyendo tiempos, operaciones y locaciones de entrega.
  • Analizar tiempos y movimientos, balanceo de líneas, cargas de trabajo, capacidad de procesos y Takt Time.
  • Desarrollar Value Stream Mapping (VSM), identificar desperdicios (MUDAS) y establecer iniciativas para reducir tiempos de ciclo y Lead Time.
  • Diseñar e implementar mejoras de procesos enfocadas en Seguridad, Calidad, Entrega y Costo.
  • Coordinar eventos Kaizen utilizando metodologías Lean Manufacturing y PDS.
  • Desarrollar e implementar Poka-Yokes para prevenir defectos y reducir scrap.
  • Realizar análisis de riesgos de las operaciones y desarrollar contramedidas para mejorar las condiciones de seguridad y ergonomía.
  • Participar en proyectos de introducción de nuevos productos (NPI), asegurando el cumplimiento de las etapas necesarias para su liberación.
  • Participar en proyectos de transferencia de equipos y procesos, asegurando el cumplimiento de fechas, presupuesto y condiciones requeridas para el arranque de producción.
  • Definir equipos, herramientas, Fixtures, Jigs, PKYK y demás recursos necesarios para los procesos de fabricación.
  • Brindar soporte técnico a Producción y capacitar al personal operativo en métodos y estándares de fabricación.
  • Participar en la evaluación de factibilidad de productos especiales (FPA) y validar los requerimientos de manufactura.
  • Analizar y actualizar tiempos y rutas de fabricación en Oracle para asegurar la correcta cotización y costeo de productos.
  • Participar en proyectos de mejora continua y documentar los ahorros obtenidos.
  • Desarrollar y administrar presupuestos de capital (CapEx) para proyectos de manufactura.
  • Elaborar análisis financieros, estimaciones de ahorro y retorno de inversión (ROI) para proyectos de capital.
  • Desarrollar RFQs para adquisición de nuevos equipos y coordinar su implementación y liberación.
  • Planear y supervisar proyectos de manufactura, incluyendo alcance, objetivos, tiempos, recursos, riesgos y presupuesto.
  • Utilizar herramientas de gestión de proyectos como Diagramas de Gantt, análisis financiero, checklists de implementación, análisis de riesgos y control de cambios.

Factory Master Plan (FMP)

Como parte de las responsabilidades de Factory Master Plan, la posición podrá:

  • Evaluar y desarrollar modelos de capacidad para procesos productivos y áreas de soporte de la fábrica.
  • Analizar pronósticos de producción, nuevos productos (NPI) y factores externos para asegurar la continuidad y capacidad futura del negocio.
  • Desarrollar estrategias de implementación de nuevas tecnologías y optimización de recursos.
  • Realizar benchmarks, workshops y análisis de oportunidades de innovación y tecnología.
  • Identificar y recomendar proyectos de inversión que contribuyan al crecimiento y sustentabilidad de la fábrica.
  • Desarrollar un portafolio de oportunidades de inversión de capital a corto, mediano y largo plazo.
  • Administrar y dar seguimiento al presupuesto anual de CapEx, asegurando su correcta ejecución.
  • Evaluar necesidades futuras de capacidad y desarrollar planes de acción para atenderlas.
  • Participar en el ciclo anual de Factory Master Plan y dar seguimiento a proyectos de alta visibilidad para la gerencia de planta.
  • Analizar indicadores clave de la planta para anticipar riesgos de capacidad y oportunidades de mejora.
  • Desarrollar una visión de manufactura a futuro, considerando las capacidades y tecnologías necesarias para los siguientes años.

Indicadores de desempeño

  • Desarrollo, implementación y liberación de proyectos.
  • Cumplimiento del presupuesto y plan de adquisiciones de CapEx.
  • Transferencia de equipos y procesos en tiempo y forma.
  • Cumplimiento de objetivos de capacidad y eficiencia.
  • Desarrollo de planes de incremento de capacidad vs. demanda.
  • Cumplimiento de metas de ahorro mediante proyectos de mejora continua.
  • Implementación y mantenimiento de estándares Lean Manufacturing y 5S.
  • Ejecución del ciclo anual de Factory Master Plan.
  • Ejecución del presupuesto de CapEx.
  • Evaluación de capacidad de la fábrica.
  • Madurez de los procesos de FMP y CapEx.

Principales retos y toma de decisiones

  • Definición y priorización de proyectos de CapEx.
  • Planeación y presentación de proyectos de inversión.
  • Evaluación de factibilidad y retorno de inversión.
  • Recomendación de tecnologías y equipos para la fábrica.
  • Desarrollo de estrategias para incrementar capacidad de acuerdo con la demanda.
  • Identificación de oportunidades de mejora y optimización de procesos.
  • Coordinación de proyectos multidisciplinarios con diferentes áreas de la organización.

Perfil del puesto

Experiencia

  • 3 a 8 años de experiencia como Ingeniero de Manufactura o en posiciones relacionadas.
  • Experiencia en procesos de manufactura, mejora continua y administración de proyectos.
  • Experiencia en análisis de tiempos y movimientos, balanceo de líneas y diseño de layouts.
  • Experiencia en implementación de proyectos de mejora continua y Kaizen.
  • Experiencia en administración de presupuestos y proyectos de capital.
  • Deseable experiencia en Factory Master Plan, CapEx o planeación de capacidad.

Conocimientos técnicos

  • Lean Manufacturing y mejora continua.
  • Análisis de tiempos y movimientos.
  • Balanceo de líneas y cargas de trabajo.
  • Diseño y modificación de layouts.
  • Documentación y estandarización de procesos.
  • Análisis de capacidad y demanda.
  • Administración de proyectos.
  • Desarrollo y administración de presupuestos de capital.
  • Análisis financiero y retorno de inversión.
  • Procesos de NPI y transferencia de equipos.
  • Kaizen y metodología PDS.
  • Diseño de Poka-Yokes.
  • Conocimiento de procesos de ensamble.
  • Manejo de Oracle.
  • AutoCAD.
  • SolidWorks.
  • Deseable conocimiento básico en sistemas de refrigeración.

Idioma

  • Inglés avanzado.

Escolaridad

  • Ingeniería Industrial, Mecánica, Electrónica, Química, Bioquímica o carrera afín.
  • Título profesional requerido.
  • Deseable posgrado o maestría en Administración, Tecnologías de Manufactura o áreas relacionadas.

Daikin is the world's industry leader in air conditioning with sales over 27 billion dollars, comprised of over 300 companies around the globe. Its cutting edge air conditioning products and services using environment friendly technologies are widely distributed and marketed in more than 170 countries, from residential A/C to commercial A/C market. As its global headquareter, Daikin Industries, Ltd. is continually leading air conditioning history with its business strategies & technological breakthrough in the area of environment friendly air comfort solutions. In challenging the needs of the future with new innovations using AI/IoT technologies, Daikin will continue its commitment to growth of the business and contribution to the society.

title: Senior Operations Lead, Fraud
description:
Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting-edge technology, we’re enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?

We're looking for a Senior Operations Lead, Fraud to lead a team of Fraud Associates protecting cardholders and Mission Lane from fraudulent activity, reporting to the Principal Operations Lead.

Somewhere right now, one of our cardholders is checking their account after an unfamiliar charge shows up, waiting to find out whether their next few weeks get harder or stay on track. The moment your team catches that charge and clears it fast is the moment their progress keeps moving instead of stalling out. As Senior Operations Lead, Fraud, you'll build the team and the coaching rhythms that make that moment happen reliably, for thousands of cardholders at once.

Fraud tactics shift constantly, and the challenge isn't just catching bad activity, it's holding the line between stopping fraud and letting legitimate cardholders through without friction, while your team's accuracy and turnaround times hold steady under that pressure. You'll spend real time in the data behind those numbers, coaching specific behaviors that move them.

Fraud Operations at Mission Lane is still building its playbook as the team scales. You'll have real room to shape how coaching, escalation, and process improvement work here, not just execute a process someone else has already finalized.

As Senior Operations Lead, Fraud you will:

  • Lead a team of 13 to 15 Fraud Associates, including 1:1 coaching, performance reviews, and career development conversations
  • Coach the team against key operational targets, using performance data to identify trends and close gaps in efficiency and accuracy
  • Serve as the team's escalation point for complex, high-risk fraud cases and difficult customer situations, applying fraud policy and looping in Fraud leadership on the highest-risk or most novel scenarios
  • Build an inclusive team culture of trust, accountability, and open communication, recognizing individual and team wins
  • Manage day-to-day team logistics: schedule adherence, time-off coverage, project assignments, and staffing through peak periods
  • Translate company strategy and policy updates into clear, actionable direction for your team

You'll thrive in this role if:

  • You've led a customer operations, risk, or fraud team before and genuinely enjoy the coaching side of management, not just the metrics side
  • You can read a performance dashboard and turn it into a specific coaching conversation, not just a status update
  • You communicate directly and empathetically, even when the conversation is a hard one
  • You're comfortable making a call on a high-risk case with incomplete information, and know when to escalate instead of guessing
  • You want to help build a fraud operations practice that's still taking shape, not just run one that's already finished

Minimum qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience leading customer operations, risk, or fraud teams, with a track record of hiring, coaching, and developing direct reports
  • Working knowledge of fraud, risk operations, or credit card operations
  • Comfort interpreting performance dashboards and operational data to drive coaching and performance management
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to travel 4-6 times per year for onsite meetings and strategy sessions in Richmond, VA, or other designated U.S. locations

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in fintech, banking, or another highly regulated customer operations environment
  • A track record of guiding teams through periods of rapid growth or process change

Compensation:

Annual full-time starting base salary range: $55,000 - $70,000

This role is eligible for additional compensation in the forms of participation in our annual incentive and equity programs.

Pay is based on factors such as work experience, education, certification(s), training, skills, and competencies related to the role. Mission Lane also offers a comprehensive benefits plan, which includes paid time off, 401(k) match, a monthly wellness stipend, health/dental/vision insurance options, disability coverage, paid parental leave, flexible spending account (for childcare and healthcare), life insurance, and a remote-first work environment.

About Mission Lane:

Founded in December 2018, Mission Lane is a purpose-driven fintech company based in the U.S., with headquarters in Richmond, Virginia.

It all started with a realization: nearly fifty percent of the adult population in the U.S. doesn’t have access to a clear line of credit. Most traditional credit card companies either overlook or overcharge this group because they have less-than-perfect credit scores or no scores at all. We decided this just wouldn’t do.

title: Engineer, RAS
description:
The Alberta Electric System Operator (AESO) is responsible for the safe, reliable, and economic planning and operation of the Alberta Interconnected Electric System. We provide open and non-discriminatory access to Alberta’s interconnected power grid and also facilitate Alberta’s competitive wholesale electricity market. The AESO strives to foster an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace where people feel respected and welcomed for who they are, together we deliver high performance and innovative results.

Job Description

If you are a current AESO employee, please view openings and apply through our internal site at Workday.


Reporting to the Manager, Operations Planning, the Engineer, Remedial Action Scheme (RAS) supports the design, modification, commissioning, operational integration, and ongoing effectiveness of RAS across Alberta. You will work with Operational Planners, Connection Planners, and other technical teams to help ensure RAS are appropriately designed, modelled, documented, and incorporated into AESO planning and operating practices.


You will collaborate across the AESO, including System Planning, System Operations, Project Management, Project Engineering, Regulatory, Legal, and Tariff, and interface with facility owners, generation developers, transmission-connected customers, and consultants. You will provide technical guidance on routine RAS matters and work with the Engineer Specialist, RAS on complex or higher-risk issues.


Signs you will enjoy the position

  • You enjoy applying power-system knowledge to the design, modification, commissioning, and operation of remedial action schemes.
  • You are energized by translating system needs and operational requirements into practical technical solutions.
  • You like working with technical models, operating documentation, records, and databases to support reliable outcomes.
  • You enjoy monitoring the performance of existing schemes and recommending improvements as system conditions evolve.
  • You are comfortable providing technical guidance and escalating complex, novel, or higher-risk matters when appropriate.
  • You value work that combines technical analysis, collaboration, sound judgment, and clear communication.

Signs you will enjoy working in this team

  • You enjoy partnering with Operational Planners, Connection Planners, project teams, and real-time operations.
  • You value working with diverse internal and external stakeholders to resolve technical and operational matters.
  • You enjoy contributing throughout the full RAS lifecycle, from development and commissioning through modification and retirement.
  • You are comfortable sharing knowledge and delivering technical training to operators, engineers, and other technical staff.
  • You can collaborate effectively across long-term planning and real-time operations while keeping work moving toward reliable outcomes.


Your main accountabilities

  • Collaborate with Operational Planners, Connection Planners, and other technical teams to develop and modify RAS that address identified system needs and operational requirements.
  • Provide technical guidance to internal teams and external stakeholders on the design, application, and operation of RAS, including anti-islanding schemes.
  • Coordinate the commissioning, testing, documentation, and operational integration of new and modified RAS to support safe and reliable in-service operation.
  • Work with Transmission Facility Owners, Generation Facility Owners, and Distribution Facility Owners to resolve technical and operational matters related to RAS design, implementation, and performance.
  • Support project, system planning, operations planning, project engineering, and real-time operations teams throughout the RAS lifecycle.
  • Maintain accurate RAS records, databases, technical documentation, and related processes to support planning, operations, compliance, and change management.
  • Develop and provide technical input to System Controller procedures and other operational documentation affected by new or modified RAS.
  • Support the accurate representation and validation of RAS in the Energy Management System and offline power-system simulation models.
  • Monitor and assess the effectiveness of existing RAS and recommend improvements to address performance issues, changing system conditions, or emerging reliability risks.
  • Develop and deliver technical training for real-time operators, engineers, and other technical staff involved in the planning or operation of RAS.
  • Escalate complex, novel, or higher-risk RAS matters to the RAS Specialist Engineer and contribute technical analysis to support resolution.

What you need – Education and Experience

  • A bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering from an accredited college or university.
  • Professional Engineer designation (P. Eng.) with APEGA.
  • 5 years of electric power industry experience, with experience in operations planning, power-system models and analysis, protection and control, customer connections, transmission planning, or engineering economics.
  • Working knowledge of the purpose of RAS in planning and its use in operations.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work with diverse team members, from long-term planning to real-time operations.
  • Proven ability to solve problems collaboratively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of Alberta Reliability Standards, ISO rules, and the Alberta electricity industry framework.
  • Proven ability to solve highly complex engineering problems with a defined objective and minimally defined scope in a high-conflict environment.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and technical staff.

Why work with us

This full-time opportunity offers a competitive salary, along with paid vacation and flex time, health and dental benefits, mental health support, a defined contribution pension plan, and learning and development opportunities as part of the overall compensation package.


We support a hybrid work environment. The team is in the office on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, with flexibility to work where you are most effective on Mondays and Fridays.


Application deadline: October 12, 2026

If you are contacted for a pre-screening and/or interview, please advise of any accommodation measures required to enable you to fully participate. Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

The Alberta Electric System Operator, and its members, officers, employees and agents (collectively, the "AESO") is committed to protecting personal information provided to it. When you submit your personal information to the AESO for the purpose of pursuing employment with the AESO, the collection, use and disclosure of personal information is in accordance with the provisions of the Protection of Privacy Act (POPA) of Alberta.

As noted, the AESO is mandated to maintain the safe and reliable operations of the provincial power grid. As part of meeting its obligations, the AESO may require the successful candidate to undergo a criminal background check for the position. This collection of personal information for the purposes of a check will be conducted in accordance with Section 4 of POPA.

40

title: Staff Engineer, State Estimation (R5783)
description:

title: Vendor Management Administrator
description:
Job Description:

Position Summary:

The Vendor Management Administrator supports the credit union’s vendor management program by coordinating third-party due diligence activities, maintaining vendor records in the GRC system, supporting contract administration workflows, and monitoring routine vendor performance activities. This role ensures vendor documentation is complete, current, and audit-ready, while providing responsive, detail-oriented support to internal stakeholders and vendors in a highly regulated environment.

Primary Responsibilities & Duties:

  • Coordinate vendor onboarding by collecting and reviewing vendor information for accuracy, gathering required documentation, and routing requests for review/approval in accordance with the organization’s vendor management program.
  • Perform and track routine due diligence activities (initial and ongoing), including collecting required documents and reports, business continuity documentation, and other required artifacts; follow up with vendors and internal owners as needed.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date vendor records in the GRC system (primarily the NVendor module), including risk tiering fields, due diligence status, document storage, review dates, and workflow notes to support reporting, audits and regulatory exams.
  • Support contract administration by tracking contract start and end dates, renewal and termination notice periods, and key contractual obligations; assist with document routing for legal and business approvals.
  • Prepare routine reports and dashboards (e.g., upcoming due diligence, expired documents, contract renewals, high-risk vendor lists) and assist with leadership, audit, and examination requests.
  • Draft and maintain standardized templates, checklists, and guidance for business units to improve consistency and efficiency of vendor management processes.
  • Provide general administrative support for the vendor management program, including meeting coordination, communications, and responding to internal inquiries.
  • Assume additional responsibilities as necessary for the continued growth and advancement of the credit union.

Knowledge/ Skills:

  • Working knowledge of vendor management and third-party risk concepts, including due diligence, contract tracking, and ongoing monitoring activities in a regulated environment.
  • Strong organizational skills with demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines, track follow-ups, and maintain accurate records.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to identify missing, expired, or inconsistent documentation and escalate issues appropriately.
  • Proficiency with business systems and reporting tools with the ability to learn and effectively use the organization’s GRC system.
  • Professional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to work directly with vendors and internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to handle sensitive/confidential information with discretion and sound judgment.
  • Ability to synthesize vendor due diligence information, identify trends or recurring exceptions, and recommend process improvements to leadership.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, risk management, or a related field preferred.
  • 3+ years’ experience in vendor management, contract administration, risk/compliance, procurement, or related administrative support
  • Financial services experience preferred.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, Outlook) and comfort working in workflow and document management systems; GRC system experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accurate documentation in an audit-ready manner.
  • Ability to work independently with limited guidance, exercising judgment to prioritize workload, identify gaps/risks in vendor documentation, and escalate issues appropriately.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Meet the Team

The Solutions Engineer (SE) is a customer-focused technical sales professional responsible for providing technical expertise, solution design, and implementation guidance to customers in a dedicated and/or pooled capacity. Holding direct technical accountability for specific opportunities, the SE leverages deep knowledge across Cisco's broad portfolio—including hardware, software, and services—alongside his/her technical specialization to deliver business outcomes.

Taking an architectural perspective, the SE demonstrates how Cisco products and solutions address customers' business challenges. Working closely with Account Managers and engaging additional resources (e.g., consulting specialists, demo labs), the SE recommends, develops, and proposes tailored customer solutions. The SE cultivates long-term relationships with customer technical stakeholders, identifies opportunities aligned to customer business goals, and proactively shares knowledge and best practices across Cisco and the SE Community.

Reports To: Solutions Engineering Leader

Your Impact

Identify Opportunities

· Contribute to the development of the Technical Account Plan by applying a deep understanding of customer business requirements.

· Provide input on local market demand to support the broader Account Plan.

· Proactively generate leads through customer meetings, seminars, and educational engagements.

Qualify Opportunities

· Translate customer business challenges into clearly defined technical contexts.

· Recommend qualified partner resources when appropriate.

· Advance deals through the sales process by strategically engaging the right Cisco and partner tools and resources (e.g., CSE, PSS, AS, CX Engineers, demo labs).

· Refine and research technical requirements for each opportunity.

· Define solution options and articulate the value and benefits of Cisco solutions.

· Analyze competitive offerings to effectively position Cisco solutions.

Develop and Present Solutions

· Interpret the technical components of RFPs and determine the optimal approach to proposal development, covering products, solutions, software, and services.

· Engage external resources as needed for RFPs, competitive analysis, and specialized content.

· Research and demonstrate business benefits of proposed solutions, including ROI.

· Coordinate solution development by leveraging Cisco Validated Designs (CVDs) and researching customized alternatives.

· Identify and engage appropriate post-sales support resources.

· Develop Proof-of-Concept (PoC) engagements using demo labs, including presentation and documentation of test results.

· Develop or oversee the creation of presentation materials.

· Present technical components of Cisco solutions to customers, engaging additional resources (e.g., CSE, TSA) as required.

· Serve as a technical advisor to the customer and account team within your area of expertise.

· Utilize appropriate internal processes for key feature requests and product requirements.

Post-Sales Transition and Customer Success

· Coordinate with post-sales teams, providing comprehensive documentation for a smooth handoff.

· Minimize post-sales engagement by escalating outstanding requests to the appropriate teams (Partner, TAC, GFEP).

· Ensure customer technical needs are fully met, addressing any gaps proactively.

· Document solutions where appropriate and share findings with relevant Business Units (BUs) and the SE Community.

· Request feedback on opportunity performance to support continuous improvement.

Personal and Organizational Development

· Focus on the continuous development of technical, professional, and sales skills.

· Engage mentors actively to support and execute on personal development plans.

· Promote innovative approaches to address evolving business challenges.

· Contribute to knowledge sharing and best practices within the SE Community.

Minimum Qualifications

· 5 to 8 years of experience in markets where Cisco competes.

· Minimum 5 years of field technical sales experience as a Solutions Engineer, Architect, or equivalent role.

· Strong operating experience and proven expertise in at least one of the following specialization areas:

· Enterprise Networking

· Data Center Networking and/or Compute

· Wireless LAN

· Security

· Service Provider Routing

· Software-Defined Solutions (SD-WAN, SDA, ACI)

· Network and Cloud Management Platforms

· Artificial Intelligence (AI) and/or Agentic Operations

· Mandarin speaking is needed

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Lead Software engineer K&I (Java/ IAM)
description:
Salary: €55.000 - 80.000 per year

Requirements:

  • Wil jij bijdragen aan veilige en betrouwbare toegang tot de digitale bibliotheekdiensten van miljoenen Nederlanders? Bij de KB, de nationale bibliotheek van Nederland, zoeken we een lead software engineer die richting geeft aan de technische vernieuwing van ons domein Klant & Identiteit.
  • Wat ga je doen
  • Als Lead Software Engineer werk je voornamelijk met Java/Spring Boot en geef je technische richting aan het Identity & Access-domein van de KB. Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt softwaretoepassingen die veiligheid, betrouwbaarheid en schaalbaarheid waarborgen. Daarbij geef je richting aan technische keuzes binnen het team, begeleid je de migratie naar Azure en help je bij het inrichten en verbeteren van CI/CD-pipelines. Je werkt aan de overgang van een custom cloudomgeving naar een moderne architectuur en denkt mee over structurele oplossingen voor technische uitdagingen.
  • Je werkt in het team Klant & Identiteit (K&I), dat verantwoordelijk is voor de software achter gebruikersauthenticatie, registratie en het nieuwe landelijke inlogsysteem voor bibliotheken. Dit systeem wordt binnen de bibliotheeksector ontwikkeld om gebruikers met één account toegang te geven tot verschillende digitale bibliotheekdiensten.
  • Maak jij het mogelijk?
  • Je bent een ervaren software engineer die graag verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor kwaliteit en technische richting. Je kunt schakelen tussen detail en overzicht en voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar ontwikkeling en beheer hand in hand gaan.
  • Wat je meebrengt:
  • • Hbo- of wo-werk- en -denkniveau.
  • • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als software engineer, waarvan:
  • ten minste 3 jaar aantoonbare ervaring met Java;
  • minimaal 2 jaar ervaring met Spring Boot in een productieomgeving;
  • ervaring met het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van PHP applicaties;
  • ervaring met het ontwikkelen, beheren of migreren van applicaties in Azure.
  • • Bekendheid met CI/CD en ervaring met het inrichten of verbeteren van pipelines.
  • • Ervaring met het implementeren van IAM-oplossingen.
  • • Ervaring met autorisatie en authenticatie management (zoals Auth0).
  • • Ervaring met Agile/Scrum-werken.
  • • Goede beheersing van het Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
  • • In staat om technische richting te geven binnen het team.

Responsibilities:

  • Waar kan jij op rekenen?
  • Kies je voor de KB, dan kies je voor inhoud en ontwikkelruimte. Je kunt rekenen op:
  • • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €4.885,- en € 6.722,- (schaal 11).
  • • Om te beginnen een contract van één jaar, met de intentie om dit bij goed functioneren om te zetten naar een vast dienstverband.
  • • 42 vrije dagen bij een fulltime dienstverband.
  • • 100% vergoeding van jouw OV-reiskosten.
  • • Pensioenopbouw via ABP, waarbij de KB 70% van de premie betaalt.
  • • Een dertiende maand (8,33%).
  • Deze arbeidsvoorwaarden gelden voor een fulltime dienstverband van 40 uur per week. Voor deze vacature is een dienstverband van 32-40 uur per week aan de orde. Lees meer over onze uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden op de website.
  • Hoe solliciteer ik naar deze vacature?
  • Wil jij bijdragen aan onze digitale toekomst? Mooi! We kijken uit naar jouw cv en motivatie via het sollicitatieformulier op de website. Vragen over de functie? Stel deze aan Nena Lukic via nena.lukic@kb.nl.
  • Zien we voldoende raakvlakken, dan bellen we je voor een kennismaking. Bij onvoldoende raakvlakken laten we dit weten via e-mail.
  • Tijdens de selectieprocedure bewaren we je gegevens. Uiterlijk 4 weken na het beëindigen van de sollicitatieprocedure verwijderen we deze op grond van de Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming (AVG). Lees meer hierover in onze privacyverklaring sollicitanten op de website.

Technologies:

  • Architect
  • Azure
  • CI/CD
  • IAM
  • Java
  • PHP
  • Product Owner
  • Spring
  • Spring Boot
  • Cloud

More:

Over de KB en het team
De KB, de nationale bibliotheek van Nederland, zorgt dat alles wat in en over Nederland wordt geschreven, gepubliceerd of online gedeeld bewaard blijft en toegankelijk blijft voor de toekomst.

Het team Klant & Identiteit maakt deel uit van het domein Publieksdiensten en bestaat uit vier ontwikkelaars, een product owner, een scrum master en een solution architect die ook voor andere teams werkt. Het is een betrokken team dat korte lijnen heeft en veel waarde hecht aan samenwerking en kennisdeling.

De komende jaren staan in het teken van groei en modernisering: het aantal gebruikers groeit van vier naar acht miljoen en de omgeving wordt omgezet naar een schaalbare Azure-architectuur. In deze functie draag je bij aan de technische vernieuwing en het verder ontwikkelen van een betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige digitale toegang voor bibliotheekgebruikers.

Special skills required

  • Microsoft office literacy

Personal attributes

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Caring, honest and responsible worker.
  • Willingness to work on scheduled hours, shift, and weekends, public holidays, on-call and anytime when called during emergency.

  • High integrity, patience, and attention to detail.

title: Regional Vice-President, Imperial Service, Ontario Region
description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit

The Regional Vice-President (VP), Imperial Service, Ontario Region is accountable for leading implementation of initiatives for CIBC’s Imperial Service business, which focuses on our mass affluent clients to drive outstanding results in the areas of net sales growth, revenue and client satisfaction. As a member of Personal and Business Banking, Canada is accountable for determining the strategic direction, providing leadership and business management of the Imperial Service markets within their span of control and within the overall Region. The role is focused on all aspects of Imperial Service including the implementation of forward thinking business and sales strategies, productivity, profitability initiatives and enhancement of the client experience. The Regional VP is jointly responsible with the Regional President for regional business, risk management, profitability, cost and expense management.


As an organizational leader, this role champions:

  • Always professional… so our team members can excel and be their best professional self.
  • Radically simple… so our team members can focus on what they need to do and make an impact.
  • Genuinely caring… so our team members can feel valued for who they are and what they contribute.

CIBC leadership capabilities:

  • Inspires hearts and minds…to build an inclusive culture where we make bold choices, collaborate, and empower others to take chances and do what’s right for our stakeholders.
  • Drives action and impact, together…to align with urgency around what matters, making decisions with speed and always making a real difference.

What You’ll be Doing

  • Shape the Imperial Service Strategy. Partner with the Region Head, Imperial Service and senior Imperial Service leaders to define, evolve, and execute the long-term Imperial Service vision, operating model, and differentiated client value proposition.
  • Drive Business Performance. Provide strategic oversight of a complex, high-profile markets — delivering sustainable business results, exceptional client experiences, and a strong risk and compliance culture.
  • Inspire High-Performance Leadership. Cultivate a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and inclusive leadership — investing in coaching, candid feedback, and leadership development to build the next generation of talent and connect individual roles to CIBC's enterprise ambitions.
  • Lead National Strategic Initiatives. Architect and advance enterprise-wide priorities that evolve frontline roles, leadership capability, and coaching practices, while ensuring disciplined stakeholder engagement and measurable outcomes.
  • Elevate the Client Journey. Champion a seamless client experience framework that enables well-executed transitions across the Core, Imperial, and Private Wealth continuum — supported by targeted marketing strategies that deepen engagement and accelerate growth.
  • Advance frontline productivity and transformation by strengthening advice-based sales leadership and accelerating the adoption of omni-channel, virtual, and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Champion exceptional client and team member experiences by fostering a culture of continuous improvement, inclusion, accountability, and leadership excellence.
  • Maximize Competitive Positioning. Leverage the full breadth of CIBC's products, channels, specialists, and brand to deliver a differentiated client offer, while translating market intelligence and emerging industry trends into strategies that keep Imperial Service at the forefront of the financial advice landscape.
  • Align Partners and Infrastructure. Collaborate with product, infrastructure, and cross-functional business partners to ensure strategies, initiatives, and compensation frameworks reflect the needs of Imperial Service clients, frontline teams, and CIBC's broader strategic goals.
  • Uphold Regulatory Standards. Maintain the highest standards of licensing, accreditation, and operational compliance — including CIRO-MFD and CIRO-ID requirements — while embedding a proactive risk mindset across all levels of the team.

What We’re Looking For

  • Extensive leadership experience in Personal and Business Banking, with a strong track record in advice-based sales, client relationship management, and delivering strong business results.
  • Exceptional people leadership and coaching capability, with experience leading large, geographically dispersed sales teams and developing high-performing leaders for current and future business needs.
  • Deep knowledge of financial services practices, principles, and sales management, with the ability to translate strategy into execution and achieve financial, client, and operational objectives.
  • Proven ability to lead through change, maintaining employee engagement, clear communication, and alignment to strategic priorities during periods of transformation.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, including experience with strategic planning, business planning, and cost management to support sustainable growth and performance.
  • Highly effective relationship builder and influencer, able to work across a complex matrix organization to drive collaboration, alignment, and results without direct authority.
  • Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively up, down, and across the organization and turn strategic intent into clear, actionable priorities.
  • Strong client and market orientation, with the ability to leverage market insights, evolving client needs, and competitive dynamics to strengthen the client value proposition and business strategy.
  • Experience leading strategic initiatives with accountability for execution, stakeholder management, risk management, and delivery of measurable business outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of technology platforms, operational processes, data, and AI, with the ability to influence improvements that enhance frontline effectiveness and the client experience.

description:
The Alberta Electric System Operator (AESO) is responsible for the safe, reliable, and economic planning and operation of the Alberta Interconnected Electric System. We provide open and non-discriminatory access to Alberta’s interconnected power grid and also facilitate Alberta’s competitive wholesale electricity market. The AESO strives to foster an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace where people feel respected and welcomed for who they are, together we deliver high performance and innovative results.

Job Description

If you are a current AESO employee, please view openings and apply through our internal site at Workday.

We are seeking an Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Transformation Management Office (TMO). Reporting to the Manager, Business Design, you will support the delivery of enterprise transformation initiatives by coordinating operational readiness activities, enabling governance processes, and providing strategic and analytical support. Working across business units and leadership teams, you will develop executive materials, facilitate cross-functional collaboration, and help drive organizational alignment and transformation outcomes.

Signs you will enjoy this position:

  • You value flexibility to support life and personal needs. We offer a flexible work practice where some weeks may require more onsite presence during key business or operations events.
  • You enjoy working in a team of bright professionals, and work and learn in a diverse atmosphere - our team and colleagues have varied backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
  • You thrive in a dynamic environment and seek opportunities for transformative change.
  • You have excellent strategic thinking and analytical problem-solving skills.
  • Your exceptional interpersonal skills enable you to influence, collaborate and build relationships across multiple teams and organizational levels.
  • You possess exceptional organizational and communication skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast paced, evolving environment.


Accountabilities include but are not limited to:


Transformation Readiness, Coordination & Governance

  • Coordinate operational readiness activities to support successful transformation initiative implementation and Day 1 readiness.
  • Report on readiness activities, risks, dependencies, deliverables, and key milestones in partnership with operational teams.
  • Facilitate risk mitigation, issue resolution, and stakeholder alignment across the organization.
  • Develop executive-level presentations, recommendations, and governance materials.

Business Design, Analysis & Strategy

  • Drive stakeholder alignment by connecting strategic objectives, operational requirements, and organizational capabilities.
  • Lead cross-functional workshops and stakeholder discussions to define business needs, align priorities, and support decision-making.
  • Help initiative leads and project teams develop and implement future-state business designs.
  • Analyze business processes, operating models, risks, dependencies, and impacts to support transformation planning and execution.
  • Translate complex business challenges into actionable recommendations and practical solutions.
  • Build strong relationships across the organization, serving as a trusted advisor and facilitator.
  • Develop clear communications, presentations, and materials to support leadership decision-making.

What you’ll bring to us:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, economics, or a related field; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered.
  • 7-10+ years of experience in large change initiatives, strategy, operational readiness, or project management is strongly preferred.
  • Skilled in project and/or transformation delivery experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop executive level presentations, recommendations, and documents.
  • Knowledge of change management, operational readiness, or business transformation practices is considered an asset.


Why work with us
This full-time opportunity offers a competitive salary, along with paid vacation and flex time, health and dental benefits, mental health support, a defined contribution pension plan, and learning and development opportunities as part of the overall compensation package.

We support a hybrid work environment. The team is in the office on Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, with flexibility to work where you are most effective on Mondays and Fridays.

title: Applicator/Operations
description:
Agtegra Cooperative is a local agricultural cooperative headquartered in Aberdeen, SD. It is owned by over 7,000 farmers and ranchers, predominantly in North and South Dakota, with a network of over 70 locations and 850 employees. For more information, please visit www.agtegra.com.

At Agtegra, our mission is simple: we will do something great for farms and families in rural communities that nobody else will do. To accomplish this, Agtegra offers diverse career opportunities where employees can grow and work in their local communities. Your personal and professional needs matter here – which is why we offer a variety of competitive benefits to employees, including healthcare and retirement, generous paid-time-off (PTO), family leave, and a clothing allowance - just to name a few. It’s not just a job at Agtegra – it’s a place where we invite all employees to "Start Here. Grow Here."

POSITION SUMMARY
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Applicator/Operator to join our team. The Applicator/Operator is responsible for operating and maintaining spray equipment according to specifications as well as blending chemicals according to labels and will be responsible for assisting with the agronomy operations and providing excellent customer service.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Executing processes and operating machinery and equipment as required, including providing accurate and efficient unloading and delivery of product. This position involves the frequent operation of Skidloaders, Tractor/Mowers, Forklifts and Applicator equipment.
  • Inspecting buildings, grounds, and equipment utilized by the facility to troubleshoot, perform light maintenance, and complete repair work.
  • Responsible for blending crop protection products per label instructions to ensure quality chemicals, reading maps, following directions, and operating equipment with computer assisted operations.
  • Interacting regularly with customers, peers, and management to provide exceptional customer service, pursue continuous improvement of facility operations, and promote a teamwork focused environment. Includes interacting with Sales and Agronomy teams regarding field scouting and chemical mix recommendations.
  • Adheres to all safety regulations, requirements, policies and procedures, including OSHA regulations, the vehicle policy and fleet safety program, and DOT regulations.
  • Other duties as assigned

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Diploma/GED or 0-1 year related experience; or combination of education and experience
  • Valid driver’s license with the ability to obtain a CDL.
  • Commercial Applicator License or ability to obtain license.
  • Must be eligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship.
  • Must be 18 years or older.
  • English Proficiency.
  • Ability to perform physical job duties which may include bending, lifting up to 50lbs, kneeling, climbing, crawling, and twisting, with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Ability to work in varied indoor and outdoor conditions which may include heat, cold, dust, loud noise, etc., with the use of personal protective equipment (PPE) including a respirator.
  • Ability to work in elevated areas (4 feet and above)
  • Ability to work in confined spaces.
  • Ability to work overtime including weekends, holidays, or different shifts.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • CDL
  • Experience running applicator equipment.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands; talk or hear and taste or smell. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms; climb or balance and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 100 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly exposed to fumes or airborne particles and outside weather conditions. The employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions; high, precarious places; toxic or caustic chemicals; extreme cold; extreme heat and risk of electrical shock. The noise level in the work environment is usually loud.

The Payor Change Coordinator plays an important role in helping ensure patients receive uninterrupted service when their insurance or payor information changes.
