title: CAREER ADVANCEMENT NAVIGATOR
description:
About the Role:

The Career Advancement Navigator plays a pivotal role in empowering individuals to achieve their professional goals by providing personalized guidance and support throughout their career development journey. This position focuses on assessing clients' skills, interests, and experiences to create tailored advancement plans that align with their aspirations and market opportunities. The Navigator collaborates with educational institutions, employers, and community resources to connect clients with relevant training, certifications, and job openings. By continuously monitoring progress and adapting strategies, the Navigator ensures clients remain motivated and equipped to overcome barriers to career growth. Ultimately, this role contributes to enhancing workforce readiness and long-term employment success for diverse populations across the United States.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Career Counseling, Human Resources, Education, Social Work, or a related field.
  • At least two years of experience in career counseling, workforce development, or a related advisory role.
  • Strong understanding of labor market trends and workforce development resources within the United States.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to effectively engage with diverse client populations.
  • Proficiency in using career assessment tools and case management software.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in Counseling, Career Development, or a related discipline.
  • Certification from a recognized career development or counseling organization (e.g., NCC, GCDF).
  • Experience working with underserved or disadvantaged populations to support career advancement.
  • Familiarity with virtual coaching platforms and digital resource management.
  • Bilingual abilities to serve non-English speaking clients effectively.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct comprehensive assessments of clients’ career goals, skills, and educational backgrounds to develop individualized advancement plans.
  • Provide one-on-one coaching and counseling to help clients identify opportunities for skill development, certifications, and job placements.
  • Facilitate workshops and informational sessions on resume building, interview techniques, and professional networking.
  • Collaborate with employers, training providers, and community organizations to create pathways for client employment and advancement.
  • Track client progress, maintain detailed records, and adjust career plans as needed to ensure continuous development and success.

Skills:

The required skills enable the Career Advancement Navigator to conduct thorough assessments and develop actionable career plans tailored to each client’s unique needs. Strong communication and interpersonal skills are essential for building trust and motivating clients through their career journeys. Proficiency with career assessment tools and case management software facilitates efficient tracking and documentation of client progress. Preferred skills such as certification and bilingual abilities enhance the Navigator’s capacity to serve a broader and more diverse client base. Additionally, familiarity with virtual coaching platforms allows the Navigator to deliver flexible and accessible support in today’s evolving work environment.

title: Digital Learning AI Enablement Lead
description:
The Digital Learning AI Enablement Lead designs, builds, and maintains AI-assisted workflows that enhance the development, delivery, and measurement of learning and technology adoption programs across the Firm. As an emerging expert in AI-assisted learning solutions, the Lead combines knowledge of instructional design, adult learning principles, and learning technology with hands-on technical expertise to improve repeatable processes, develop reliable and documented workflows, and support the effective use of AI tools across the Digital Learning team and broader Learning & Development function.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, test, and maintain AI-assisted workflows, tools, and automations that improve the development, delivery, and measurement of learning and technology adoption programs.
  • Partner with Digital Learning team members to identify appropriate opportunities for AI-enabled process improvement, define requirements, develop solutions, and refine workflows based on business needs and user feedback.
  • Review AI-generated learning content, including outlines, scripts, job aids, assessments, and course descriptions, to ensure instructional soundness, accuracy, consistency, and alignment with Firm standards.
  • Apply instructional design and adult learning principles to AI-assisted solutions and maintain the content standards, templates, and conventions used to support consistent learning outputs.
  • Document AI-assisted workflows, including required inputs, processes, expected outputs, limitations, and appropriate use, enabling team members to use solutions effectively and independently.
  • Maintain the team's library of AI-assisted tools and workflows, monitoring utilization and effectiveness and recommending improvements, replacements, or retirement as technologies, source data, and Firm platforms evolve.

  • Facilitate AI enablement workshops and digital learning programs through classroom and virtual instruction, software demonstrations, workshops, and individual coaching, incorporating feedback to improve effectiveness.
  • Develop and maintain reporting on learning and technology adoption activity, including completion, utilization, engagement, and learner feedback, to support evaluation and continuous improvement.
  • Collaborate with colleagues across Learning & Development, Data & AI, IT, Knowledge Management, and other functions to support alignment with Firm AI initiatives and contribute to related learning projects as business needs evolve.

Education and/or Experience:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

  • Minimum of one year of hands-on experience designing, building, testing, documenting, and maintaining AI-assisted workflows intended for use by others.

title: Program Manager, Quality, Safety & Regulatory
description:
If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)

This is a Stanford Health Care Tri-Valley job.

A Brief Overview
The Quality, Safety & Regulatory Program Manager supports the Interventional and Procedural Services Platform by coordinating quality metrics, safety event follow-up, regulatory readiness, infection prevention partnership, radiation/contrast/sedation safety tracking, high-level disinfection oversight coordination, and procedural safety standards.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Quality and PI, the Program Manager works closely with the VP of Interventional Services, Senior Director of Procedural Nursing and Clinical Operations, Platform Medical Director, specialty medical directors, managers, Quality, Patient Safety, Infection Prevention, Regulatory, Radiation Safety, Pharmacy, and other partners to ensure the platform has reliable quality infrastructure and visible accountability for improvement.

This role is intended to be a central integration point for procedural quality, safety, and regulatory work. The Coordinator does not replace department-level accountability; rather, the role creates standard processes, dashboards, follow-up discipline, and escalation pathways across OR, Cath Lab, Interventional Radiology, Endoscopy, SPD, Pre/Post, and related procedural services.

Locations
Stanford Health Care Tri-Valley

What you will do

Quality Dashboard and Performance Monitoring

  • Develop, maintain, and coordinate platform quality and safety dashboards for OR, Cath Lab, Interventional Radiology, Endoscopy, SPD, Pre/Post/PACU/Procedural Recovery, and related procedural services.

  • Track procedural quality indicators, infection prevention indicators, procedural complications, sedation events, radiation dose outliers, contrast events, unplanned transfers/admissions, retained item risks, specimen labeling defects, endoscope reprocessing compliance, sterilization biological indicator failures, and other agreed measures.

  • Prepare routine reports for the Monthly Procedural Quality and Safety Committee, Interventional Services Executive Council, and leadership review.

Safety Event Review and Corrective Action Coordination

  • Coordinate review, classification, follow-up, and closure tracking for procedural safety events, near misses, regulatory findings, and improvement actions.

  • Support root cause analysis, apparent cause analysis, action planning, audit design, and evidence collection in collaboration with Quality and Patient Safety partners.

  • Ensure action plans have owners, timelines, evidence of completion, and sustainment measures.

Regulatory Readiness and Survey Support

  • Coordinate procedural regulatory readiness activities, mock survey preparation, tracers, documentation audits, policy review, competency tracking evidence, and survey response support.

  • Maintain readiness focus for surgical/procedural safety standards, sedation safety, high-level disinfection, infection prevention, radiation safety, contrast safety, medication safety, specimen handling, and SPD/sterilization processes.

  • Partner with managers to identify gaps, escalate risks, and support timely corrective action.

Cross-Functional Improvement and Standardization

  • Support standardization of policies, procedures, checklists, audits, dashboards, and escalation pathways across procedural areas.

  • Facilitate interdisciplinary improvement workgroups as assigned, including sedation safety, procedural verification, high-level disinfection, infection prevention, radiation/contrast safety, and SPD/OR reliability.

  • Promote a Just Culture, high-reliability principles, C-I-CARE, and transparent learning from events.

Key Performance Metrics

  • Timeliness and completeness of quality dashboards, monthly reporting, action item closure, and sustainment audits.

  • Safety event follow-up completion, corrective action verification, regulatory readiness scores, audit completion, and survey finding closure.

  • Performance trends in sedation safety, radiation/contrast safety, infection prevention, retained item risk, specimen labeling defects, endoscope reprocessing compliance, sterilization monitoring, and procedural complications.

  • Manager and physician leader satisfaction with quality reporting, escalation visibility, and improvement support.

Employee must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the C-I-CARE Standards of the Hospital. C-I-CARE is the foundation of Stanford Health Care Tri-Valley’s patient experience and represents a framework for patient-centered interactions.


Education Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in nursing, healthcare administration, quality management, public health, clinical discipline, or related field required. Master’s degree preferred.


Experience Qualifications

  • Minimum of four (4) years of healthcare experience in quality, patient safety, regulatory readiness, perioperative/procedural services, infection prevention, nursing, or clinical operations.

  • Experience with quality dashboards, safety event analysis, regulatory surveys, infection prevention, high-level disinfection, sedation safety, radiation or contrast safety, or procedural environments preferred.


License/Certification

  • Clinical license preferred when applicable to candidate background. CPHQ, CPPS, CIC, or related quality/safety/regulatory certification preferred.


Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Knowledge of healthcare quality, patient safety, regulatory standards, performance improvement, audit methods, and event follow-up.
  • Ability to work independently, organize complex cross-functional work, and influence without direct authority.
  • Strong data management, dashboard coordination, written communication, facilitation, and action-tracking skills.
  • Ability to maintain objectivity, confidentiality, and disciplined follow-through in sensitive quality and safety work.


These principles apply to ALL employees:

SHC Commitment to Providing an Exceptional Patient & Family Experience

Stanford Health Care sets a high standard for delivering value and an exceptional experience for our patients and families. Candidates for employment and existing employees must adopt and execute C-I-CARE standards for all of patients, families and towards each other. C-I-CARE is the foundation of Stanford’s patient-experience and represents a framework for patient-centered interactions. Simply put, we do what it takes to enable and empower patients and families to focus on health, healing and recovery.

You will do this by executing against our three experience pillars, from the patient and family’s perspective:

  • Know Me: Anticipate my needs and status to deliver effective care
  • Show Me the Way: Guide and prompt my actions to arrive at better outcomes and better health
  • Coordinate for Me: Own the complexity of my care through coordination

Equal Opportunity Employer Stanford Health Care (SHC) strongly values diversity and is committed to equal opportunity and non-discrimination in all of its policies and practices, including the area of employment. Accordingly, SHC does not discriminate against any person on the basis of race, color, sex, sexual orientation or gender identity and/or expression, religion, age, national or ethnic origin, political beliefs, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, veteran status, or disability, or the perception of any of the above. People of all genders, members of all racial and ethnic groups, people with disabilities, and veterans are encouraged to apply. Qualified applicants with criminal convictions will be considered after an individualized assessment of the conviction and the job requirements.

title: Client Executive VEC - VCG Channel Management
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing…

Join Verizon as we continue to expand our industry-leading network to improve the ways people, businesses, and things connect. Verizon is positioned to lead the “Fourth Industrial Revolution” (4IR) with the emergence of technologies like our best-in-class 5G network and the Internet of Things (IoT) to impact a wide variety of industries such as healthcare, education, manufacturing, public safety, government, and many others. We are in the midst of historic breakthroughs in connectivity and mobility to blend the physical and the digital through cutting-edge technologies such as virtual reality, augmented reality, artificial intelligence, autonomous vehicles, nanotechnologies, 3D printing, wearables, and advanced robotics. As part of this team, you will play a critical role in our network transformation through building a unified network across all lines of business and maintaining the technology that keeps millions of our customers connected.

You will serve as a Client Executive to approximately three to four hundred multi-dwelling unit (MDU) communities in the 5G Home footprint. You will be accountable for sales results and mitigating disconnects in your assigned module. You will be responsible for analyzing data and strategically planning marketing activities to drive sales. You will be coordinating events with property professionals and our vendors. You will partner with cross-functional teams, to resolve customer escalations.

  • Building and maintaining relationships with property staff.

  • Overseeing two-to-three vendor sales agents.

  • Creating marketing plans to increase sales.

  • Pulling sales data from Verizon systems.

  • Updating documents in Excel, PowerPoint and Google Sheets.

Physical requirements of the job may include but are not limited to lifting and carrying objects weighing up to approximately 30 pounds.

In the field at MDUs four days per week.

Willingness to transport and set up Verizon marketing materials for events.

This position will cover Charlotte, Concord, Huntersville, Gastonia, NC; Rock Hill, SC and surrounding areas. Employees must reside no more than 50 miles from their assigned sales territory or module.

What we’re looking for…

You are energized by the challenge of working through difficult situations and finding positive outcomes. You defuse the situation, isolate the core issue and address the customer’s concerns. You enjoy gathering information, understanding the facts of a situation, and like problem solving. You are flexible, dependable and work well on a team as well as independently.

You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.

  • Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience.

  • Willingness to work a rotating schedule (shifts) including evenings and weekends based on the needs of the business.

  • Ability to perform physical requirements of the job, with or without a reasonable accommodation.

  • Willingness to travel up to approximately 75% of the time.

  • Valid driver’s license.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • A degree.

  • Experience in working with Excel, PowerPoint, and Google Suite.

  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills.

  • Experience in wireless sales and ability to motivate others to sell.

  • Experience in systems, including Optix, AMDB, BDMS, OBIEE and VZAI.

  • Knowledge of the multi-dwelling housing industry.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this mobile role, you'll primarily work from customer or field location(s), with occasional visits to a Verizon location for in-person training and meetings.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits and Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

Job Summary

The Sr Manager Data Analytics Logistics & Procurement leads the design and delivery of high-value, complex analytics, artificial intelligence, automation, and data engineering solutions across Logistics and Procurement. This role combines deep technical expertise with business acumen to translate operational challenges into scalable data products, intelligent applications, and automated solutions that deliver measurable business value.


The Sr Manager provides hands-on technical leadership across advanced analytics and data engineering — including solution architecture, data pipelines and modeling, AI-enabled applications, system integrations, and workflow automation. The role owns initiatives end to end, from problem identification and technical design through development, production implementation, adoption, and value realization.


The Sr Manager works closely with Logistics and Procurement leaders, senior leadership, and data and analytics teams across Tyson to identify and implement the tools, platforms, and practices needed to deliver continued value to stakeholders. This includes partnering with IT and enterprise technical teams to ensure the security, reliability, and scalability of Tyson data.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities


Strategy and Business Partnership

  • Business Partnership. Partner directly with Logistics and Procurement leaders and operational teams to understand business processes, identify opportunities, and translate operational challenges into technical requirements and solutions.
  • Strategy and Roadmap. Collaborate with senior leadership to define strategy and roadmaps that align analytics, AI, and automation initiatives with broader business priorities, and evaluate emerging technologies to determine where new capabilities can practically create value.
  • Business Case Development. Develop business cases, quantify opportunities, establish expected ROI and success measures, and communicate recommendations and value to business and senior leadership.

Solution Delivery and Technical Leadership

  • Initiative Leadership. Lead complex, high-value analytics, AI, automation, and data engineering initiatives from opportunity identification and requirements development through technical design, implementation, adoption, and value realization.
  • Solution Architecture and Standards. Design and guide scalable solutions — data pipelines and models, integrations, analytics applications, automated workflows, and AI-enabled capabilities — and establish the reusable technical patterns and development practices that allow the team to efficiently build, deploy, monitor, and scale them.
  • AI and Advanced Analytics. Develop and operationalize AI and advanced analytics solutions that improve decision-making, automate processes, identify exceptions, and surface actionable insights.
  • Hands-On Delivery. Contribute directly through solution development, prototyping, architecture and code reviews, and troubleshooting, applying agile practices to deliver on time and to quality standards.

Team Leadership and Development

  • Lead and Develop the Team. This position is considered an individual contributor and does not have direct reports. However, it will be required to partner with organizational leaders to support their teams in development of analytics, data engineering, and technical talent by providing coaching, expertise, and developmental opportunities that enhance skills, broaden cross-functional exposure, and foster career growth within a collaborative and innovative culture.

  • Technical Mentorship. Mentor analysts, data engineers, and team leads on advanced technical techniques, solution reviews, and problem-solving, and share knowledge broadly to expand team capability.

Operational Excellence and Governance

  • Enterprise Collaboration. Collaborate with IT and enterprise technical teams on architecture, infrastructure, security, integration, governance, and production deployment, driving solutions forward from the Logistics and Procurement business perspective.
  • Operational Performance and Risk. Drive operational improvements across the team and oversee risk management processes that proactively address issues and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Stakeholder and Vendor Management. Maintain frequent, effective communication with cross-functional teams and stakeholders, and evaluate and manage relationships with vendors and service providers to ensure successful partnerships.
  • Value Realization. Measure solution adoption, operational impact, financial value, and reliability following implementation.

This role will also perform other job-related duties as assigned that align with the organization’s vision, mission, and values and fall within the scope of the role.


Qualifications


Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Analytics, Information Systems, Supply Chain Management, Business, or a related field is preferred. Master’s degree is strongly preferred. Seven years of relevant experience will also be considered in place of a degree.


Preferred Certification(s)

Relevant certifications in data engineering, cloud technologies, AI, machine learning, automation, analytics, or related disciplines are preferred but not required.


Experience

Seven years+ of relevant, practical experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, artificial intelligence, automation, software development, advanced analytics, analytics management, or a related technical field, with a proven ability to lead and motivate teams.

Demonstrated experience designing and delivering complex, production-ready data or technology solutions is strongly preferred. Experience applying technology within logistics, procurement, supply chain, warehousing, manufacturing, or another operationally intensive environment is preferred.


Special Skills

  • Technical Depth. Strong knowledge of modern data engineering and architecture — data pipelines, modeling, orchestration, integrations, cloud data environments, and scalable solution design — along with proficiency in scripting or software development and familiarity with APIs, version control, testing, monitoring, and security.
  • AI and Automation Fluency. Strong understanding of modern AI, machine learning, and intelligent automation, and of the data and application patterns required to turn these capabilities into practical business solutions.
  • Problem-Solving and Decision-Making. Ability to independently structure ambiguous problems, investigate technical and data challenges, evaluate alternatives, and make sound decisions under pressure.
  • Business and Technical Translation. Ability to understand operational processes and translate between business requirements, data needs, technical architecture, and measurable business outcomes.
  • Leadership and Delivery Management. Strong leadership and proficiency in project management methodologies and tools, and the ability to set technical direction and gain alignment across business stakeholders, engineers, IT teams, and senior leadership.
  • Communication and Interpersonal Skills. Ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts, recommendations, opportunities, and risks to both technical and non-technical audiences, ensuring alignment and understanding at all levels.
  • Supervisory: No direct reports
  • Travel: 1-3 trips per year

title: Data Engineer
description:
Prolific is not just another player in the AI space—we are the architects of the human data infrastructure that's reshaping the landscape of AI development. In a world where foundational AI technologies are increasingly commoditized, it's the quality and diversity of human-generated data that truly differentiates products and models.

The role

We're looking for a Data Engineer to help build scalable data solutions that serve teams across the business—from data scientists and analysts to AI engineers and product teams. You'll contribute to both the underlying platform and the way data is used in our products, working in a modern, cloud-native environment where privacy, security, and good data practices are part of how we build.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • Technical Expertise: 3+ years building and shipping production-grade data systems, with strong SQL skills and proficiency in Python or another object-oriented language (Java, Scala etc.)
  • Familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure—ideallysome exposure to Terraform, Kubernetes, or similar IaC and container orchestration tools. We don't expect deep expertise in all of these, but comfort working in this kind of environment matters.
  • Experience designing data APIs or services that expose data to applications, or a strong interest in working across the analytical/operational boundary.
  • A thoughtful approach to data quality, privacy, and security—youunderstand that how data is used is as important as how it's moved.
  • Strong collaboration skills and comfort working across teams with different priorities—engineers, data scientists, AI engineers, and product.
  • A pragmatic, curious mindset—youenjoy keeping up with the field and know when to reach for a new tool versus when to stick with what works.
  • Pipeline Management: Hands-on experience with data pipeline tools (Airflow, dbt) and strong ability to optimize for performance and reliability.
  • Quality Focus: Commitment to continuously improving product quality, security, and performance through rigorous testing and code reviews.
  • Documentation: Meticulous approach to creating and maintaining architecture and systems documentation.
  • Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical skills to troubleshoot complex data issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Independence: Capability to ship medium features independently while contributing to the team's overall objectives.

What you’ll be doing in the role

  • Build and maintain data pipelines that power analytics, ML workloads, and product-facing applications—from internal databases, SaaS sources, and streaming systems through to the teams and services that consume them.
  • Evolve our data platform alongside cloud platform engineers, using infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and Kubernetes-based deployments (Argo) to keep the platform scalable, reliable, and self-serve.
  • System Architecture: Design and implement scalable data infrastructure that accommodates our growing data volume and complexity.
  • Develop data services and APIs that expose trusted data to product applications, bridging analytical and operational systems.
  • Own data quality and observability, putting monitoring, testing, and alerting in place so issues are caught early and trust in the data stays high.
  • Partner with AI engineers, data scientists, analysts, and product teams to understand their data needs and design the right solutions—not just the quickest ones.
  • Uphold strong data privacy, security, and compliance practices in everything you build, particularly where data flows into product-facing contexts.
  • Technical Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive documentation of data flows, models, and systems for knowledge sharing.
  • Security and Compliance: Ensure all data systems adhere to security best practices and compliance requirements.

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation—one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

HELP BUILD WHAT’S NEXT IN PLASMA COLLECTION

What if your next opportunity wasn’t just about training employees-but about helping build a new plasma collection center from the ground up? PlasmaSource is opening a new plasma donation center in Saratoga Springs, Utah, and we’re looking for a Training Instructor to help develop employees, establish training standards, and shape a culture of quality from Day One. As an emerging business line within Vitalant, PlasmaSource combines the energy of a growing organization with the resources and experience of an established one.

The Training Instructor will provide orientation and continuing education for collection staff, ensuring employees have the knowledge and skills to perform safely, effectively, and in compliance with SOPs and regulations. This role combines clinical expertise with coaching and mentorship, providing onsite and virtual training, evaluating competency, supporting retraining and process changes, and partnering with Leadership.This is an opportunity to help build a strong team and create an exceptional donor experience from the start.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

• Identify individual training needs and partner with leadership to address performance concerns.

Support Training and Process Changes

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

We’re looking for a knowledgeable and engaging training professional who combines plasma collection experience with strong communication, coaching, and instructional skills. The ideal candidate is passionate about developing people, maintaining technical excellence, and helping employees succeed.

Requirements:

• High school diploma or equivalent required.

WHY PLASMASOURCE?

Founding-team opportunities don’t come along often.

PlasmaSource exists because patients depend on plasma. Every day, our teams help connect donors to the plasma therapies patients need.

BUILD THE TEAM. SHAPE THE CULTURE. DEVELOP THE PEOPLE. IMPROVE LIVES. READY TO BUILD WHAT’S NEXT?

title: Risk Lead, IT Risk Management
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 10/15/2026

2024989 - Risk Lead, IT Risk Management (Remote)

  • The role is listed as remote and can be performed from anywhere in the US
  • NOTE: Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

Meet the Team

Commerce Engineering Productivity & Platforms (CEP&P) is a fast paced, multifaceted engineering organization that adapts quickly to changing business and technology needs. We are launching IT Risk Management (ITRM) to support all of Cisco AI + IT with real-time risk insight, resilience testing, and closed-loop remediation. CEP&P brings together shared-service functions that enable teams across Cisco. You’ll work with some of Cisco’s most cutting-edge engineers and technical leaders as we invent how AI-native delivery changes the way we build, operate, and manage risk.

Your Impact

You will lead ITRM as an expert practitioner at the leading edge of AI-enabled risk management. You will define the standard and methodology, use AI and agentic tools to turn fragmented signals into risk intelligence, and build the assurance model that tests resilience, control effectiveness, and AI safeguards. You will guide where AI can safely detect, prioritize, act, test, and verify; challenge disaster-recovery capability with evidence rather than accepting plans at face value; and ensure the organization confirms that remediation held. This role combines deep risk expertise with hands-on proficiency in AI, agents, automation, telemetry, and the systems that make closed-loop remediation possible.

  • Own the ITRM standard and methodology: risk sensing, aggregation, prioritization, risk appetite, taxonomy, thresholds, and common methods.
  • Lead the AI-enabled risk intelligence model. Define how sub-agents use signals from across AI + IT to prioritize exposure by business impact and support real-time leadership insight.
  • Define the assurance model for critical service outcomes, failure tolerances, resilience, control effectiveness, and AI lifecycle safeguards. Challenge disaster-recovery capability through evidence-based tests of objectives, dependencies, and recovery procedures.
  • Operate the closed-loop model through named owners, action tracking, risk acceptance and escalation paths, and verification that risk reduction actually occurred. Feed incidents, test results, and lessons back into standards and design.
  • Provide technical thought leadership on AI-enabled risk management. Partner with the Software Engineer and leaders across AI + IT, STO, Finance, Security, Compliance, and Resiliency to set guardrails, evaluate agent behavior, enable automation and telemetry, and preserve domain ownership of risk decisions and remediation execution.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in IT risk, GRC, audit, control assurance, or technology risk program management.
  • Experience establishing a common risk framework, taxonomy or scoring method, enterprise risk register, and recurring executive review cadence.
  • Experience partnering with executive team members and domain owners to define RACI, escalation paths, risk acceptance, and decision rights.
  • Experience working across at least two of the following domains: SOX or control assurance, vulnerability management, lifecycle management, business continuity or disaster recovery, application resiliency, CMMC, or GRC or audit.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Information Systems, Risk Management, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience applying AI, agentic workflows, automation, or sophisticated analytics to technology risk, security, resilience, control assurance, or operations, including guardrails and human-in-the-loop review.
  • Experience leading evidence-based resilience, control-effectiveness, or AI lifecycle testing as systems, models, data, and dependencies evolve.
  • Experience connecting fragmented risk or compliance programs into a common operating model while leaving domain risks and remediation execution with the teams that own them.
  • Experience building closed-loop risk management with named owners, action tracking, verified closure, and measures such as automation coverage, signal-to-action time, or repeat-risk reduction.
  • Fosters candid communication and balanced debate. Acknowledges all perspectives and drives consensus on decisions that improve business outcomes.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Sterile Services Technician
description:
CSSD Technician

The Harley Street Clinic, London

Full time, 37.5 hours per week

A mixture of early and late shifts between 07:30 and 21:00, Monday - Saturday (working 5 days)

Permanent

Competitive salary (dependent on experience) + excellent benefits

We’re looking for a CSSD Technician to join our Sterile Services (CSSD) team based at The Harley Street Clinic. The department plays a critical role in supporting clinical services by ensuring the safe, effective decontamination and distribution of reusable medical devices. This team operates to the highest standards, working closely with theatres and clinical teams to maintain patient safety and deliver exceptional care. This role is essential in maintaining the smooth running of hospital operations and ensuring equipment availability when it matters most.

As a CSSD Technician, you’ll support the day-to-day delivery of a safe and efficient decontamination service. Responsibilities will include carrying out the full decontamination cycle while maintaining strict compliance with quality and safety standards. Working in a fast-paced environment, you’ll liaise with clinical teams, support junior staff, and contribute to continuous improvements across the department. This is an excellent opportunity to join a highly specialised team where attention to detail and commitment to quality directly impacts patient outcomes.

Above all else, we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life. It’s this guiding vision that influences everything we do at HCA UK. From the CEO to the colleagues on the floor we all have a part to play in delivering exceptional care to our patients. Other’s may think this is just a role in Sterile Services (CSSD), but to us, you’ll be part of a wider team with a unique sense of purpose, one that helps improve lives on a daily basis.

What you’ll do:

  • Carry out decontamination processes including disassembly, cleaning, sterilisation, and reassembly of medical devices
  • Adhere to Standard Operating Procedures and Quality Management Systems
  • Support and guide Apprentice CSSD Technicians in daily activities
  • Maintain accurate tracking records using HESSDA systems and monitor stock levels
  • Communicate with clinical teams and escalate non-conformance issues appropriately

What you’ll bring:

  • Experience working in a decontamination / sterile services environment
  • Knowledge of cleaning, disinfection, and sterilisation of medical devices
  • Understanding of infection control, COSHH, HTM guidelines, and ISO standards
  • Ability to follow Standard Operating Procedures accurately and escalate faults appropriately
  • NVQ Level 3 in Decontamination Science (or equivalent experience)

Why HCA UK?
Originally founded over 50 years ago by Dr Thomas Frist, HCA has gone on to become one of the world’s leading healthcare providers. In the UK, we’re one of the largest providers of privately funded healthcare and have invested over £500 million in the latest treatments, technology, techniques, medication and facilities. Being part of a large multisite, established healthcare group we can offer you unrivalled opportunities for career progression through internal and external courses, as well as working conditions that prioritise both your mental and physical wellbeing.

By caring for our colleagues, we empower them to provide exceptional care for our patients. That’s why we offer a host of flexible benefits that reflect the invaluable contribution they make every day. As a CSSD Technician you’ll be eligible for:

  • 25 days holiday each year (plus bank holidays) increasing with service, with option to buy or sell leave to suit you
  • Private Healthcare Insurance for treatment at our leading hospitals
  • Private pension contribution which increases with length of service
  • Season Ticket Loan and Cycle to Work scheme
  • Group Life Assurance from day one
  • Critical illness cover
  • Enhanced Maternity and Paternity pay
  • Corporate staff discount for all facilities including Maternity packages at The Portland
  • Comprehensive range of flexible health, protection and lifestyle benefits to suit you
  • Discounts with over 800 major retailers

Culture and values
At HCA UK we believe exceptional care starts with our people. We celebrate the unique perspectives and different experiences each of us bring as we know that when you feel seen, heard and supported you can be at your best for our patients, and each other.

Our mission is simple, above all else we’re committed to the care and improvement of human life, a clear statement that extends to both our patients and colleagues. To achieve this, we live and breathe four core values:

  • Unique and Individual: We recognise and value everyone as unique and individual
  • Kindness and compassion: We treat people with kindness and compassion
  • Honesty, integrity and fairness: We act with absolute honesty, integrity and fairness
  • Loyalty, respect and dignity: We trust and treat one another as valued members of the HCA UK family with loyalty, respect and dignity

Reasonable adjustments
We believe everyone should feel comfortable to bring their full self to work and be afforded the same opportunities. As a Disability Confident committed organisation, we’re happy to discuss flexible working arrangements to suit your needs as well as offer reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process, and in the workplace, to anyone that needs them.

title: Software Engineer, IT Risk Management
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 10/15/2026

2024990 - Software Engineer, IT Risk Management (Remote)

  • The role is listed as remote and can be performed from anywhere in the US
  • NOTE: Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

Meet the Team

Commerce Engineering Productivity & Platforms (CEP&P) is a fast-moving, multifaceted engineering organization that adapts quickly to changing business and technology needs. We are launching IT Risk Management (ITRM) to support all of Cisco AI + IT with real-time risk insight, resilience testing, and closed-loop remediation. CEP&P brings together shared-service functions that enable teams across Cisco. You’ll work with some of Cisco’s most cutting-edge engineers and technical leaders as we invent how AI-native delivery changes the way we build, operate, and manage risk.

Your Impact

You will build the technical engine that helps ITRM respond to risk at machine speed. You will use Circuit My Agent, and sub-agents to turn signals from security exposure, lifecycle and technical debt, SOX, resilience, identity and AI security, GRC, and portfolio ownership into real-time risk insights and closed-loop action. You will help move the organization from retrospective reporting to risk reduction that is tested, verified, and improved.

  • Design, build, and operate Circuit My Agent and sub-agent workflows that sense signals, map exposure, prioritize risk by business impact, and deliver real-time insights.
  • Integrate enterprise sources such as ServiceNow, ESP, CMDB, AppSec and vulnerability tooling, SOX evidence, resilience tests, and audit or MAP actions into trusted risk intelligence.
  • Implement rules, guardrails, and automated controls that detect drift or unsafe change across systems, models, data, and dependencies, with human review for exceptions.
  • Test resilience, control effectiveness, and AI lifecycle safeguards before disruption and as systems evolve, using telemetry and evidence to identify gaps.
  • Build closed-loop workflows that track action, verify risk reduction, and develop lessons back into design.
  • Partner with the Risk Lead, domain owners, Security Primes, PSAs, and engineers to productionize the capability.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience building production applications, integrations, or automation.
  • AI-first attitude with demonstrated ability to experiment with emerging models, developer tools, and agentic workflows; knows the latest model capabilities and challenges established ways of working.
  • Experience building APIs, event-driven services, or automated workflows using Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or a comparable language.
  • Experience integrating signals or telemetry from multiple enterprise systems into risk intelligence, alerts, dashboards, or operational reporting.
  • Experience with source control, CI/CD, and automated testing for services running in production.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI models, agents, or sub-agents to improve engineering productivity, quality, or risk reduction; evaluates emerging tools and trends and turns useful experiments into production capabilities.
  • Experience with IT risk, security, compliance, resilience, or control data, such as SOX evidence, vulnerabilities, CMDB, ServiceNow, or GRC platforms.
  • Experience implementing rules, telemetry, automated controls, or resilience and control-effectiveness testing for production systems.
  • Experience designing dashboards or measures for real-time risk insight, signal-to-action time, verified closure, automation coverage, or repeat-risk reduction.
  • Constructive communication and active listening. Identifies obstacles early, follows through to reliable outcomes, and influences through peer networking.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

description:

About the Role

  • Lead end-to-end development of enterprise-grade applications, from requirements analysis and solution design to development, testing, deployment, and production support.

  • Partner with product owners, business stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams to translate business needs into robust technical solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to engineers while promoting best practices in software design, code quality, performance, and reliability.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to modernize systems, optimize application performance, and improve development efficiency.
  • Ensure solutions are aligned with enterprise engineering standards, security expectations, and scalable delivery practices.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on experience in .Net development, including designing and building scalable backend services and enterprise applications.
  • Proven experience with front-end development using React and Angular.
  • Strong working knowledge of SQL, including database design, query optimization, stored procedures, and performance tuning.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently run a project from scratch, including technical design, development planning, implementation, and delivery.
  • Experience working across the full software development lifecycle in an Agile or iterative delivery environment.
  • Strong understanding of application architecture, API development, integration patterns, debugging, and production support.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, ownership mindset, and ability to operate with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a principal engineer, lead engineer, or senior technical ownership role.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms, DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern deployment approaches.
  • Experience designing microservices, distributed systems, or high-volume enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with secure coding practices, observability, application monitoring, and performance engineering.
  • Prior experience mentoring engineers, conducting code reviews, and establishing engineering best practices.
  • Experience working with global teams or supporting enterprise-scale technology platforms.

What You’ll Get

At Rocket India, you’ll be part of a high-impact technology environment where innovation, ownership, and collaboration are valued. You’ll have the opportunity to work on meaningful platforms that support enterprise transformation while growing your technical leadership capabilities. You’ll collaborate with talented teams across India and global Rocket functions, contributing to solutions that improve experiences for clients and team members. We offer an inclusive workplace that encourages learning, professional development, and bold thinking.

Rocket India, registered as NSM Services Private Limited and formerly Mr. Cooper, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Rocket Mortgage, LLC, headquartered in Detroit, Michigan. As a core part of Rocket’s global ecosystem, Rocket India helps shape the future of home financing through technology, innovation, and client-focused digital solutions. Our teams partner closely with global functions across Operations, Product, Technology, Innovation, and Customer areas to simplify mortgage origination and servicing, remove friction, and create lasting value for homeowners. Together, we support Rocket’s mission to “Help Everyone Home” by turning bold ideas into real-world impact.

title: Senior Design Manager
description:
The West Kowloon Cultural District Authority welcomes exceptional talent with a passion to realise the vision and mission of making the West Kowloon Cultural District a prime local and international destination for arts, culture and entertainment.

Reporting to the Director, Special Projects Design within the Projects Department, the Senior Design Manager is a key leadership role responsible for the strategic and technical management of architectural and design initiatives across the West Kowloon Cultural District (WestK). This role oversees the planning, coordination, and review of multi-disciplinary designs to ensure they are fit for purpose, high-quality, and compliant with all statutory requirements.

The incumbent will lead design management for in-house studies and other assigned projects. This involves managing external Design Consultants, collaborating with internal functional teams, and ensuring that all design deliverables are achieved on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality and sustainability. The Senior Design Manager plays a critical role in safeguarding the Authority’s design vision and ensuring project success.

Key Responsibilities:

Design Leadership and Management

  • Lead and manage the architectural, interior, and landscape design processes for assigned projects and studies across WestK, from strategy formulation and conceptual design through to detailed design and construction support.

  • Oversee the vetting and review of all design submissions, including architectural plans, interior designs, materials and specifications, as well as submissions to ensure they align with the project's intent and the Authority's quality standards.

  • Proactively identify and resolve design, construction, and interface issues, liaising with Design Consultants, Project Consultants, and Works Contractors to deliver time and cost-effective solutions.

  • Provide expert design direction, support, and coordination for assigned projects, managing the performance of Design Consultants in achieving cost, quality, and time targets.

Project Planning and Development

  • Prepare and develop conceptual and preliminary designs for in-house studies and projects as required.

  • Ensure that project requirements, user needs, and statutory obligations are accurately incorporated into all design deliverables, tender documents, contract documents, and works on site.

  • Oversee the preparation of design reports, feasibility studies, status reports, and presentation materials for regular progress reviews and reporting to senior management and the Authority’s oversight committees.

Stakeholder and Consultant Management

  • Manage and coordinate Design Consultants and Works Contractors, ensuring their performance and deliverables are managed effectively and efficiently in accordance with their contracts.

  • Collaborate closely with the Engineering, Project Management, and Project Cost Control teams within the Projects Department to jointly ensure that design development, project programmes, and costs are managed and maintained.

  • Assist the Project Cost Control team in assessing design variations and claims submitted by Consultants and Contractors, providing expert recommendations to management.

  • Foster cooperative and collaborative synergies with all internal and external stakeholders, including government departments, utilities organizations, and PPP project developers.

Compliance and Quality Assurance

  • Ensure all design activities and statutory submissions (e.g., Buildings Department, Planning Department) comply with the Hong Kong Building Ordinance, planning regulations, and other relevant statutory requirements.

  • Conduct site inspections on design matters to ensure that on-site works correspond with the approved design and specifications.

  • Champion the use of Building Information Modelling (BIM) and drive its effective application in design coordination, documentation, and project delivery.

Strategic Support

  • Support the Director, Special Projects Design in developing methodologies that promote efficient and effective design management.

  • Perform any other duties as the Authority may reasonably direct from time to time.

Requirements:

Qualifications and Experience

  • A recognized university degree or master's degree in Architecture, Urban Design, or a related design discipline.

  • A member of the Hong Kong Institution of Architects (HKIA) or equivalent recognized professional institution.

  • A Registered Architect with the Architects Registration Board of Hong Kong.

  • Authorized Person (Architect) or equivalent is preferred.

  • A minimum of 12 years of post-qualification experience in design and management of large-scale, mixed-use, or major infrastructure projects, of which 8 years should be at a senior managerial level.

Technical Competencies

  • In-depth knowledge and practice of architectural design in Hong Kong.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of Hong Kong’s statutory and planning/building-related legislation, regulations, codes, and standards.

  • Proven experience in managing the time, cost, and quality issues throughout the entire design process.

  • A thorough understanding of and skill in design and design management, with specific technical competence in mixed-use and multi-disciplinary design integration.

  • Advanced working knowledge of Building Information Modelling (BIM) software, tools, and techniques, and their application to design, statutory submissions, coordination, and construction stages.

  • Familiarity with design software (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, 3D modeling, and presentation tools) and the ability to be "hands-on" in producing in-house designs, presentations, and reports.

Core Skills and Competencies

  • Proven leadership skills in managing multi-disciplinary design professionals, project stakeholders, and statutory authorities.

  • Excellent strategic thinking, planning, organizing, and reporting skills, with a strong attention to detail and the ability to take ownership of outcomes.

  • Skilled in creative problem-solving, decision-making, and developing solutions that are both technically sound and commercially viable.

  • Effectiveness in dealing with claims from Design Consultants, Contractors, and Government Departments.

  • Exceptional interpersonal, cooperative, and collaborative communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at all levels.

  • Proficient in both written and spoken English and Chinese.

Critical Success Factors

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and inspire a design team to achieve project objectives.

  • Capacity to balance and integrate multiple design, commercial, and stakeholder requirements to achieve a cohesive and successful outcome.

  • Track record of proactively identifying and resolving complex design and construction interface issues.

  • Strong business acumen and client perspective, ensuring design decisions support the broader goals of the Authority.

title: Hose Assembly Technician Paid Training & Company Vehicle
description:
Benefits:
  • Bonus based on performance
  • Company car
  • Competitive salary
  • Health insurance
  • Opportunity for advancement
  • Paid time off

This Is Not Your Typical Job Posting

Most job ads are full of corporate buzzwords, vague promises, and a laundry list of “requirements” that don’t tell you what the job is actually like. That’s not us.

We’re looking for the one person who reads this and thinks:
“Yeah — I could do this, and I’d fit in here.”

At PIRTEK Brooklyn, we keep New York’s equipment moving. From tugboats and shipyards to construction sites and industrial machines, when a hose blows or a machine goes down, work stops — and we’re the ones who get the call to get it running again. Fast.

This is hands-on work, real problem-solving, and real responsibility. If you want an easy, predictable desk job, this isn’t it. If you want a career where your work actually matters, keep reading.

Who We Are

We’re a tight-knit Staten Island crew. We work hard, we bust chops, and we argue about important things — like who actually has the best pizza or bagels, and which New York team is going to inevitably break our hearts this season.

We’re NYC through and through, and we take pride in that. Our customers aren’t always easy, the work isn’t always clean, the weather doesn't always cooperate and breakdowns don’t care what time it is — but that’s exactly why they call us.

A few things we take seriously:

  • Communication matters. With customers and with each other.

  • Processes exist for a reason. Following them keeps everyone safe and successful.

  • Respect is non-negotiable. For customers, teammates, and equipment.

  • We hustle — and we get rewarded for it.

Our best techs treat a customer’s equipment like it’s their own. That mindset is why most of our customers stick with us long-term.

We believe in win-win-win: the customer wins, the company wins, and the tech wins.

What You’ll Actually Do

This isn’t a vague “technician” role. Here’s the real work:

  • Drive a fully outfitted PIRTEK mobile service van across Brooklyn and the greater NYC area

  • Respond to on-site breakdowns, routinely on an emergency basis

  • Diagnose, replace, and install hydraulic and industrial hoses

  • Work on:

    • Marine equipment, tugboats, and shipyards

    • Construction equipment

    • Industrial machinery

    • Machine servicing and cylinder repair

  • Be part of the on-call rotation (yes, nights and weekends happen — and yes, you’re paid extra for it)

  • Communicate clearly with customers — explaining what’s wrong and what it’ll take to fix it

  • Keep your truck, tools, and paperwork in order so you’re always ready to roll

You Might Be a Fit If…

  • You like working with your hands and figuring things out

  • You hustle and don’t need to be babysat

  • You can stay calm when a customer is stressed and a machine is down

  • You communicate well — problems don’t get ignored here

  • You respect processes and understand they protect you

  • You’re mechanically inclined (cars, boats, heavy equipment, machines — it all helps but specific experience isn't required)

  • You don’t mind dirt, grease, tight spaces, or being on your feet

  • You have a valid driver’s license and can pass a background and drug check

No hose experience? No problem.
We provide hands-on training and 24/7 technical support.

Training & Growth

  • 4–6 weeks of structured training

  • Then you’ll be trusted to run your own service calls

  • Over time, you’ll gain specialized repair knowledge (marine, cylinders, advanced diagnostics)

  • Strong performers can move into Lead Tech roles within 12–24 months

  • This is a career path, not a dead-end job

Pay & Benefits

  • $25–$35/hour depending on experience

  • Commission-based sales incentives and performance bonuses

  • Paid on-call premiums

  • Company vehicle and phone

  • Health benefits: medical, dental, and vision

  • Paid time off and holidays

  • Ongoing certified training and growth opportunities

The Bottom Line

This job isn’t for everyone — and that’s intentional.

But if you want:

  • Real responsibility

  • Real skills

  • Real earning potential

  • And to be part of a crew that actually has your back

Then PIRTEK Brooklyn might be the right move for you.

title: Full Stack Senior Developer
description:
The University of Newcastle – Newcastle NSW

Are you an experienced software engineer who enjoys working across the full technology stack?

The University of Newcastle is looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer / Senior DevOps Engineer to provide technical leadership across cloud platforms, application development and integration services.

This is a hands‑on role where you’ll design, build and support modern technology solutions while helping to strengthen engineering practices, mentor other developers and solve complex technical challenges.

You’ll work across cloud infrastructure, application development, integration and DevOps, helping evolve the University’s technology platforms and applications to meet changing business needs.

The Role

You’ll work across a broad range of technical activities, including:

  • Design, develop and operate modern solutions on AWS.
  • Build and support backend, integration and web applications.
  • Develop cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code and automation.
  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
  • Build and integrate services using technologies such as API Gateway, AppSync, Lambda, ECS and SQS.
  • Develop modern front‑end applications using React and contemporary web technologies.
  • Implement monitoring, observability, alerting and operational support practices.
  • Diagnose complex technical issues and contribute to the ongoing evolution of University technology platforms.
  • Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers and promote effective software engineering and DevOps practices.
  • Work closely with stakeholders and delivery teams to understand problems, develop practical solutions and achieve delivery outcomes.

About you

You’re a senior software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and working across development, cloud and operations. You will also have experience leading and managing a small technical team, including mentoring and developing engineers

You’ll bring strong experience in AWS, software engineering and DevOps, along with the ability to take ownership of solutions from design through to deployment and ongoing support.

Experience with Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, cloud‑native development, integration services and modern web development will be valuable.

We’re not expecting you to be an expert in every technology listed — if you bring strong experience across most of these areas and the ability to learn and adapt, we’d like to hear from you.

You’ll also have:

  • Strong software engineering skills across backend, integration and web applications.
  • Experience designing, building and operating solutions in AWS or a comparable cloud environment.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as CDK, CloudFormation, SAM or Terraform.
  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation and DevOps practices.
  • Experience with cloud services such as API Gateway, AppSync, Lambda, ECS and SQS, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with monitoring, observability, alerting and operational support.
  • Front‑end development experience using React and modern web technologies.
  • The ability to provide technical leadership, mentor engineers and contribute to delivery outcomes.

title: Voice Tier 3 Engineer
description:
Voice Tier 3 Engineer

KeenLogic is seeking a Voice Tier 3 Engineer to support the U.S. Air Force’s Executive Airlift Communications Network (EACN). EACN delivers voice, video, and data services to senior U.S. Government leaders aboard executive aircraft through operational gateways at Scott Air Force Base, Joint Base Andrews, and Joint Base Lewis-McChord. A Systems Integration Lab at Scott Air Force Base supports engineering, testing, and validation of changes before operational implementation.

This position will provide advanced engineering and technical support for EACN’s Cisco-based Voice over Internet Protocol environment. The engineer will configure, enhance, secure, and troubleshoot voice systems and develop connections between EACN and external customer voice networks.

KeenLogic offers Fortune 500-level benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance, PTO, paid federal holidays, 401(k), and life insurance.

Position Details

  • Anticipated Start: January 2, 2027, with availability required for the beginning of phase-in.
  • Contract Length: Anticipated phase-in from January 2–February 1, 2027, followed by a base period from February 2–September 30, 2027. Four one-year option periods may extend performance through September 30, 2031, with a potential six-month extension through March 31, 2032.
  • Location: Scott Air Force Base, Illinois.
  • Onsite Requirements: Onsite support for the laboratory and operational environment. Limited telework is subject to Government approval and mission requirements.
  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, with an assigned schedule within 6:30 AM–5:30 PM Central Time, excluding federal holidays.
  • Clearance: Top Secret security clearance.
  • Operational Designation: Mission-essential support.
  • Travel: Government-approved travel within the continental United States may be required for technical support and contract activities.

Required Qualifications

  • Top Secret security clearance.
  • 5+ years of VoIP experience.
  • Cisco voice certification with a concentration on Cisco Unified Call Manager (CUCM) that includes the 350-801 Implementing and Operating Cisco Collaboration Core Technologies (CLCOR) exam.
  • Ability to perform onsite duties at Scott Air Force Base and meet applicable DoD workforce and privileged-access qualification requirements.

Job Expectations

  • Ability to configure, maintain, troubleshoot, patch, and enhance Cisco voice and collaboration systems.
  • Working capability with CUCM, Cisco Unity, Instant Message and Presence, teleconference bridges, and Ribbon VX900 devices.
  • Ability to develop and troubleshoot SIP connectivity involving Cisco Unified Border Elements, Session Border Controllers, and external customer voice networks.
  • Ability to support Network Engineering Tier 3 functions and follow laboratory testing, documentation, and configuration-control practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure, develop, maintain, and enhance the Cisco VoIP environment supporting EACN.
  • Apply patches and Security Technical Implementation Guides to supported voice systems.
  • Add and support approved capabilities within Call Manager, Cisco Unity, Instant Message and Presence, conferencing systems, and Ribbon VX900 devices.
  • Develop configurations and connection methods for Cisco Unified Border Elements, Session Border Controllers, and other SIP-enabled devices.
  • Establish and troubleshoot SIP connections between EACN and customer voice environments, including Call Manager Express, Survivable Remote Site Telephony, and other Cisco VoIP networks.
  • Perform or assist with Network Engineering Tier 3 activities, including complex troubleshooting and configuration support.
  • Validate applicable voice-related hardware, software, and configuration changes in the Systems Integration Lab before operational deployment.
  • Maintain technical and configuration documentation and support installation guides, configuration training, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Coordinate with Government engineers and gateway personnel to resolve service issues and sustain voice capabilities across the laboratory and operational environments.
