title: Applied Technology Instructor
description:
Key Responsibilities

Technical Instruction & Curriculum Delivery

  • Serve as the lead instructor for assigned technology and IT workforce development courses.
  • Deliver instructor-led, hands-on training in areas including computer hardware, software, operating systems, networking, troubleshooting, cybersecurity, systems administration, cloud technologies, and related applied technology disciplines.
  • Prepare participants for industry-recognized certifications, including CompTIA and other technology credentials incorporated into MyndBridge programming.
  • Facilitate laboratory exercises, simulations, technical projects, demonstrations, and problem-solving activities.
  • Connect classroom instruction to real-world IT environments, workflows, and workplace expectations.
  • Maintain organized lesson plans, instructional materials, assignments, assessments, and technical lab activities.
  • Collaborate with program leadership to continuously strengthen technology curriculum based on industry trends and employer needs.

Certification Preparation

  • Provide structured preparation for certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, and other approved credentials.
  • Assess student readiness for certification examinations and identify areas requiring additional instruction.
  • Conduct certification review sessions, practice examinations, technical labs, and remediation activities.
  • Monitor certification progress and provide targeted interventions for participants requiring additional support.
  • Reinforce test-taking strategies and technical terminology while ensuring students understand the underlying competencies rather than relying solely on exam preparation.

Tutoring & Academic Support

  • Provide individual and small-group tutoring to participants requiring additional technical support.
  • Identify skill gaps and develop individualized strategies to improve student performance.
  • Provide additional support with assignments, labs, certification preparation, and technical projects.
  • Adapt instructional approaches for students with different learning styles, educational backgrounds, and levels of technology exposure.
  • Maintain appropriate availability for student questions and instructional support outside scheduled classroom instruction.

Mentoring & Career Development

  • Serve as a mentor and positive professional role model for program participants.
  • Help students understand career pathways within information technology, cybersecurity, systems engineering, networking, cloud computing, technical support, and related industries.
  • Reinforce professional expectations including communication, accountability, problem-solving, teamwork, punctuality, and workplace professionalism.
  • Help participants connect their technical competencies to specific occupations and career opportunities.
  • Support participants in developing confidence, persistence, professional identity, and independent problem-solving skills.
  • Collaborate with workforce development and case management staff to support participants experiencing barriers to program completion.

Student Performance & Accountability

  • Monitor attendance, participation, academic progress, certification readiness, and overall student performance.
  • Maintain accurate and timely student records in designated organizational systems.
  • Provide regular progress updates to program leadership and appropriate case management staff.
  • Identify participants at risk of falling behind and initiate appropriate instructional interventions.
  • Participate in student progress meetings and contribute to individualized support plans when necessary.
  • Support organizational goals related to program completion, certification attainment, employment readiness, and job placement.

Technology Lab & Program Support

  • Assist with maintaining functional and organized technology labs and instructional environments.
  • Support the configuration and troubleshooting of computers, software, peripherals, networking equipment, virtual environments, and other instructional technology.
  • Help ensure equipment used for training reflects current industry practices whenever possible.
  • Maintain appropriate cybersecurity, data privacy, and equipment-use practices within instructional environments.
  • Recommend technology, software, equipment, and instructional resources that strengthen program delivery.

Required Qualifications

  • Professional background in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Network Engineering, Cybersecurity, Computer Engineering, Software/Hardware Support, or a related technical field.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of computer hardware, software, operating systems, networking, troubleshooting, and systems administration.
  • Working knowledge of CompTIA certification competencies, particularly A+, Network+, and/or Security+.
  • Ability to troubleshoot hardware, software, networking, and common systems issues.
  • Strong understanding of contemporary IT environments and technology career pathways.
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to learners with varying experience levels.
  • Strong communication, classroom management, coaching, and interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and motivate young adults and/or adult learners.
  • Ability to document student progress and work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary workforce development team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Current or previous CompTIA certifications such as A+, Network+, Security+, or equivalent industry credentials.
  • Certifications or experience with platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Cisco, Linux, or related technologies.
  • Experience in systems engineering, network administration, IT support, cybersecurity, cloud computing, or infrastructure.
  • Experience teaching technology, conducting corporate training, providing technical instruction, or facilitating workforce development programs.
  • Experience preparing students or employees for industry certification examinations.
  • Experience working with youth, young adults, career changers, or individuals from historically underserved communities.
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Education, or a related discipline preferred; equivalent professional experience and industry certifications will be considered.

Core Competencies

The successful candidate should demonstrate strong capabilities in:

  • Technical instruction and facilitation
  • Hardware and software troubleshooting
  • Networking and systems administration
  • Cybersecurity fundamentals
  • Systems engineering concepts
  • Certification preparation
  • Applied and project-based learning
  • Student tutoring and intervention
  • Mentorship and coaching
  • Classroom and laboratory management
  • Career pathway awareness
  • Documentation and student progress tracking
  • Communication and collaboration

Success Measures

Performance in this position will be evaluated based on student attendance and engagement, technical skill development, course completion, certification readiness and attainment, quality of instruction, student progress, instructional documentation, successful intervention with struggling participants, and contribution to participants' overall career readiness.

Role Philosophy

The Applied Technology Instructor is not simply responsible for teaching technology. The instructor is responsible for helping participants learn how to think, troubleshoot, adapt, and perform like technology professionals.

The goal is for every participant to leave the program with stronger technical competencies, recognized credentials where applicable, greater confidence, and a clearer pathway into employment, continued education, or advanced technology training.

title: Senior Agentic AI Engineer
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you'll be doing…

As a Senior Agentic AI Engineer within our team, you will be at the forefront of Verizon's transformation toward centralized intelligence and enterprise-grade AI agents that drive action. Our team manages a broad portfolio of business processes underpinned by analytics, and you will lead the evolution from reactive reporting to autonomous, intelligent execution. You will architect and deploy multi-agent systems capable of reasoning, planning, and collaborating across complex business domains—closing the loop between AI investment and measurable business outcomes.


Responsibilities include:


  • Architecting and deploying scalable multi-agent AI systems—designing agent workflows, communication protocols (A2A), and task delegation hierarchies for fleets of cooperative AI agents.
  • Integrating LLMs with enterprise systems via APIs, function calling, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to enable agents that can reason, plan, use tools, and act autonomously.
  • Building and operating enterprise Agent Factory pipelines—moving from reactive, episodic analytics to autonomous, continuously executing intelligent workflows.
  • Designing and implementing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems with ONNX-based embeddings and vector databases to power context-aware, hyper-personalized outputs at scale.
  • Managing agent memory and state architecture—implementing short-term, medium-term, and long-term memory using tools like LangGraph for reliable multi-step task execution.
  • Owning the full agent and model lifecycle: feature engineering, training, production deployment (Cloud Run, Vertex AI), and continuous monitoring with observability tooling.
  • Establishing security guardrails, permission boundaries, short-lived agent identity tokens, and safety constraints for production agentic systems.
  • Developing and maintaining propensity models, classification systems, and forecasting solutions that feed downstream agent decision-making.
  • Translating complex agentic AI outputs into clear operational strategies and presenting findings to senior leadership and cross-functional business partners.
  • Performing advanced AI-augmented analytics and generative AI model validation to ensure accuracy, reliability, and measurable business performance.

What we're looking for…


You are a senior AI engineer who has moved beyond building models into building agents—systems that reason, plan, and act. You have a strong foundation in data science and machine learning, and you've extended that into LLM orchestration, multi-agent architecture, and production agentic systems. You have the strategic vision to evaluate when an autonomous agent is the right solution, and the communication skills to explain complex, probabilistic AI behaviors clearly to executive, security, and business stakeholders.


You'll need to have:

  • Bachelor's degree or four or more years of work experience.
  • Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
  • Four or more years of relevant work experience, with two or more years focused specifically on Generative AI, LLMs, and autonomous agent systems.
  • Four or more years of experience developing and implementing analytical or AI solutions to complex business problems.
  • Hands-on proficiency with multi-agent orchestration frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, Google Agent Development Kit (ADK), LlamaIndex, or AutoGen.
  • Experience designing agent-to-agent (A2A) communication protocols, task delegation hierarchies, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for enterprise tool integration.
  • Experience with agent memory and state management: short-term context, long-term storage, context window optimization, and stateful workflow execution.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), ONNX-based embeddings, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector), and semantic search.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of cloud-scale data engineering: BigQuery pipelines and GCP (Cloud Run, Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock, or Azure equivalent).
  • Experience with Python and SQL for statistical modeling, prompt engineering, token management, and large-scale data extraction.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • A Master's degree in a quantitative discipline such as Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or Operations Research.
  • Familiarity with ML/LLM monitoring and observability tooling (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Arize Phoenix, Galileo) for tracking model drift, accuracy degradation, and agent output quality over time.
  • Experience with generative AI-augmented analytics: AI testing frameworks, model validation pipelines, and LLMOps tooling including observability and token management.
  • Experience with AI governance, security, compliance, and financial ROI modeling for AI agent deployments.
  • Domain expertise in customer, churn prediction, customer lifetime value (CLV) modeling, or related commercial analytics in Consumer, Telecommunications, Financial Services, or Technology industries.
  • A passion for educating and communicating AI findings with integrity to all levels—from reviewing raw outputs with colleagues to presenting AI strategy and business impact to executive stakeholders.
  • High curiosity, an investigative mindset, and the flexibility to adapt to new challenges while staying focused on the team's deliverables.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits and Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

Reporting to the Supervisor, Building Inspections, the Building Inspector is responsible for inspecting construction at selected stages to ensure conformity with approved drawings, specifications, building codes, building permit by-law and other relevant legislation or policies, and ensuring that unauthorized construction is not taking place and applicable legislation is not being contravened.

You will work across the full technology stack, creating intuitive web applications and the scalable backend services, APIs, and data models that power them. You will take ownership of significant technical areas, from understanding user needs and shaping solutions through to implementation, deployment, observability, and production support.

This is a hands-on engineering role with meaningful technical leadership responsibilities. You will influence technical decisions within the team, establish effective design patterns, contribute to architectural direction, and help engineers make sound technical choices. You will mentor less-experienced engineers through design discussions, code reviews, pairing, and day-to-day collaboration while continuing to write and deliver high-quality production code.

Challenges you will own

Deliver end-to-end platform capabilities

Design and deliver applications that make complex model-development workflows easier to manage—from experiment scheduling and evaluation to on-road testing. Work closely with users to understand their needs, shape pragmatic solutions, and own features from initial design through deployment and continuous improvement.

Build scalable, secure, reliable, and performant services

Build and operate production web applications, APIs, and backend services that perform reliably as usage and complexity grow. Apply sound security practices, identify bottlenecks and failure modes, and use testing, observability, and performance analysis to continuously improve the systems you own.

Shape system design and technical direction

Lead the design of significant features and services, making thoughtful trade-offs between delivery speed, scalability, security, operational simplicity, and maintainability. Contribute to design reviews and establish reusable patterns that help the team build coherent, well-integrated systems.

At the Staff level, you will also guide broader architectural decisions, align approaches across teams, and lead complex, multi-quarter technical initiatives.

Lead through hands-on contribution

Remain actively involved in implementation while helping others make strong technical decisions. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through design discussions, code reviews, pairing, and practical guidance.

Cross-functional collaboration

Partner closely with Product Management, Research, Operations, Design, and other engineering teams to understand user needs and deliver effective solutions. Communicate technical decisions and trade-offs clearly, build alignment between stakeholders, and ensure platform capabilities work coherently across team and system boundaries.

What we are looking for

Essential

  • Full-stack engineering – Strong experience designing, building, and operating production web applications across frontend and backend systems. Experience with modern technologies such as React, TypeScript, Python, Flask, or FastAPI—or comparable frameworks and languages.
  • Production system design – A strong understanding of system design, API design, data modeling, asynchronous workflows, automated testing, and distributed-system fundamentals. Experience building services that are scalable, secure, reliable, observable, and performant.
  • End-to-end ownership – A track record of taking significant features or services from problem definition and technical design through implementation, deployment, and production operation.
  • Technical leadership and mentorship – Experience leading technical discussions, influencing engineering decisions, establishing effective design patterns, and supporting other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, pairing, and practical guidance.
  • Collaborative problem-solving – The ability to work effectively with engineering, product, research, and operational stakeholders, translating complex requirements into practical solutions and communicating technical decisions and trade-offs clearly.

Desirable

  • Developer or ML Platforms – Experience building internal platforms, developer tools, workflow systems, or applications used by machine-learning researchers and engineers.
  • ML Operations and Experimentation – Familiarity with model training, evaluation, experiment tracking, artifact management, or related model-development workflows.
  • Data and Workflow Systems – Experience with data pipelines, distributed job orchestration, event-driven architectures, or large-scale compute platforms.
  • Platform Observability – Experience defining service-level indicators and objectives and using metrics, logs, traces, and alerting to improve production reliability.
  • Security and Data Governance – Knowledge of privacy, compliance, access control, auditability, and secure handling of sensitive or large-scale data.
  • Domain Experience – Previous experience with autonomous systems, robotics, simulation, or another safety-critical domain.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer - South Bank, QLD
description:
At Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG) our purpose is to'open up the world for those who want to see'. Every day, we give people all around the world the opportunity to experience something amazing – travel!

We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help us build and scale a travel platform relied on by some of Australia's largest corporate operators. It's a full stack role for someone who genuinely enjoys the hard problems: complex, high availability systems that process high volume travel booking at scale, end to end, from backend services through to the interfaces people rely on every day.

You’ll be a key technical contributor on capabilities that matter, the kind of work that shapes how thousands of travellers experience booking, changing, and managing their trips. You won't be maintaining someone else's legacy code in isolation; you’ll be designing and building new capability from the ground up, including change and cancellation support, waitlist management, and deep policy engine integration, then owning it end to end in production. This is a chance to make decisions that stick: the architecture you choose, the standards you set, and the patterns you introduce will shape how the platform evolves for years to come.

Day to day

Core Backend Development

  • Design, build, and own complex backend services and APIs using Java (Spring Boot), with a strong focus on reliability, performance, and correctness
  • Deliver new modules including: change and cancellation processing, waitlist capability, and policy engine integration across the travel platform
  • Implement and consume RESTful APIs and SOAP/Web Services that integrate with airline GDS systems, internal booking engines, and third party travel platforms
  • Build robust, fault tolerant service components capable of handling high volume, time critical travel booking

Frontend Development

  • Design and build responsive, accessible user interfaces in React that give travel bookers and administrators a clear, reliable view into complex processes
  • Own end to end feature delivery: from API design through to the React components and state management that consume them
  • Work with component libraries and design systems to keep the UI consistent, maintainable, and easy to extend
  • Optimise frontend performance (load times, rendering, bundle size) for users working in time critical, high pressure booking scenarios

System Reliability & Observability

  • Ensure the platform maintains high uptime, this is a mission critical system for travel operations; downtime has direct operational impact
  • Instrument services with Datadog, including APM tracing, custom metrics, log correlation, and dashboard creation to provide full observability across the travel booking stack, frontend and backend
  • Define and monitor SLOs/SLIs, respond to incidents, and lead post incident reviews to drive continuous reliability improvement
  • Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, memory issues, and degradation patterns before they impact customers

Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Lead technical design for new capabilities, producing clear architecture and API design documentation before implementation
  • Conduct rigorous code reviews and hold the team to high standards for API design, exception handling, test coverage, component quality, and service contract quality
  • Identify and reduce technical debt, particularly around legacy integration patterns, file based data exchange, and monolithic components

DevOps & Delivery

title: Managing Consultant – Data Engineer | Adelaide

description:

A great career is closer than you think. Come work for the City of Burlington, where you'll be joining an innovative and progressive workplace focused on building a 21st century city that respects the diversity of our residents, visitors and employees; and prioritizes continuous opportunities for you to learn and grow.

We don't just spend time attracting the best talent. We spend time and resources to keep the best talent. This may include: flexible working hours, mobile and hybrid working arrangements, a great pension and benefits package, as well as programs to foster innovation and leadership.

Existing Vacancy

Information Technology

Location

This position is eligible for a hybrid work model. When attending an event or meeting in person, your primary office location will be based out of 390 Brant Street Burlington Ontario – Sims Square. Work location is subject to change at the discretion of the City due to operational demands. Effective September 2027, this role will be required to be on site 50% of the time each month.

Position Overview

The Product Manager, Information Technology, Strategic Portfolio is a senior strategic role reporting to the Director/Chief Information Officer and working across the Information Technology division to help shape priorities, advance strategy and drive coordinated execution.

The successful candidate will be a strategic thinker and strong operator who can move comfortably between executive-level strategy and detailed execution, bringing together people, priorities, governance, financial information, performance measures and decision-making across IT.

The role serves as a central point of coordination for major divisional priorities, helping translate strategy into actionable plans, maintain momentum across complex initiatives, identify risks and dependencies and provide the CIO and IT leadership team with the analysis, insight and visibility needed to make informed decisions. Key areas of focus include portfolio and intake management, Application Portfolio Management, technology cost modelling, digital governance, performance and value reporting, executive decision support and other strategic priorities as they emerge.

Responsibilities

This position will be responsible for:

  • Providing senior-level support to the Director, Information Technology through the delivery of strategic product and portfolio initiatives such as Application Portfolio Management (APM), technology cost modelling, portfolio intake, and digital governance.
  • Leading the planning, implementation, and continuous improvement of digital products, with a focus on driving adoption, alignment with business priorities, and measurable value.
  • Developing and maintaining enterprise product roadmaps in collaboration with internal stakeholders and external vendors, ensuring alignment with departmental strategies and corporate objectives.
  • Supporting the design, implementation, and evolution of an IT cost model to increase transparency, inform decision-making, and optimize digital investments across the organization.
  • Leading and continuously improving the department-wide intake and portfolio management process, ensuring technology requests are assessed, prioritized, governed, and advanced in alignment with strategic priorities, capacity, and organizational value.
  • Coordinating cross-functional teams and vendor partners using Agile principles (Scrum or Kanban) to ensure successful delivery of digital solutions and enhancements.
  • Managing vendor relationships, including contract development, performance evaluation, issue resolution, and alignment of vendor deliverables with enterprise objectives.
  • Supporting change management, communication, and training activities related to product implementations, ensuring strong adoption and user satisfaction.
  • Collaborating with senior leaders across departments to identify and evaluate opportunities to leverage technology products in support of business transformation.
  • Monitoring, analyzing, and reporting on product performance and value realization to senior leadership, and making recommendations for course correction where necessary.
  • Preparing business cases, presentations, and reports for executive audiences, providing insight into product impact, portfolio health, and strategic alignment.

Requirements

  • A university degree in business administration, public administration, computer science, or a related discipline. A graduate degree or formal training in digital strategy, innovation, or enterprise architecture is considered an asset.
  • Certification in Project Management Professional (PMP), PMI-Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) are considered an asset.
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience leading the delivery of digital products, platforms, or strategic technology initiatives, preferably in a public sector or complex organizational environment.
  • Demonstrated experience in product management, portfolio or program management, and working with both Agile and traditional delivery methods to advance strategic priorities including delivering cross-organizational solutions.
  • Proven ability to work closely with executive leadership, providing analysis, insights, and recommendations that shape technology investments and product roadmaps.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise IT environments and experience working with a range of digital platforms or technologies such as Microsoft Power Platform, Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM), GIS, Workday, AMANDA, ServiceNow, or equivalent.
  • Experience supporting IT financial frameworks such as cost models, total cost of ownership analysis, or business case development to guide prioritization and investment decisions.
  • Knowledge of change management strategies, user adoption practices, and training and communication planning for successful implementation of digital solutions.
  • Experience in a municipal or broader public-sector environment is preferred.

Additional Information

Please note: If you previously applied to the Product Manager posting, you do not need to reapply. Your previous application will continue to be considered for this recruitment.

title: IT Lead
description:
ClassDojo's goal is to give every child on Earth an education they love.

We started by building a powerful network for communication. ClassDojo’s flagship app is the #1 communication app connecting K-12 teachers, children, and families globally. Teachers use it to share what’s happening throughout the day through photos, videos, and messages that make parents feel like they’re there. It’s actively used in over 95% of US schools, reaching over 45 million children in 180 countries, with a team of just around 200 people [1]. We are now beginning to use this network to give kids the best learning experiences in the world, far beyond those a standard school can provide.

We hire for talent density. Our team comprises the most talented, entrepreneurial, and innovative teammates from around the world, with experience in education and large scale consumer internet companies, including Instagram, Netflix, Dropbox, Stripe, Uber, Y Combinator, and more. We’re building a company where the most talented people want to work. We believe you’ll do the best work of your life here—and you’ll pioneer the future of education, too.

As IT Lead you are ClassDojo's IT function; owner & operator, reporting to the CTO, covering identity, devices, SaaS, security operations, vendors, and our AI platforms for roughly 350 people.

The function already runs on automation and AI-assisted triage rather than effort. You inherit it with a documented handover, keep it efficient, make it your's, make it better, and make it legible to people who are not you.

What you’ll do:

  • Own identity and the employee lifecycle: Okta, Google Workspace, and an HRIS-driven pipeline where access changes fire automatically with an audit trail the systems produce.

  • Own a Mac-first MDM fleet at near-100% coverage, passwordless authentication at 100%, and assist response on security incidents.

  • Run and own IT operations end to end: onboarding, offboarding, support, and the AI triage and self-service that handle most of it, treating repeat request as a defect to remove.

  • Govern a 50+ tool SaaS stack, the IT budget and vendors.

  • Apply governance for Claude and ChatGPT accounts, use AI and automation to take manual work out of IT.

  • Keep IT-owned SOC 2 controls audit-ready with evidence that comes from the systems.

You will be a match if:

  • You have owned and operated IT alone at 200+ staff, including identity in Okta, Google Workspace, and Slack, and a HRIS-driven lifecycle that ran unattended.

  • You have owned a production Mac fleet under MDM, including a migration or baseline rebuild

  • You have administered ChatGPT and Claude (or comparable) for a company, use them daily, and have built automations that replaced manual IT work with a measurable result.

  • You automate by default: script, API, log, admin console, and you can automate entire request categories.

  • You have practical security judgment and have worked inside a SOC 2 environment.

  • You support people directly and well, and can quote your own support numbers.

  • You write documentation people follow and explain technical decisions to executives in two sentences.

  • You have an ownership mindset and do not wait for perfect requirements or handoffs.

  • You live in the US, East or West Coast, and can travel to San Francisco.

Bonus - You have experience with:

  • AWS IAM Identity Center and Terraform, or other config-as-code you could apply to Okta and Google.

  • Office buildouts, BYOD policy rollouts, international contractors, Windows and ChromeOS

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
As Lead Data Engineer at Superscript, you’ll be the technical and strategic owner of our data platform, the foundation that powers everything from business intelligence and underwriting models to machine learning predictions and data products.

You’ll define and drive the evolution of our modern data ecosystem to ensure it’s robust, scalable, and efficient. Working closely with stakeholders across Data, Tech, and the wider business, you’ll lead the design and delivery of data solutions that underpin our ability to understand and serve customers, manage risk intelligently, and make data-driven decisions at scale.

You’ll also act as a mentor and technical leader within the team, up-skilling others, setting engineering standards, and ensuring our data capabilities continue to be a strategic differentiator for Superscript.

What you'll get up to:

Define the architectural vision for Superscript’s data platform, ensuring it scales with our business and supports diverse use cases including BI, ML, and real-time analytics.

Write and review high-quality, production-grade code in Python, SQL, and IaC (Terraform) that sets the standard for engineering excellence.

Design and deliver end-to-end data pipelines.

Optimise performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency across all data workflows and systems.

Lead development of Superscript’s MLOps capabilities, ensuring seamless model deployment, monitoring, and feedback loops.

Own and improve data quality frameworks and observability to ensure trust in business-critical data assets.

Produce detailed technical documentation accessible to both technical and non-technical stakeholder s.

Lead complex, high-impact data initiatives from concept through to delivery, including scoping, architecture, resource planning, and execution.

Anticipate risks, identify dependencies, and clearly communicate trade-offs between speed, quality, and business impact.

Drive platform automation and resilience, ensuring rapid, reliable delivery of new data features and models.

Lead, coach and support Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers, creating an environment where individuals can grow in confidence, capability and impact.

Provide structured feedback and guidance through code reviews, pair programming, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Collaborate with Product Managers, Analysts, and stakeholders to design impactful data products that advance business goals.

Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous improvement, and technical curiosity within the data functio n.

About you:

Deep understanding of modern data architectures (data lakehouse, event-driven pipelines, and orchestration systems).

Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and IaC (Terraform).

Experience using dbt, Snowflake, AWS, orchestration tool like Prefect.

Experienced in building and maintaining batch and streaming data pipelines at scale.

Skilled in managing and optimising cloud infrastructure for cost and performance.

Knowledge of CI/CD, testing frameworks, version control (Git), and containerisation (Docker/Kubernetes).

Strong background in data modelling, warehousing, and supporting analytical and ML workloads.

Exposure to MLOps tools including MLFlow, kedro and Amazon Sagemaker.

Development and maintenance of real time products like APIs using FastAPI/Flask.

Operates autonomously with strong ownership and accountability.

Strategic thinker who balances immediate delivery with long-term platform evolution.

Excellent communicator who can bridge technical and business domains.

Collaborative leader who uplifts others through mentorship, clarity, and support.

Passionate about continuous improvement, technical excellence, and innovation in data engineering.

A competitive salary and the ability to grow your career

25 days holiday - so there’s plenty of time for work, rest and play

Hybrid way of working for the perfect work / life balance

Added benefits including competitive pension and salary sacrifice

title: Rotational Management Program Trainee
description:
About the Role

Gap, Old Navy, Banana Republic, Athleta - Four brands, one place to start. Gap Inc.'s Rotational Management Program (RMP) fuels the next generation of innovators redefining the retail experience: an 18-month immersive journey built to catapult emerging talent who are curious about how global brands thrive, passionate about customers, and energized by innovation. Throughout the program, you’ll gain cross-functional experience and exposure across Product, Merchandising, Planning, Inventory and Pricing, building an understanding of how product, customer insights, inventory, and data come together to drive the business. Along the way, you’ll build AI literacy, adaptability, and leadership capabilities to excel in a rapidly evolving retail landscape. You won't watch it happen. You'll help make the call.

RMP is your canvas, where curiosity, creativity, and product obsession turn into possibility. Whether it's forecasting demand, curating assortments, or spotting trends before they hit, you'll be learning to lead from day one. Where you grow from here is something we shape together, guided by where the business needs strength, what you're great at, and the work that pulls you in. The point of starting here is how many doors it opens.

What You'll Do

  • AI fluency and judgment. Put AI and data to work, spotting what's coming, forecasting demand, and sharpening decisions. Then bring the judgment to know when it's right, when it isn't, and when it meets our standards.
  • Analytical thinking. Dig into the data and the retail math. Model the scenarios, pressure-test the thinking, and turn a messy problem into a recommendation bold enough to act on.
  • Commercial instinct. Notice what's catching on, ask why it's working, and start connecting the dots between a trend and what it could mean for the business.
  • Turning insight into action. Cut through the noise to the "so what," shape it into a clear, decision-ready recommendation, and make the case simply enough that people can act on it.
  • Product and customer obsession. Put the customer at the center. Anticipate what they'll want, understand why it matters, and shape products and experiences that blend human instinct with data-driven insight.
  • Collaboration and influence. Build trust and accountability across diverse teams, earning influence through partnership rather than position. Bring together creativity, strategy, and operations to drive aligned decisions and meaningful business outcomes.
  • Learning agility. Navigate ambiguity with agility: move across different kinds of work, pick things up fast, and pivot when the plan changes. Stay curious, keep growing, and start learning what it means to lead responsibly.

Salary range is $73,000-$75,000

Employee pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, competencies and work location. We will meet minimum wage or minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county and state requirements.


Who You Are

  • Completing a bachelor's degree by June 2027 and passionate about fashion, retail, and shaping what's next.
  • Curious, adaptable, and energized by change. You embrace feedback, learn quickly, and thrive in ambiguity.
  • Customer and commercially minded. You connect consumer insights, product decisions, and business outcomes.
  • AI-enabled and future-focused. You use emerging technologies to accelerate your thinking while trusting your own judgment.
  • Collaborative and resilient. You build trust across teams, navigate complexity with confidence, and bring others along.

PROGRAM REQUIREMENTS

  • Retail experience is a plus, but curiosity, resilience, and potential matter most.
  • This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.
  • The program is based in San Francisco and New York City, with most roles located in San Francisco. Participants must be willing to relocate to their assigned location.
  • Qualified applicants may be required to complete a timed assessment within 7 days of applying.

You'll grow fast here — and learn what it means to lead well in a world being reshaped by AI.


Sound like you? We'd love to meet you.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and reliable Consultant to join our Cyber Security Operations team. In this role, you will primarily work after-hours shifts to complete day-to-day operational work, create and revise critical operational documentation, and continuously review security events. You will serve as support for the Executive Relations Team and act as a frontline monitor responsible for alerting leadership immediately if a critical security issue arises. This position requires scheduled after-hours, weekend, and holiday coverage.


Key Responsibilities

  • After-Hours Operations & Monitoring: Complete core operational workflows and maintain continuous system and threat monitoring during after-hours, weekend, and holiday coverage windows.
  • Security Event Review & Critical Escalation: Monitor and review daily security events and operational logs. Immediately alert security leadership and relevant stakeholders upon identifying critical security issues, high-severity threats, or system anomalies.
  • Executive Relations & Account Support: Support the Executive Relations Team with sensitive account requests and high-visibility escalations. Assist with account lock removals and account protection mechanisms, including SIM locks and port freezes.
  • Documentation & Revision: Create, revise, and maintain operational documentation and conduct tasks related to account enrollment and de-enrollment processes.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner effectively with internal operational teams, Cyber Security, Corporate Security, and technical teams to route and resolve routine security escalations.
  • Process Improvements: Identify opportunities to improve processes in the program operations, account security, and customer experience including ways to leverage AI to reduce unnecessary manual work.

This position can be located in other valid Verizon locations.


What we’re looking for...


You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
  • Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience.
  • Flexibility to work after-hours, weekend, and holiday shifts as part of primary coverage.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for creating clear documentation and issuing timely alerts.
  • Basic understanding of wireless/wireline communications, account servicing processes, account security principles and VCG and VBG operational structure.

  • Document Control & Detail Orientation: Demonstrated ability to draft, edit, and organize technical or operational documentation under minimal supervision.
  • Incident Handling & Escalation: Prior exposure to monitoring systems and escalating critical security or operational incidents to leadership teams.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

40

title: Materials Management Associate II
description:

title: Sr. Manager, Product Manager
description:
We are proud to be the only company covering the spectrum of residential storage and organization needs, from high-end, dealer-supplied custom solutions to do-it-yourself storage systems available online and in retail stores. Our organization systems are marketed under the Inspired Closets, ORG Home, Gorgeous Garage, ProClosets, EasyClosets, EasyGarage, Easy Track, and Garage Essentials brand names.

The Stow Company is currently seeking qualified candidates for a Sr. Manager, Product Management located in Holland, MI. We are the country’s premier source for custom closets and organizational solutions; designed, custom-cut, and shipped directly to our clients.

Primary Purpose of Position:

The Sr. Manager, Product Management, is accountable for Stow's product roadmap — optimizing across revenue growth, cost savings, operational efficiency, and customer intimacy to shape what Stow's physical and digital product offerings become next across our dealer, direct-to-consumer, and retail channels. Reporting to the Vice President of Brand Management, this role bridges where Product is headed and how it gets there day-to-day: building the systems, documentation, and team capability that let Product operate with rigor and executional excellence.

This is a hands-on, high-visibility, working-leader role. Beyond leading the product team, the Sr. Manager is expected to build trust across the organization — with Operations, Sales, Marketing, IT, Program Management, and executive leadership — and to bring forward clear, data-informed recommendations that connect product decisions to business outcomes.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Customer Insight

  • Own the product roadmap across Stow's channels, translating market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape into recommended prioritized initiatives.
  • Build detailed business cases for major initiatives — technical requirements, revenue projections, and ROI — to align product direction with company priorities.
  • Identify and evaluate new product and partnership opportunities, translating them into marketable concepts.

Team Leadership & Systems Building

  • Lead and develop the product management and product development team, building the technical and leadership skills the team needs to scale.
  • Create the systems, documentation, and repeatable processes that let Product operate with rigor instead of reacting project to project — including root-causing recurring execution issues
  • Diagnose resourcing and process gaps using data, not just intuition.
  • Anchor the team's day-to-day work in org priorities, keeping the focus on impact over activity.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Build strong, proactive partnerships and trust with Operations, IT, Marketing, Sales, and Program Management to drive shared solutions across department boundaries.
  • Represent Product in cross-functional planning and project reviews, and own the follow-through on commitments made.
  • Partner with Program Management to ensure work is clearly scoped, documented, and ready for execution before it reaches the team.

Executive Engagement & Business Judgment

  • Maintain a direct line to executive leadership on product plans, metrics, and roadmap progress.
  • Bring forward clear, well-reasoned recommendations, and manage confidently through follow-up questions and pushback.
  • Connect product decisions explicitly to business outcomes (revenue, margin, customer intimacy) when presenting to leadership.

Financial Acumen & Pricing Strategy

  • Partner with Finance to shape product pricing recommendations, lifecycle management, and profitability analysis.
  • Ensure product decisions balance market competitiveness with Stow's financial goals.

Other

  • Lives Company values on a daily basis.
  • Poses no direct threat to the health or safety of themselves, of others, or to property. Defined as a significant risk of substantial harm that cannot be eliminated or reduced to an acceptable level by reasonable accommodation.
  • Requires regular attendance to perform essential elements as contained herein between the assigned start and end times for work.
  • Establishes and maintains effective work relationships within the department, the Corporation and the community; and maintains the professional competence, knowledge and skill necessary for the satisfactory performance of all assigned responsibilities

The Stow Company may temporarily assign any team member with duties outside of their normal responsibilities. Such assignments may be warranted due to a variety of specific requirements, conditions and/or the capabilities of available personnel. Management will determine the nature and duration of those assignments.

  • SAP ERP experience preferred

    • Track record of building trust and driving outcomes across functions without direct authority.

In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing...

We are seeking a Senior Manager in Cyber Security to drive high-impact data investigations and operational threat mitigation. Building on core threat analysis and project management capabilities, this role requires hands-on technical ability in database querying and log analysis. You will monitor data and perform deep-dive investigations into wireline and wireless accounts and systems. You will handle highly sensitive data, address urgent investigations, and translate technical insights into clear executive briefings and security solutions. This position will require some scheduled and unscheduled after hours, weekend, and holiday coverage.


Key Responsibilities

  • Deep-Dive Investigation & Root Cause Analysis: Conduct root-cause investigations into operational failures, security events, and complex fraud schemes involving wireline/wireless architectures.
  • Account Support & Communication: Partner closely with the Executive Relations Team to provide security support for sensitive account requests and manage urgent, high-visibility escalations. Provide oversight of account lock removal and account protections including SIM lock and port freeze.
  • Technical Threat Hunting & Log Analysis: Leverage Splunk and enterprise tools to analyze log data, build custom searches, track advanced threat patterns, and detect subtle system anomalies.
  • Database Querying & Analysis: Write, optimize, and execute SQL queries across platforms such as SQL Server, Teradata, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to extract and synthesize raw data.
  • Data & Pattern Analysis: Review daily security events to identify suspicious internal or external threat actor behavior. Analyze large sets of operational and sensitive data to spot trends, establish baselines, and detect subtle outliers or emerging threats.
  • Project & Work Stream Management: Simultaneously manage multiple complex projects and investigative work streams, ensuring timely deliverables and operational compliance.
  • Process & System Adaptation: Continually adapt to rapid changes in systems, operational processes, data structures, and the broader threat landscape including identifying ways to implement AI into daily operations.

This position can be located in other valid Verizon locations.


What we’re looking for...


You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
  • Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
  • Hands-on experience writing and executing SQL queries in production environments.
  • Solid understanding of wireless and wireline systems, operational workflows, and account security.
  • Proven experience in fraud detection, security, risk management, or threat operations.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze unstructured operational data, recognize patterns, and isolate system outliers.
  • Strong ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, manage competing priorities, and build trust across diverse teams.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • SIEM / Log Analytics Experience: Proficiency in Splunk for data extraction, log monitoring, and anomaly detection.
  • Project Leadership: Strong background in managing multiple technical work streams, project deadlines, and cross-functional technical relationships.
  • Analytical & Communication Mastery: Proven track record of turning complex technical findings into clear root-cause analyses and executive-level presentations.
  • Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with proven experience writing formal executive summaries under tight deadlines.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits and Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

description:
Who We Are

AMPAM is a leading Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) contractor serving large-scale multifamily and commercial projects across California and Arizona. With 1,500 employees across multiple business units, we are committed to delivering quality, safety, and excellence in every project.

Job Summary

Skilled Wireman is responsible for the safe installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of electrical wiring systems and associated components on commercial, industrial, and/or residential projects. This role requires strong technical ability in electrical systems, adherence to electrical codes, and the capability to interpret blueprints and technical drawings while ensuring work is completed to high standards of safety, quality, and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities Include: (But not limited to the following)

Electrical Installation & Maintenance

  • Install, connect, test, and maintain electrical wiring, conduits, fixtures, control devices, panelboards, and circuit protection equipment.
  • Route and pull electrical conductors and cables through conduit, walls, ceilings, and raceways.
  • Terminate and connect wires to electrical devices, switchgear, and control panels.
  • Install and configure lighting systems, receptacles, switches, motors, and other electrical components.

Troubleshooting & Repairs

  • Diagnose and repair electrical malfunctions using diagnostic tools (multimeters, testers, etc.).
  • Resolve complex wiring and electrical system issues in a timely manner.
  • Perform preventive maintenance to reduce system downtime.

Code Compliance & Safety

  • Ensure compliance with National Electrical Code (NEC), local electrical codes, and safety standards.
  • Follow OSHA, company safety policies, and industry best practices.
  • Maintain site cleanliness and safe working conditions.

Documentation & Communication

  • Interpret blueprints, schematics, and job specifications to plan and execute work.
  • Maintain accurate records of work performed (daily logs, reports).
  • Communicate effectively with supervisors, project managers, inspectors, and other trades.

Teamwork & Professionalism

  • Work independently or as part of a multi-discipline crew.
  • Mentor and guide junior technicians or apprentices when needed.
  • Participate in safety meetings and ongoing training.

Qualifications

Education & Certification

  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Completion of a recognized electrical apprenticeship program or equivalent experience.
  • Valid California Electrician’s Certification, Journeyman Wireman card, or equivalent (as required).
  • Class C California Driver’s License (preferred).

Experience

  • Minimum of 3–5 years' experience as a wireman/electrician in commercial, industrial, or residential work.
  • Demonstrated experience with conduit bending, cable pulling, terminations, and panel work.

Skills & Competencies

  • Proficient in reading blueprints, schematics, and technical manuals.
  • Strong diagnostic and problem-solving abilities.
  • Knowledge of NEC and applicable local codes.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
  • Ability to work at heights, in confined spaces, and lift equipment as needed.

title: Senior Consultant – Data Engineer | Melbourne
description:
Build modern data solutions and take greater ownership of client delivery.

We’re looking for a Senior Data Engineerwho combines strong technical foundations with the confidence to work directly with clients and help turn complex requirements into practical, scalable solutions.

This is a hands‑on consulting role for someone who wants to stay close to the technology while taking greater ownership across delivery, client engagement and solution design. You’ll work across modern data and analytics projects, contribute throughout the full delivery lifecycle, and build experience across a range of platforms, industries and client environments.

If you’re ready to broaden your technical exposure, strengthen your consulting capability and have more influence over how solutions are shaped and delivered, this could be a great next step.

What you’ll do

You’ll work alongside clients and Altis teams to understand business challenges, shape the right technical approach and deliver high-quality data and analytics solutions.

You’ll:

  • Deliver Data & Analytics solutions from discovery and requirements through to implementation and support
  • Work directly with clients to understand business needs and translate them into practical technical solutions
  • Contribute to workshops, solution design sessions and technical reviews
  • Design and build data pipelines, data models, database structures and data stores
  • Integrate and analyse data from multiple sources to support reporting, analytics and decision‑making
  • Develop reports, dashboards, visualisations and actionable insights
  • Apply strong SQL, data modelling and engineering practices across client projects
  • Support testing, deployment, User Acceptance Testing and post‑production activities
  • Contribute to project planning, estimation and delivery scheduling
  • Take ownership of your work while supporting and sharing knowledge with others
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders
  • Help clients successfully adopt the solutions we deliver through training and knowledge transfer

The experience you’ll bring

We’re looking for someone with strong Data & Analytics foundations, hands‑on delivery experience, and the confidence to contribute meaningfully in a client environment.

Your experience may include:

  • Data & Analytics solution delivery
  • Strong SQL capability
  • Data modelling and database design
  • Data integration and modern ETL/ELT approaches
  • Data pipeline development
  • Experience with cloud technologies, such as Snowflake, Databricks and/or Google Cloud
  • Reporting, analytics and visualisation solutions
  • Translating business requirements into technical solutions
  • Working directly with clients or business stakeholders
  • Testing, implementation and production support

You don’t need to have worked with every technology we use. We’re more interested in strong technical foundations, sound judgement and your ability to learn and adapt across different client environments.

Why Altis?

For more than 25 years, Altis has focused on one thing: helping organisations create better outcomes through data.

We're Australian-owned and technology‑agnostic, which means our consultants can focus on solving the right problem rather than selling a particular platform.

At Altis you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work across varied and challenging Data & AI engagements
  • Learn from experienced specialists across consulting, engineering, analytics and AI
  • Build your capability through ongoing learning and career development
  • Work in a collaborative environment where you're encouraged to challenge ideas and contribute your own
  • Work flexibly through our hybrid model
  • Access health and wellbeing support for you and your family
  • Access paid parental leave and our reward and recognition program

Our values — Be Curious, Own It, Lead with Heart and Discover a Way — shape how we work with our clients and with each other.

Your next move doesn't need to tick every box

If the role sounds like the direction you want your career to take but you don't meet every requirement listed, we'd still encourage you to apply.

Different experiences and perspectives make our teams stronger.

If you need adjustments or support at any stage of our recruitment process, let our Talent Acquisition team know and we'll work with you.

Ready to see your career differently? We'd love to hear from you.

title: Manager, Product Design (m/f/d)
description:
ABOUT US:

Sportradar is the world's leading sports technology company, creating immersive experiences at the intersection of sports, betting, and entertainment. Every day, our products engage millions of sports fans and players around the globe.

We are looking for a Product Design Manager to join our AV Fan Engagement team and help shape engaging digital experiences for sports fans. You will work across a diverse portfolio of sports products and platforms from OTT streaming experiences on Web, Mobile and TV to interactive fan engagement features including sports betting.

THE CHALLENGE:

We are looking for an experienced product designer who combines strategic thinking, design leadership and also supports with hands-on craft if needed.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Product Leadership from the earliest ideation phase to shape new concepts and ensure creative excellence throughout the entire product lifecycle from concept to launch and beyond.
  • Provide creative leadership, mentoring, and coaching to designers fostering a shared creative culture and continuously raising the quality bar.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering, Commercial, Marketing, external development partners, and other Sportradar business units to transform product ideas into compelling user experiences.
  • Continuously improve creative processes, collaboration models, and design workflows across distributed teams.
  • Stay ahead of trends in sports betting and streaming to continuously evolve our products and creative direction.
  • Explore and apply AI-powered tools and emerging technologies to improve both product experiences and the way we design.

ABOUT YOU:

  • 6+ years of experience in Product / UX / UI Design, ideally working on complex digital products.
  • Significant experience designing digital products, with a strong portfolio demonstrating product thinking, prototyping, and excellent design craft.
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coaching creative professionals in an international and cross-functional environment.
  • Passion for sports entertainment, innovation, and creating memorable user experiences.
  • The ability to connect design decisions to user needs, product goals and business outcomes.
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, including the ability to explain complex ideas clearly.
  • Fluent written and spoken English.
  • Curiosity about AI tools and how they are changing product design and the way teams work.

OUR OFFER:

  • Shape product direction and take ownership of the visual direction
  • Create products that combine the worlds of sports, betting, and interactive
  • entertainment for millions of users worldwide.
  • Collaborate with talented colleagues across multiple international studios and disciplines in a highly collaborative environment.
  • A challenging, rewarding, and creative environment where your ideas have a direct impact on products used around the globe.
  • Competitive salary and attractive benefits package.
  • Flexible hybrid working model built on trust and autonomy.
  • Individual learning and professional development opportunities.
  • A vibrant, inclusive company culture with global collaboration and diverse communities.
  • Corporate fitness activities and additional employee wellbeing programs.

OUR RECRUITMENT PROCESS:

Initial Screening - A conversation with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss your background, experience, career expectations, and interest in the role.

Team Interview - Meet the team to explore your experience in more depth, discuss your approach to product design and collaboration, and learn more about how we work together.

Design Task - A take-home assignment designed to give you the opportunity to demonstrate your product thinking, design strategy, and hands-on design skills.

Final Interview - An in-depth discussion based on your submitted task, covering your thought process, design decisions, conceptual approach, and leadership experience.

Final Step - We will share feedback with you and, if successful, move forward with an offer.

We believe great products are built by great teams working closely together. While we offer flexibility in working hours, this role is fully office-based. We strongly value in-person collaboration, knowledge sharing, fast decision-making, and strong team connections. Working together onsite enables us to collaborate effectively, learn from one another, and continuously drive innovation. Certain exemptions may apply depending on location. Your local HR contact can provide further details.

The minimum monthly salary for this position is according to the Collective Bargaining Agreement. Overpayment will be considered depending on qualifications and working experience.

At Sportradar, we celebrate our diverse group of hardworking employees. Sportradar is committed to ensuring equal access to its programs, facilities, and employment opportunities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We encourage you to apply even if you only meet most of the requirements (but not 100% of the listed criteria) – we believe skills evolve over time. If you’re willing to learn and grow with us, we invite you to join our team!

title: HR Data Engineer
description:
Be An Essential Part Of Everyday Life

Position: HR Data Engineer

Contract Type: Full time – permanent

Travel Required: Less than 20%

Location: UKI//NORAM

At DHL our business is logistics, but people are our passion. With over 500,000 team members in 220 countries, we attract and retain great talent. We are one of the most innovative, most culturally diverse companies on the planet. We provide unmatched opportunities for personal and professional development. We really are a “Best Place to Work”.

Join us as an HR Data Engineer, where you will play a critical role in transforming HR data into a trusted, secure, and reusable asset that powers business decisions and HR operations globally. Combining technical expertise with a strong understanding of HR processes, you will design and deliver data migration, integration, automation, and reporting solutions that enable successful system implementations and continuous operational excellence.

Working in an automation-first environment, you will leverage tools such as Python, SQL, RPA, and Oracle HCM to build scalable solutions, streamline complex data processes, and ensure the highest standards of data quality, governance, and security. You'll partner with project teams and HR stakeholders to manage end-to-end data migration activities, troubleshoot challenges, and deliver efficient, repeatable solutions that support both major transformation programmes and business-as-usual operations.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex data challenges, driving process improvement through automation, and combining technical capability with business understanding to create impactful, high-quality HR data solutions.

If this sounds like a team, you'd like to join … keep reading.

Your key accountabilities include:

  • Solution Design,Build, and Support — independently design,build (components), and support/troubleshoot medium-to-high complexity data solutions (transformation, migration and operational / migration-support reporting) to best-practice standards.
  • Data Conversion & Migration — develop and operate scripted automation (Python, SQL) for data conversion supporting recurring, cookbook-driven implementation projects; operate industry-standard migration tools to transform and load into target systems.
  • Standards-Compliant Loading — ensure converted data complies with HR master-data standards; identify and reject exceptions prior to loading; troubleshoot and resolve loading errors during migrations and for live BAU solutions.
  • Mass-Load Template Tailoring — tailor Oracle HCM standard 'business object' model mass-load templates — which contain all fields supported by the business object — down to targeted recurring mass-load needs, producing slimmer, easier-to-understand templates that the HR Data Management Operations team re-uses for recurring and common mass-load requests.
  • RPA Flow Design & Build — design and build supporting components (Python scripts) for medium-to-high complexity RPA end-to-end flows that perform mass data creation and maintenance, ensuring master-data-standards compliance.
  • Cleanse Planning & Tracking — plan cleanse and migration steps and timelines to project plans and migration methodology; proactively track progress for timeline adherence and standards compliance; manage the data-owner relationship through cleansing to completion.
  • Process-First Structuring — understand HR process dependencies to sequence data migration and structure HR master data to meet process and analytical requirements.

What are we looking for from you?

  • Technical: Python and SQL scripting (data conversion, migration); ETL and industry-standard migration tools; Oracle HCM (or equivalent) business-object / HDL mass-load templates and OTBI / BI Publisher; medium-to-high complexity RPA design and build; medium to advanced Power BI (Power Query, DAX).
  • Data quality & delivery: master-data-standards compliance, exception handling, structured error resolution; data privacy and security by design.
  • Ways of working: independent medium-to-high complexity design; project delivery on recurring / cookbook patterns; agile; process-first, systematic thinking.

We will ensure that all our resourcing activities are fair, transparent, and consistent across the Globe. We want to ensure that the candidate experience is of the highest professional standard.
