title: Staff Deep Learning Engineer, State Estimation (R5785)
description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

Job Description:

Join Shield AI’s Hivemind SDK State Estimation & Vision team to build deep learning capabilities that help autonomous systems understand their motion and localize in the world when GPS is unavailable or unreliable.

You will work at the intersection of deep learning, 3D computer vision, and geometric estimation, developing learned components for vision-based navigation. You will own the model development pipeline—from selecting tools, defining annotation needs, and cleaning data through training, evaluation, integration support, and deployment recommendations.

Hands-on experience with Deep Learning and 3D computer vision and geometry is required; prior experience specifically in vision-based navigation is optional.

What you'll do:

  • Develop and evaluate models for tasks such as feature detection and matching, visual correspondence, depth estimation, relative pose estimation, and image-to-map localization.
  • Combine learned visual representations with geometric methods to improve localization accuracy, robustness, and recovery under challenging conditions.
  • Own data preparation and supervision strategies, including dataset curation, annotation requirements, labeling tools, automated quality checks, and coverage analysis.
  • Select and integrate deep learning tools and build reproducible training workflows, including experiment tracking, configuration management, and dataset and model versioning.
  • Design evaluations that measure both model performance and downstream localization outcomes across changes in lighting, viewpoint, altitude, terrain, weather, and sensor characteristics.
  • Analyze failures and use controlled experiments to prioritize improvements to data, supervision, models, and integration.
  • Partner with state estimation engineers to integrate learned measurements and confidence estimates into VIO and terrain-relative navigation systems.
  • Profile models against onboard compute, memory, and latency constraints, and work with deployment engineers on optimization and runtime validation.
  • Deliver tested, documented components and interfaces for Hivemind SDK, collaborating with software, systems, and flight test teams.

Required qualifications:

  • M.S. in Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field; minimum 4+ years of related professional work experience with an M.S. degree, or 2+ years with a Ph.D.
  • Hands-on experience designing, training, debugging, and evaluating models using PyTorch or an equivalent framework, including architecture selection, loss design, optimization, and augmentation that preserves geometric consistency.
  • Strong foundations in camera models, coordinate transformations, projective geometry, and multi-view geometry, with practical experience in one or more fields: vision-based navigation, visual geolocation, Structure from Motion (SfM), SLAM, 3D reconstruction, depth estimation or similar fields. Expertise in every area is not required.
  • Strong Python skills and experience writing maintainable, reusable software. Demonstrated ability to take a computer vision capability from problem definition and raw data through training, evaluation, and integration readiness.
  • Experience building pipelines for sensor data ingestion, cleaning, filtering, deduplication, and dataset versioning.
  • Ability to select and integrate development tools and build reproducible training workflows, including configuration management, experiment tracking, checkpointing, and GPU performance troubleshooting.
  • Experience designing benchmarks, preventing data leakage across related sequences or locations, analyzing performance across operating conditions, and connecting model metrics to downstream geometric or localization accuracy.
  • Ability to profile inference latency and memory use, document model interfaces and preprocessing, assess accuracy–compute tradeoffs, and advise deployment engineers on export, precision, and runtime optimization.
  • Ability to communicate assumptions, experimental findings, and design tradeoffs clearly and translate research into working software.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with aerial imagery, geospatial data, elevation maps, or matching observations across viewpoint, lighting, season, or sensor modality
  • Experience with model export, quantization, TensorRT, ONNX, or deployment on embedded compute platforms.
  • Experience validating perception or robotics systems on physical platforms.
  • Relevant publications, open-source contributions, or demonstrated delivery of production computer vision systems, familiar with methods including:
  • feature correlation, correlation or cost volumes, and matching methods for correspondence, stereo, optical flow, or localization.
  • learning priors over scene geometry, depth, motion, or appearance to improve estimation under sparse, ambiguous, or degraded observations.
  • applying diffusion models or flow matching to computer vision, geometric inference, or conditional generation.
  • Experience in aerospace and / or defense industry.
You do not need every nice-to-have to succeed in this role. We welcome engineers with strong Deep Learning and 3D vision foundations who are excited to develop expertise in state estimation and navigation to apply.

title: Senior Penetration Tester
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing...

The Verizon Cyber Security (VCS) organization enables the business by protecting assets and information across Verizon networks, infrastructure and applications. VCS integrates cybersecurity governance, policies, technologies and operations across Verizon, and works to incorporate security into the design of technology systems and services.

Verizon Cybersecurity (VCS) is looking for an Application Penetration Tester to join our Enterprise Pen Test team. You’ll be joining a group of talented, creative thinkers who "act like the enemy" to focus on ensuring that infrastructure and applications (web, mobile, and API) are secure by performing penetration testing from both inside and outside of Verizon. This team isn’t a "copy and paste from a scan tool" reporting team, or a cookie cutter just scanning with tools team, or a team that just monitors and supports security scanning tools used by developers. This team is an Enterprise recognized and supported group of skilled, experienced and certified ethical hacking Verizon employees who are trusted to direct themselves with a lot of unknowns.

The successful candidate will possess an effective aptitude in thinking like an adversary, security of Infrastructure, Web applications, APIs and Mobile Applications, mentoring and leading junior pen testers and effectively translating highly technical information to internal customers in a way that supports VCS and broader Verizon goals.


Role responsibilities include:

  • Leading and performing full scope penetration testing on complex, high risk web applications, Infrastructure, APIs and Mobile applications.
  • Successfully working complex issues that require the analysis and in-depth evaluation of variable factors.
  • Interpreting broad goals with unknown variables and craft, execute plans to achieve these goals with little to no contemporary “clear and transparent” standards.
  • Developing resolutions that require the frequent use of creativity and out of the box thinking.
  • Configuring and safely utilizing attacker tools, tactics, and procedures for Verizon environments.
  • Developing comprehensive and accurate reports and presentations for both technical and executive audiences.
  • The ability to make collaborative and independent decisions on the impact of an exposure to Verizon
  • Acting as a SME and guide, advising on security vulnerability impact, ratings and remediation recommendations across the organization as needed.
  • Helping to lead the definition of Pen Test (with AI) strategy and standards to further enhance the company’s security posture, collaborating with management/exec leadership.
  • Supporting, designing and architecting an inhouse developed AI Pen Testing harness.
  • Effectively communicating findings and strategy to client stakeholders including technical staff, executive leadership, and legal counsel
  • Working closely with stakeholders and developers providing risk-appropriate and pragmatic recommendations to correct found vulnerabilities.
  • Translating functional plans into operational processes and guiding execution of the development of scripts, tools, or methodologies to enhance Verizon’s pen testing processes and effectiveness
  • Driving technical oversight and mentoring junior pen testers on pen test engagements, vulnerability impact and ratings and remediation recommendations.
  • Providing leadership and guidance to advance the offensive capabilities of the team and its subsequent ability to defend the Verizon Enterprise.

What we’re looking for...


For this role, we are looking for an experienced hands on pen tester who thinks like an attacker and outside of the box, who is vocal and can help lead/motivate Jr team members and who is motivated to evolve pen offensive security w/ AI - not just work with it, nor just do small jobs with it but innovate and develop it. Creative thinking, working autonomously and strategic thinking are also critical for this role.


You’ll need to have:

  • Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
  • Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
  • Six or more years of application/network penetration testing or security experience.

Even better if you have one or more of the following:


  • A degree in engineering, cyber security or computer science.
  • Experience developing AI toolkits and an understanding of AI LLMs and MCPs.
  • Knowledge of secure software deployment methodologies, tools, and practices.
  • Experience with application security risk procedures, security patterns, authentication technologies and security attack pathologies.
  • Certifications such as: GXPN, GPEN, , eWPT, GCIH, GWAPT, OSCP, OSWA, OSCE, OSWE.
  • Service Delivery/Governance: ITILv2/3.
  • Deep understanding of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Top 10, MASVS.
  • Strong knowledge of tools used for api, Infrastructure, web application, mobile, and network security testing, such as Kali Linux, Metasploit, Wireshark, Burp suite, Cobalt Strike, Nessus, Web Inspect, SQLMap.
  • Experience leading small pen test teams, driving process and strategy.
  • Solid understanding of common hosting environments such as containerization platforms (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes) and virtual machines running under hypervisors.
  • An implementation level familiarity with all common classes of modern exploitation.
  • Mastery of Unix/Linux/Mac/Windows operating systems, including bash and Powershell.
  • Programming skills preferred and encouraged, as well as the ability to read and assess applications written multiple languages, such as Python, JAVA, .NET, C#, or others.
  • Experience with system and application security threats and vulnerabilities and secure configuration management techniques, software debugging principles, software design tools, methods, and techniques, software development models (e.g., Waterfall Model, Spiral Model).
  • Knowledge of secure coding techniques.
  • Knowledge of application security, application security vulnerabilities and exploitation techniques.
  • Some experience with software related information technology (IT) security principles and methods (e.g., modularization, layering, abstraction, data hiding, and simplicity/minimization).
  • Knowledge of secure software deployment methodologies, tools, and practices.
  • Knowledge of network security architecture concepts including topology, protocols, components, and principles (e.g., application of defense-in-depth).
  • Knowledge of security architecture concepts and enterprise architecture reference models.
  • Knowledge in discerning the protection needs (i.e., security controls) of information systems and networks.
  • Strong organization skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple, often conflicting priorities to successful completion.
  • Be a continuous learner; with a desire to stay current on security trends, tool, technologies and best practices.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this remote role, you'll work from home with occasional in-person trainings and meetings.

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits and Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

title: Manufacturing Quality Foundations Systems Lead
description:
Dometic is a global market leader in the mobile living industry. Millions of people around the world use Dometic products in outdoor, residential, and professional applications.

Our Marine organization is a trusted provider of innovative solutions for the worldwide boating and boat building industry, and we recently expanded our scope to lead the boating industry into an electrified future. Dometic has won numerous NMMA Innovation Awards over the years and we are always striving for new ways to make boating easier, safer, and more enjoyable.

We are on a journey of continuous growth – now looking for our next star – a passionate Manufacturing Quality Foundations Systems Lead. This position reports to Interim Director, Quality Assurance and will work in Vancouver, BC.

About the position

Dometic Marine’s headquarters are in Vancouver, British Columbia in Canada. The facility develops and manufactures hydraulic, electronic, and combustion-based products.

As Manufacturing Quality Foundations Systems Lead of the Vancouver team, you will build quality assurance into the company's production process through integration of YMC Monozukuri Principle Activities and to support internal and external audit activities. This role sits at the intersection of Quality, Manufacturing, and Customer Quality, ensuring that Yamaha (YMC) quality manufacturing principles are trained, applied, and sustained across the Vancouver facility and broader Marine Segment.

Reporting to the Interim Director of Quality Assurance, the Quality Foundations Systems Lead serves as the site's certified Yamaha (YMUS) Principle Activities trainer, develops and delivers Monozukuri training materials, and provides QA support on legacy hydraulic product defects to help reduce cost-of-quality KPIs. The role is also the primary quality customer interface for key accounts and acts as the sole General Dynamics Land Systems Inspector Delegate. This is a highly cross-functional role requiring comprehensive knowledge of production, quality systems, and customer requirements.

Your main responsibilities

  • YMC Monozukuri Principle Activities & Training
    • Serve as a Yamaha (YMUS) certified Principle Activities trainer, training all Dometic staff in the YMC quality manufacturing system.
    • Develop Monozukuri Principle Activities training materials for Vancouver internal, Vancouver external, and Marine Segment audiences.
    • Lead weekly DPS Make Rule Book and Principle Activities training sessions.
    • Conduct monthly and semiannual Monozukuri Level Evaluations, including the semiannual Yamaha audit.
    • Deliver quality onboarding for new hires and co-op students on a semiannual basis.
  • Product Quality & Customer Support
    • Provide QA support for external and internal defects on legacy hydraulic products (helm, pivot, hose, kitting) to help decrease the cost of quality KPI, including external warranty data.
    • Respond daily to warranty findings and implement corrective fixes to production.
    • Respond weekly to customer quality concerns.
    • Act as the quality customer interface for Mercury, YMC/YMUS, Volvo, and Honda.
  • Audit, Inspection & Compliance
    • Perform GP12 inspections as required.
    • Support annual ISO 9001 audit activities.
    • Perform daily operations quality control (firefighting) to maintain production flow.

What do we offer?

You are offered an interesting role in a dynamic, fast paced and global environment with great opportunities to grow and take on new challenges. The growth at Dometic is continuous – which gives you great possibilities to evolve with the company.

  • Medical/Dental/Vision Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Disability insurance (STD/LTD)
  • Retirement Programs (RSP and Company Pension Plan)
  • Paid Vacation
  • Statutory Holidays
  • Free on-site parking
  • Paid maternity/paternity leave
  • Tuition and Professional Designation dues assistance
  • Employee discounts on our incredible products
  • Company events
  • Opportunities to make an impact

A suitable background would bring demonstrated success in manufacturing environment. Additionally, they will have acquired the following qualifications and experiences:

  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in a related engineering, quality, or manufacturing discipline, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Yamaha (YMUS) Principle Activities certification, or willingness and ability to obtain certification.
  • Experience in quality assurance, manufacturing quality systems, or a related engineering discipline within a manufacturing environment.
  • Familiarity with Lean/Monozukuri principles, ISO 9001, and structured audit processes.
  • Experience supporting warranty analysis, root cause investigation, and corrective action on legacy or in-production hardware.
  • Experience acting as a quality liaison with external customers or regulatory/inspection bodies.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint for reporting, documentation, and training material development.
  • Manufacturing & Product Quality
    • Deep, hands-on understanding of manufacturing quality within a production environment, including how quality is built into the process rather than inspected in after the fact. This includes working knowledge of Yamaha (YMC) Monozukuri principles, Lean manufacturing fundamentals, and ISO 9001 quality systems, along with the ability to identify process-level defect sources, drive containment, and implement corrective actions on the shop floor. Comfortable working directly with Operations to resolve day-to-day quality issues (firefighting) while also building the longer-term training and process discipline that prevents recurrence.
  • Customer Quality
    • Skilled at representing quality to external customers and acting as a trusted technical point of contact for accounts such as Mercury, YMC/YMUS, Volvo, and Honda, as well as regulatory/inspection bodies such as General Dynamics Land Systems. This requires the ability to interpret and respond to customer quality concerns and warranty findings, communicate root cause and corrective action clearly to non-internal audiences, and manage the relationship professionally even when delivering difficult news. Includes experience supporting customer audits, inspections (e.g., GP12), and ongoing performance reporting.
  • Product Development & NPI
    • Ability to support quality throughout the product lifecycle, from legacy product sustaining (helm, pivot, hose, kitting) through new product introduction. This includes working cross-functionally with Design Engineering during development to build quality and manufacturability considerations into new designs, supporting early-stage risk identification, and ensuring quality processes and documentation are in place before a product transitions into full production. Familiarity with how engineering changes and process improvements affect an in-production or newly launched product is essential.
  • Analytics
    • Comfortable working with data to track and improve quality performance, including monitoring cost-of-quality KPIs, external warranty data, and Monozukuri Level Evaluation results over time. Able to build and maintain reporting (e.g., in Excel) that surfaces trends, aging issues, and training/adoption gaps to leadership, and to use that data to prioritize where training, process changes, or corrective action will have the greatest impact. Strong attention to detail when analyzing defect data to distinguish root cause from symptoms.

To be successful in this role, we believe that you possess the following skills, competencies & characteristics:

  • Strong written and verbal communication and training skills, with the ability to engage both internal staff and external customers.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally across production, engineering, and customer-facing teams.
  • Detail-oriented, with a track record of driving down cost-of-quality issues and resolving field defects.
  • Able to manage competing daily priorities, from firefighting production issues to long-term training program development.

And of course – our Core Values

To thrive and succeed in this role, you understand the importance of our core values – Together We build our future, We play to win, We embrace change and We walk the talk; these values reflect the heart and soul of Dometic and they define what it takes to work here and how we do things.

Are you our next star? Then we would love to see your application.

Dometic is passionate about building together an inclusive and equitable working environment, that respects individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that diversity enables us to thrive across our differences. Be yourself and join us!

Dometic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Dometic evaluates qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, gender, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

title: Paid Creator Coordinator
description:
Paid Creator Coordinator

Department: Partnerships – Creator Team

Location: Hybrid (Orem, UT) – Travel Required

Salary: $50,000–$60,000, based on experience

Who We Are

At Just Ingredients – a health and wellness e-commerce company – we believe that nourishing your body with real ingredients is essential for living a healthy and fulfilling life. That's why our products are made using carefully selected, whole-food ingredients. And our people are just as real as our ingredients – authentic, collaborative, and dedicated to fostering a workplace that inspires individuals and teams to reach their full potential.

About the Team

The Creator Team, within the Partnerships department, manages Just Ingredients' affiliate and creator partnerships – the everyday influencers and content creators who share our products with their audiences. This role owns the paid side of that program: negotiating rates and terms with creators, and making the call on who's actually worth paying and how much. This is distinct from the Collaborations team's talent and celebrity partnerships – this role focuses on the broader creator and affiliate ecosystem, from nano and micro creators through mid-tier influencers.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for a paid creator coordinator with 2-3+ years of hands-on experience managing paid creator or influencer deals. You know current market rates across platforms and creator tiers, and you're comfortable negotiating directly with creators, managers, and agents on rates, deliverables, usage rights, and exclusivity. Just as important, you know how to look past follower count – you can read engagement, conversion, and past performance data to figure out which creators actually make strategic sense to pay, and which don't. You're organized enough to manage a high volume of active deals and deadlines at once without losing track of details.

What You'll Do

Creator Sourcing & Deal Negotiation

  • Source and evaluate potential paid creators for the affiliate program based on audience fit, content quality, and performance history.
  • Negotiate rates, deliverables, usage rights, and exclusivity terms directly with creators, managers, and agents.

title: Technical Site Lead  - SEI Customer Site - Fort Meade, MD
description:
This role is based onsite with SEI customers in the Fort Meade area.

Who We Are

SEI conducts research and development in software engineering, systems engineering, cybersecurity, and many other areas of computing, working to introduce private-sector innovations into government. The SEI works closely with defense and government organizations, industry, and academia to continually improve software-intensive systems. Its core purposes are to help organizations improve software engineering capabilities, advance cybersecurity methods and technologies, and bring the discipline of software engineering to AI systems.

What We Do

Once a Computer Emergency Response Team formed in 1988 in response to the Morris Worm, today the CERT Division leads as a Cybersecurity Engineering and Resilience Team conducting collaborative and innovative evidence-based research to fortify the cyber ecosystem and protect national security and prosperity. We aim to:

  • Advance Cybersecurity by Design—Develop and transition evidence-based solutions addressing foundational and enduring challenges
  • Enhance Cybersecurity Resilience—Discover and prototype methods to build resilience into existing and future critical infrastructure
  • Influence the Cybersecurity Marketplace—Promote more effective, efficient, and resilient methodologies and principles
  • Shape the Future—Inform stakeholders of technical priorities and emerging research challenges in partnership with the community

Position Summary

As a Technical Site Lead, you will work closely with the CERT leadership team to activate and sustain a SEI operating location in the Fort Meade area. You will act as the forward presence and primary point of contact for CERT in the area. You will contribute to the planning, execution, and delivery of a portfolio of technical projects supporting our Intelligence Community (IC), Combatant Command (CCMD), and Service Cyber Component (SCC) mission partners. You will partner with our Cybersecurity Innovations and Initiatives (CII) team to coordinate with our IC, SCC, and CCMD mission partners, ensuring project performance meets expectations, deliverables are on schedule, and technical approaches remain aligned with partner needs. You will partner across SEI technical and support staff, to create and sustain a culture of technical excellence, creativity, cross-enterprise collaboration, innovation within the portfolio, and secure capability transitions. You will produce assessments measuring the utility and value of SEI work products for our mission partners. You will advocate for staff assigned to the remote site partnering with their leadership. Finally, you may also contribute technically, helping shape approaches to analyzing, assuring, and countering software systems in support of National Security.

Who you are:

  • Site Management: Stemming from site activation to day-to-day management of personnel, activities, and engagements locally. Advocate for staff assigned to the remote site in partnership with their leadership. Serve as the forward presence and primary point of contact for CERT with the IC, CCMD, and SCC partners in the area.

  • Solutions Engineer: You partner with our CII team to create and maintain strong working relationships with mission partners, conducting regular check-ins to assess satisfaction, gather feedback, and ensure alignment between delivered work and partner priorities. You translate partner needs into actionable technical requirements for project teams.
  • Strategic Communicator and Collaborator: You have outstanding written and oral communication skills. You can synthesize complex technical information into clear status updates, risk assessments, and executive briefings for both internal leadership and external mission partners. You are a communicator with strategic partners to posture CERT for the most impactful outcomes for our applied research.
  • Technical Leadership: You have experience managing complex technical projects from initiation through delivery. You can organize cross-functional teams and keep execution on track across multiple concurrent efforts. You have experience leading and advocating for personnel.
  • Quality-Driven: You ensure deliverables meet both mission partner expectations and SEI standards. You conduct regular project reviews, identify quality gaps, develop corrective actions, and verify that SEI standards for safety, security, and compliance are satisfied.
  • Outcome-Focused: You are a driven by a sense of duty to deliver outcomes that advance the state of cybersecurity.
  • Culture: Help develop a site team culture that fosters innovation, technical excellence, and leadership in alignment with SEI core values.

What you’ll do:

In conjunction with the CERT leadership team, you will…

  • Activate and sustain a SEI operating location in the Fort Meade area in conjunction with CERT leadership.
  • Serve as a primary technical liaison to IC, CCMD, and SCC mission partners alongside our CII team, conducting regular project reviews to assess how CERT is meeting their operational needs and where adjustments are required.
  • Develop an IC, CCMD, and SSC mission partner technical strategy in alignment with CERT’s broader technical strategy.
  • Communicate with strategic partners regarding ongoing support and make recommendations for future direction.
  • Assess CERT's portfolio of projects for IC, CCMD, SSC mission partners ensuring alignment with strategic needs.
  • Review externally-delivered products and ensure all internal quality, safety, and security requirements are met.
  • Foster a team culture of technical rigor, accountability, and cross-team collaboration.
  • Partner with other FFRDCs and UARCs to better serve our mission partners.
  • Serve as a point of contact for local personnel seeking employment with the SEI.
  • Coordinate across SEI and CMU support functions (including security, IT, contracting, and human resources) to ensure the site has what it needs to execute.

Requirements:

  • BS in computer science, software engineering, networking, information systems, or a related technical field with ten (10) years of experience; MS in computer science or technical/engineering field with eight (8) years of experience; PhD in computer science or technical/engineering field with five (5) years of experience or equivalent combination of training and experience. Other educational backgrounds of a technical nature with experience as described may be considered.
  • You have a willingness to travel (25%) outside of your office location to other SEI offices, sponsor sites, conferences, and offsite meetings.
  • You will be subject to a background investigation, and you must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Department of War security clearance.

title: VP of Development - United Overseas Bank
description:
Company: 1011 United Overseas Bank Ltd

About UOB

United Overseas Bank Limited (UOB) is a leading bank in Asia with a global network of more than 500 branches and offices in 19 countries and territories in Asia Pacific, Europe and North America. In Asia, we operate through our head office in Singapore and banking subsidiaries in China, Indonesia, Malaysia and Thailand, as well as branches and offices. Our history spans more than 80 years. Over this time, we have been guided by our values - Honorable, Enterprising, United and Committed. This means we always strive to do what is right, build for the future, work as one team and pursue long-term success. It is how we work, consistently, be it towards the company, our colleagues or our customers.

Job Description

UOB's AI & Data Risk Governance & Control is a centralized Line 2 function within Group Risk Management, responsible for providing independent oversight and effective challenge across the Bank's AI ecosystem. The function ensures that AI systems, including Generative AI and Agentic AI, are secure, fair, explainable, resilient, and appropriately governed throughout their lifecycle. Leveraging both risk expertise and hands-on technical capabilities, the team conducts independent assessments, validation activities, control evaluations, and horizon scanning to identify emerging risks, assess evolving technologies, and provide objective, decision-oriented guidance to senior management. This role does not act as a solution owner or production development team, rather, it applies technical expertise to independently evaluate, test, validate, and challenge AI solutions developed by business units, technology teams, vendors, or third parties.

Role Overview

This is a hands-on individual contributor role focused on Generative AI and Agentic AI risk governance, assessment, and oversight. The role is responsible for executing end-to-end AI use case risk assessments, monitoring frontier AI technologies and emerging risks, conducting applied research, and communicating decision-oriented insights to senior management. The role also requires sufficient technical expertise to develop prototypes, evaluation environments, and proof-of-concepts to independently assess, challenge, evaluate, and test AI systems proposed or developed by AI builders. The role does not function as a solution owner or production developer; technical capabilities are applied to support effective challenge, validation, control testing, and risk assessment activities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform independent review and effective challenge of AI use cases, covering Generative AI and Agentic AI. Execute business-as-usual risk assessment activities, including inherent risk assessment, control effectiveness assessment, residual risk assessment, remediation tracking, and governance reporting. Apply third-party risk assessment processes where external providers or solutions are involved.
  • Scan the market and research the frontier for emerging AI technologies, attack techniques, incidents, regulatory developments, standards, and industry practices. Assess the implications for the bank and present clear, decision-oriented findings to senior management.
  • Develop proof of concepts, prototypes, evaluation environments and reference implementations for Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions to support independent validation, risk assessment, control testing, and effective challenge. Understand key architectural components including models, orchestration frameworks, agents, tools, retrieval systems, APIs, data pipelines and deployment patterns.
  • Conduct applied research specific to Generative AI and Agentic AI to strengthen validation methodologies, evaluation approaches, metrics, test suites, and internal guidance.
  • Apply domain knowledge of AI risk evaluations, covering relevant threats and failure modes such as prompt injection, jailbreak, data poisoning, distribution shift, unsafe tool use, and agentic failure modes.

title: (Senior) Data Engineer, Novonesis, Bagsværd
description:
Interested in a career that matters?




Are you excited about enabling scientific innovation through data and digital solutions? Do you enjoy working hands-on with modern technologies while collaborating closely with scientists and digital specialists to solve complex challenges?


As a (Senior) Data Engineer, you will join the newly established Digital Enablement Team within Product & Process Development (PPD), an organization of more than 400 employees across six director areas and more than 10 geographical locations. The team brings together expertise in digital implementation, data engineering, AI, and data platform enablement to help shape the future of digital and data-driven R&D across Novonesis.

Working closely with scientists, local digital teams, platform owners, and data specialists, you will help create scalable and reusable data solutions that strengthen scientific workflows, improve data accessibility, and accelerate innovation across PPD.

The Role & Your Impact

This is a hands-on specialist role that combines technical delivery, technical leadership, and enablement. You will work across a diverse technology landscape that combines open-source technologies and Unix-based systems with enterprise platforms such as Benchling and Databricks. You will have considerable flexibility to shape pragmatic solutions using technologies such as Python, SQL, APIs and modern data-engineering practices.


In this role, you'll make an impact by:

  • Design, develop, and implement robust data pipelines, integrations, scalable data flows, and reusable engineering components that connect scientific applications, local solutions, and enterprise platforms such as Benchling and Databricks across PPD.
  • Partner closely with scientists and local digital teams to understand business and scientific needs, translating them into reliable, sustainable, and high-value data solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance on architecture, APIs, data quality, testing, deployment, lifecycle management, and modern data engineering practices, ensuring engineering excellence and sound technical decision-making.
  • Strengthen PPD's shared data foundation by identifying reusable patterns and components, while collaborating with platform owners, AI specialists, and partner teams to resolve dependencies, promote reuse, and ensure sustainable solution ownership.

What You'll Need to Be Successful

To succeed in this role, you bring both deep technical expertise and a collaborative mindset.


You likely have:

  • An MSc degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Bioinformatics, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent qualifications gained through substantial relevant professional experience.
  • Strong experience designing, building, and maintaining production-grade data pipelines, integrations, and operational data solutions.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Experience with APIs, data modeling, version control, automated testing, and modern software engineering practices.
  • Experience working across multiple systems and platforms while balancing data quality, reliability, maintainability, and lifecycle ownership.
  • Experience collaborating with scientists, engineers, or other domain experts to develop technical solutions that solve real-world problems.
  • Professional working proficiency in English.

In addition, you demonstrate:

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to balance short-term needs with long-term sustainability.
  • Excellent collaboration and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • An enablement mindset, helping others succeed while maintaining solution quality.
  • Structured and analytical problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong communication skills and a curiosity for understanding complex scientific domains.

Additional Skills & Interests We Value

While these qualifications are not required, they would be considered an advantage. Experience working at Novonesis or within a similarly complex R&D environment would help you quickly navigate the scientific and organizational landscape. Familiarity with scientific data, laboratory workflows, process development environments, or research systems would be beneficial, as would experience working with enterprise-scale data platforms such as Databricks. We also value exposure to AI-enabled solutions and broader data platform ecosystems, as well as experience developing reusable data engineering frameworks, standards, or shared services that enable scalability and consistency across an organization.

What We Offer

You will become part of a newly formed team with the unique opportunity to influence both the direction of the team and the way digital enablement is delivered across PPD. As a (Senior) Data Engineer, you will help shape data engineering practices across a global R&D organization while supporting scientific innovation and product development through impactful digital solutions. This role offers the opportunity to work in a highly collaborative environment where scientists, engineers, and digital specialists partner closely to solve complex challenges and accelerate innovation.


You will have the chance to expand your expertise across data engineering, digital implementation, AI, and scientific data platforms while working with a broad network of stakeholders across PPD. We foster a culture built on curiosity, knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and continuous improvement, where new ideas are encouraged and expertise is actively developed. Most importantly, you will have the opportunity to make a lasting impact by creating scalable and reusable solutions that strengthen data capabilities and benefit teams across the organization.

Ways of Working

The Digital Enablement Team operates in an office-first hybrid setup.

Being onsite is important for building strong relationships, understanding scientific workflows, and collaborating closely with stakeholders. At the same time, we support flexibility and remote work when compatible with team responsibilities and project needs.


Application deadline: 16 October 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.


Contact: For additional information about the position, please contact Christian Munk, PPD Digitalization Lead at crmu@novonesis.com or +45 30 77 04 33.

Our purpose guides the way

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.

Opportunities for everyone

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

Job Description

This position assists in the development and implementation of health physics and radiation protection programs, processes and/or systems, as necessary, for the plant operations to protect the radiological health and safety of workers and members of the public, and to control radiological effluent releases. This includes creating, documenting, and managing the technical and regulatory requirements of radiological design and safety programs. This role also assists in the technical development and implementation of engineering and program specific administrative procedures while ensuring they conform to all technical, regulatory, and internal program requirements.


Job Profile Tasks/Responsibilities:

  • Develop occupational radiation protection practices and ALARA program requirements for a first of its kind reactor or nuclear fuel fabrication facility.
  • Assist with the establishing a radiation safety program to ensure regulatory compliance as mandated by local, state, and federal agencies, including the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC), the Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA), and State Laws.
  • Evaluate and analyze radiological health hazards, or remediation of either byproduct, source or special nuclear material.
  • Collaborate and communicate with key stakeholders in project leadership and across the team to provide frequent updates on progress of projects, maintain the correct order of priorities and ability to adapt to change, and raise concerns when there are problems with projects and/or timelines.
  • Provide technical expertise and guidance in the identification, analysis, and resolution of problems of increasing scope and complexity.
  • Contribute to team decision-making in the accomplishment of business goals and objectives through effective planning, organizing, estimating, scheduling, and monitoring of work activities; deal with changing priorities and differing situations and make decisions that may affect the work of the team.
  • Prepare thorough and accurate technical reports, correspondence, documentation, calculations, and sketches related to well-defined problems and analysis of increasing scope and complexity.
  • Conduct technical studies; complete routine technical projects with minimal oversight with increasing ability to independently manage project schedules and interfaces.
  • Develop/implement radiation safety programs and procedures, including but not limited to: ALARA, respiratory protection, internal and external dosimetry, air sampling and monitoring, contamination control, radiological surveys and monitoring (including instrument selection and maintenance), radiation work permitting, and environmental monitoring.
    • Perform hazard assessments and define job safety requirements in work permits.
    • Participate in Process Hazards Analysis activities with multidiscipline teams to identify potential criticality, radiological, chemical, and fire/explosion hazards and determine potential consequence levels to support the Integrated Safety Analysis (ISA) process.
    • Consult with and advise operations, maintenance, and engineering personnel on the radiation protection or occupational safety and health impacts of new or proposed changes to processes, procedures, and facility designs/modifications.
    • Participate in design reviews.
    • Conduct surveillances, inspections, walk-downs, investigations, and audits/assessments of radiological material operations and unusual incidents to ensure compliance with approved procedures and safety bases.
    • Review and audit the safety and health programs for adequacy, compliance, and effectiveness.
    • Develop Health Physics/Health & Safety Technician Training and Qualification Plan and train employees.
    • Develop/deliver radiation safety training for all personnel.
    • Develop/revise safety postings and operator aids to implement administrative controls to ensure they are unambiguous, easily understood, and readily achievable.
    • Prepare and deliver recommendations to managers, safety committee representatives, and employees.
    • Provide support to the emergency response team.
  • Maintain professional demeanor and behavior at all times in all forms of communication.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by manager.

Level III:

    • Execute the core tasks and responsibilities, listed in the Job Profile Task/Responsibilities section of this document, with minimal supervision.
    • Provide ownership, responsibility, and accountability over technical scope involving the coordination of multiple individual contributors working in a specific area.

Level IV:

  • Lead the execution of the core tasks and responsibilities, listed in the Job Profile Task/Responsibilities section of this document, without close supervision and some latitude for independent judgment.
  • Provide feedback and guidance to more junior team members with the execution of the core tasks and responsibilities listed in the Job Profile Task/Responsibilities section of this document.
  • Shares knowledge related to industry best practices and standards with others across the team.

Job Profile Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in science (health physics, biology, etc.) and/or engineering (nuclear, chemical, mechanical, etc.) from an accredited college or university required.
  • Knowledge of the principles, theories and practices in the field of health physics and radiation safety, and in the implementation of programs associated with the use of byproduct, source or special nuclear materials in the areas of power reactor, nuclear fuel fabrication, medical, industrial, academic, decommissioning (material use or reactor operations), and/or Independent Spent Fuel Storage Installation (ISFSIs).
  • Level III: Typically, five years of experience in the health physics / radiation safety field required.
  • Level IV: Typically, ten years of experience in the health physics / radiation safety field required.
  • Experience developing written procedures to implement regulatory and code/standard requirements, and experience applying regulatory guidance.
  • Working knowledge of relevant industry codes, standards, and best practices for health physics, radiation surveying and monitoring, radiation safety training, ALARA best practices, and NRC requirements for nuclear facilities.
  • Understanding of NRC-regulated nuclear facility operation, ventilation systems, and respiratory protection to reduce worker exposure to radioactive airborne contamination, and oversight of safe handling of radiological materials.
  • Experience using MCNP, Microshield, or other computer codes and models/methods for dose assessments.

  • Restoring communications services quickly by identifying root cause, executing corrective actions, and verifying system performance for government and commercial sector customers.
  • Performing field service work, including site visits, turn-ups, cutovers, acceptance testing, signal/coverage verification, and documentation of all configurations and system changes.

  • Assisting in scope development, quoting, and estimating for service, installation, and programming projects.
  • Supporting preventive maintenance activities, firmware/software updates, subscriber reprogramming, and configuration management to ensure system reliability.
  • Making minor mechanical/electronic modifications as required (e.g., connectors, wiring, antenna adjustments, accessory integration).
  • Completing service tickets accurately and on time, including documentation of work performed, parts used, and recommended follow‑up actions.
  • Mentoring junior technicians by providing technical guidance, hands‑on coaching, best practices for troubleshooting and installation, and support in developing their skills.

  • Participating in an on‑call rotation and providing after‑hours support to meet customer uptime needs.
  • Performing other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE TEAM:

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in technical service or installation (5+ years preferred), ideally supporting two‑way radio/LMR communication systems.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in installation, programming, troubleshooting, and repair of radio communications equipment and infrastructure.
  • Proven experience supporting complex systems such as P25/ASTRO 25 systems, Motorola APX radios, MOTOTRBO/DMR platforms, VHF/UHF LMR infrastructure, trunked and conventional networks, repeaters, and dispatch consoles.
  • Strong knowledge of radio theory, RF fundamentals, propagation characteristics across various frequency bands, and communication system behavior.

FULL STACK SOFTWARE ENGINEER, INTERNAL APPLICATIONS

We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support.

Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.

Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers with diverse perspectives to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals at a rapid pace. title: Quality Coordinator - Prefab
description:
Job Description

Digital Building Components, part of the DPR Family of Companies, is seeking a Quality Coordinator - Prefab.

At DPR, roles and responsibilities are more than describing a job title—they are a commitment to building great things together. The job description(s) below defines core responsibilities and the scope of the role and is a starting point. Every employee is expected to lead from where they are, take ownership of outcomes, and always act in the best interest of the team, customer, project and organization.

As a purpose-driven organization on a journey to be most admired, we rely on trust, shared leadership, open communication, disciplined action and a deep respect for the individual to drive exceptional performance. Success is not just about what we build, but who we build and how we build it: with integrity, enjoyment, uniqueness and an ever-forward mindset.

Job Summary:
Ensures the consistent application of quality processes, based on established guidelines, to support the delivery of reliable, high-performing prefabricated products and assemblies. Creates, promotes, and reinforces a culture of quality across manufacturing, production, and support teams to establish clear quality expectations and drive consistent execution. Coordinates quality assurance and quality control activities throughout the prefabrication lifecycle, from material receipt through fabrication, assembly, inspection, testing, and shipment. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to identify, analyze, and resolve quality-related issues while supporting continuous improvement initiatives. Monitors quality performance data and recommends process enhancements to improve product quality, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities:
Manages the consistent application of quality assurance and quality control processes across prefabrication operations to support product quality and production objectives.
Coordinates with manufacturing, production, engineering, supply chain, and operations teams to integrate quality requirements into fabrication and assembly processes.
Develops and maintains quality programs, inspection plans, and process controls to support compliance with established standards and customer requirements.
Supports training and awareness initiatives that promote understanding of quality processes, inspection requirements, and individual quality responsibilities.
Monitors quality metrics, inspection results, nonconformance trends, and production performance data to identify opportunities for corrective and preventive action.
Investigates quality-related issues, facilitates root cause analysis activities, and recommends process improvements to enhance product reliability and manufacturing efficiency.
Communicates quality findings, performance trends, and recommendations to stakeholders to support informed decision-making and continuous improvement efforts.

Education Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, manufacturing, industrial technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience required.

Work Experience:
4–6 years of experience in quality assurance, quality control, manufacturing, prefabrication, production operations, or a related field required.
Experience supporting inspection, testing, process control, corrective action, and continuous improvement activities in a manufacturing or prefabrication environment required.

Certifications and Licenses:
American Society for Quality (ASQ) Certified Quality Technician (CQT) certification preferred.
American Society for Quality (ASQ) Certified Quality Inspector (CQI) certification preferred.

DPR Construction is a forward-thinking, self-performing general contractor specializing in technically complex and sustainable projects for the advanced technology, life sciences, healthcare, higher education and commercial markets. Founded in 1990, DPR is a great story of entrepreneurial success as a private, employee-owned company that has grown into a multi-billion-dollar family of companies with offices around the world.


Working at DPR, you'll have the chance to try new things, explore paths and shape your future. Here, we build opportunity together—by harnessing our talents, enabling curiosity and pursuing our collective ambition to make the best ideas happen. description:

Cloud & Identity -You run the backbone.

Endpoints & Assets - You keep every device battle-ready.
From Windows to MacBook, you'll own the full device and endpoint management stack, streamlining deployment through Intune. You'll build and roll out Intune policies that keep every endpoint aligned with our security standards, and you'll team up with Procurement to manage the IT asset lifecycle end-to-end - from onboarding to retirement.

You'll partner with teams across Emma on projects that make our business processes sharper and more efficient. This isn't a "wait for instructions" role - you'll make autonomous, strategic calls, including ones that shape cross-team architecture, and help keep every team pulling in the same direction toward company goals.


Who we're looking for:
  • A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years in a similar role, with strong depth in Azure and Intune.
  • Sharp communication and interpersonal skills — you can talk tech with anyone in the room.
  • Comfort thriving in a fast-paced, ever-shifting environment.
  • A genuine hands-on mentality — you'd rather build the fix than describe it.
  • Solid scripting chops, PowerShell preferred.

What we offer:
  • A combination of personal and company growth to accelerate your career and help you reach your goals.
  • A career development path tailored to your goals, with access to mentorship, training, and resources that will accelerate your professional growth.
  • The chance to work on exciting and challenging projects as part of a dedicated, international team.
  • A culture of collaboration and innovation, where you’ll have the freedom to implement new ideas, shape processes, and help build the DNA of a maturing company.
  • To work and learn from experts in diverse fields and get to know your team members at exciting company events.

Become an Emmie

We are on a mission to become No.1 in the world of sleep, and we’re looking for driven, ambitious people to help us shape what’s next. If you’re curious, hands-on, and ready to challenge the status quo, you’ll find the space here to make things happen and create real impact.

title: CWI AMO Technician
description:
AMO Technician – Prudhoe Bay, Alaska


Assembly, Maintenance & Overhaul (AMO) Technician


Join our Baker Hughes – Completion, Intervention and Measurement organization and Partner with the best!


Baker Hughes Incorporated has an opening for an AMO Technician in Prudhoe Bay, Alaska. As a leader in the oilfield services industry, Baker Hughes offers opportunities for qualified people who want to grow in our high-performance organization. Our leading technologies and our ability to apply them safely and effectively create value for our customers and our shareholders. Baker Hughes is an Equal Employment Affirmative Action Employer.


About this job

Schedule

  • 21 Days On / 21 Days Off Rotational Schedule
  • 12-Hour Shifts
  • Overtime Required
  • Must be willing to work days, nights, weekends, holidays, and extended hours as business needs dictate.

Position Summary

The AMO Technician is responsible for the assembly, maintenance, repair, inspection, testing, and preparation of Baker Hughes oilfield equipment supporting North Slope operations. This role plays a critical part in ensuring equipment is delivered safely, on time, and in compliance with customer, quality, and regulatory requirements.


Working in a remote Arctic environment, the AMO Technician must demonstrate a strong commitment to safety, quality, teamwork, and operational excellence while supporting drilling, completions, intervention, and production operations.


Essential Responsibilities

  • Assemble, disassemble, inspect, repair, and maintain oilfield tools and equipment.
  • Perform preventative and corrective maintenance activities in accordance with Baker Hughes procedures and engineering specifications.
  • Conduct dimensional inspections, functional testing, pressure testing, torque verification, and equipment certification activities.
  • Execute work orders, repair records, and maintenance documentation accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Support loadout and return processing of customer equipment and rental assets.
  • Identify and report equipment deficiencies, non-conformances, and reliability concerns.
  • Participate in root cause investigations and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain compliance with all HSE, quality, and operational procedures.
  • Operate forklifts, overhead cranes, torque equipment, pressure testing equipment, and other shop machinery as required.
  • Support inventory control, cycle counting, and material handling activities.
  • Assist with customer equipment preparation to meet critical operational schedules.
  • Participate in shift handovers to ensure continuity of operations across rotational crews.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and efficient work area utilizing 6S principles.
  • Support emergency and high-priority operational requests when required.

Safety Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate an unwavering commitment to Baker Hughes HSE standards.
  • Stop work whenever unsafe conditions or behaviors are observed.
  • Participate in Job Safety Analyses (JSAs), Toolbox Talks, and risk assessments.
  • Properly utilize all required PPE and follow Arctic environmental safety requirements.
  • Report all incidents, near misses, and safety observations promptly.
  • Promote an interdependent safety culture focused on protecting personnel, equipment, and the environment.

Quality Responsibilities

  • Follow all documented AMO procedures, engineering requirements, and quality standards.
  • Ensure equipment is assembled and maintained to specification prior to release.
  • Verify traceability and documentation requirements are complete and accurate.
  • Participate in audits, inspections, and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Maintain a strong focus on first-time quality and operational reliability.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum 2 years of mechanical, industrial, oilfield, maintenance, manufacturing, or related experience.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, procedures, and work instructions.
  • Experience with hand tools, precision measuring devices, hydraulic systems, and mechanical assemblies.
  • Ability to work safely in a physically demanding environment.
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds regularly and perform extended standing, bending, climbing, and manual tasks.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain required North Slope certifications and site access requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous AMO, drilling, completions, intervention, or oilfield service experience.
  • Experience working in remote rotational environments.
  • Forklift certification.
  • Overhead crane operation experience.
  • Pressure testing experience.
  • SAP or computerized maintenance management system experience.
  • Familiarity with Baker Hughes products and services.

Key Competencies

  • Safety Leadership
  • Mechanical Aptitude
  • Quality Focus
  • Teamwork and Collaboration
  • Problem Solving
  • Accountability
  • Customer Focus
  • Adaptability
  • Attention to Detail
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset

Working Conditions

This position is based in Prudhoe Bay, Alaska, and requires working in a remote Arctic environment. Employees will work a rotational schedule of 21 days on and 21 days off, including 12-hour shifts with overtime opportunities. Work may be performed indoors and outdoors (minimal) in extreme weather conditions and requires strict adherence to all safety and environmental standards.


Work in a way that works for you

We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone.


Working with us

Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.


Working for you

Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input.


Join us, and you can expect:

  • Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
  • Comprehensive private medical care options

  • Tailored financial programs
  • Additional elected or voluntary benefits

title: Senior Consultant – Data Engineer | Melbourne
description:
Build modern data solutions and take greater ownership of client delivery.

We’re looking for aSenior Data Engineerwho combines strong technical foundations with the confidence to work directly with clients and help turn complex requirements into practical, scalable solutions.

This is a hands-on consulting role for someone who wants to stay close to the technology while taking greater ownership across delivery, client engagement and solution design. You’ll work across modern data and analytics projects, contribute throughout the full delivery lifecycle, and build experience across a range of platforms, industries and client environments.

If you’re ready to broaden your technical exposure, strengthen your consulting capability and have more influence over how solutions are shaped and delivered, this could be a great next step.

What you’ll do

You’ll work alongside clients and Altis teams to understand business challenges, shape the right technical approach and deliver high-quality data and analytics solutions.

You’ll:

  • Deliver Data & Analytics solutions from discovery and requirements through to implementation and support
  • Work directly with clients to understand business needs and translate them into practical technical solutions
  • Contribute to workshops, solution design sessions and technical reviews
  • Design and build data pipelines, data models, database structures and data stores
  • Integrate and analyse data from multiple sources to support reporting, analytics and decision-making
  • Develop reports, dashboards, visualisations and actionable insights
  • Apply strong SQL, data modelling and engineering practices across client projects
  • Support testing, deployment, User Acceptance Testing and post-production activities
  • Contribute to project planning, estimation and delivery scheduling
  • Take ownership of your work while supporting and sharing knowledge with others
  • Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Help clients successfully adopt the solutions we deliver through training and knowledge transfer

The experience you’ll bring

We’re looking for someone with strong Data & Analytics foundations, hands-on delivery experience, and the confidence to contribute meaningfully in a client environment.

Your experience may include:

  • Strong SQL capability
  • Data modelling and database design
  • Data integration and modern ETL/ELT approaches
  • Experience with cloud technologies, such as Snowflake, Databricks and/or Google Cloud
  • Reporting, analytics and visualisation solutions
  • Translating business requirements into technical solutions
  • Working directly with clients or business stakeholders
  • Testing, implementation and production support

You don’t need to have worked with every technology we use. We’re more interested in strong technical foundations, sound judgement and your ability to learn and adapt across different client environments.

Why Altis?

For more than 25 years, Altis has focused on one thing: helping organisations create better outcomes through data.

We're Australian-owned and technology-agnostic, which means our consultants can focus on solving the right problem rather than selling a particular platform.

At Altis you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Work across varied and challenging Data & AI engagements
  • Learn from experienced specialists across consulting, engineering, analytics and AI
  • Build your capability through ongoing learning and career development
  • Work in a collaborative environment where you're encouraged to challenge ideas and contribute your own
  • Work flexibly through our hybrid model
  • Access health and wellbeing support for you and your family

Access paid parental leave and our reward and recognition program

Our values — Be Curious, Own It, Lead with Heart and Discover a Way — shape how we work with our clients and with each other.

Your next move doesn't need to tick every box

If the role sounds like the direction you want your career to take but you don't meet every requirement listed, we'd still encourage you to apply.

Different experiences and perspectives make our teams stronger.

If you need adjustments or support at any stage of our recruitment process, let our Talent Acquisition team know and we'll work with you.

Position Summary:

· Attend to and care for birds in growout houses; inspect birds to determine quality and progress by performing the below duties.

· Must be able to complete all production paperwork or data entry into a computer based tracking system or any tasks related to the job function.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

· Feeds and waters birds according to schedules; walks floors daily to inspect water lines, pick up and dispose of mortality, and examine birds for signs of a week or sick bird (20%)

· Transfer birds from trailer to growout house from outside Team Member to inside Team Member and place in appropriate pens (10%)

· Calculate pen size based on bird numbers to be received and adjust to provide adequate feeder, water, and space for birds; place pen partitions according to calculations; manage floor by turning/adding shavings and checking ventilation (15%)

· Sorting birds by breast size (fleshing); assist farm crew with killvac; collecting weekly samples for corporate lab of cleft pallet swabs, feed, and shavings samples (15%)

· Weigh the birds and record weights in uniformity (15%)

· inspects birds to determine quality and progress by weighing birds weekly; maintenance and sanitation of breakroom, boot rooms, equipment, and vehicles; vaccinate and isolate birds to affect disease control program; administer medications to birds as needed, such as vitamins, etc; properly euthanize weak/ill birds in accordance with company policy (10%)

· Performs simple math [addition, subtraction, multiplication and division] as part of recording information according to instructions and Cobb standards ie: bird weight, medications, feed intake, and mortality (15%)

Biosecurity/Animal Welfare Requirements:

· The jobsite is a biosecure environment which requires showering, changing clothing and footwear before entering the facility. Appropriate clothing and footwear is provided by the Company. No jewelry may be worn on the jobsite except for medical ID jewelry and body piercings covered by appropriate clothing. Must be willing to sign an agreement to avoid any avian species (chickens, ducks, birds, etc.). Must be willing to sign and abide by the Company Biosecurity and Company Animal Welfare Guidelines.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

· Physical: Must use safe lifting techniques. Must regularly lift and/or move, up to 50 pounds items such as bags of shavings, occasionally up to 75 pounds when moving/handling coops of birds, feed buckets, bags of mortality, etc; tools, such as pallet jack, may be required to occasionally lift and/or move up to 2000 pounds such as shavings, etc. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand majority of shift on multiple floor surfaces (i.e. concrete floor, shavings); walk; sit; use hands to handle or feel objects and controls; reach with hands and arms; balance; climbing/ladder usage; stoop/bend up to 300 times per day; talk or hear; drive a vehicle within the farm complex. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision; distance vision; color vision; peripheral vision; depth perception; and the ability to adjust focus. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to maneuver around pens and over fencing up to 24 inches high through the chicken house. The successful candidate(s) must be willing and able to perform the physical requirements of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.

· Tools and Equipment:

· Environment: Required to work on wet, slippery surfaces and also work in hot, dry, extreme dusty, dark, wet, icy, snowy and cold environments.

· Personal Protective Equipment Required: Safety goggles, face shield, chemical gloves, waterproof apron, headlamps, and rubber boots are required. Ear plugs will be used as required. NIOSH approved N95 particulate respirators will be worn as needed.

· Chemicals Commonly Used: Disinfectants such as Synergize, Lysol, Clorox wipes, bleach, etc.

· Safety: Will be trained to recognize and comply with all safety procedures.
