title: Senior Managing Consultant – Data Engineer - (Databricks)| Brisbane
description:
Build modern data solutions. Lead client outcomes. Help grow our Queensland capability.

At Altis Consulting, we're looking for a hands-on Data Engineer who enjoys being close to both the technology and the client.

This is a role for someone who can take a business problem, shape the right technical approach, and lead it through to a practical outcome. You'll work across modern data platforms and engineering solutions while building trusted relationships with clients and helping develop the consultants around you.

What you'll do

  • Design scalable data platforms, pipelines, integration and analytics solutions.
  • Work across modern cloud technologies including Databricks, Snowflake and the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem.
  • Translate complex business requirements into clear technical solutions.
  • Guide and mentor consultants and contribute to a strong engineering culture.
  • Build trusted relationships with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to create additional value for clients and contribute to proposals and solution shaping.

What you'll bring

You'll have strong experience across data engineering, architecture or analytics consulting and be comfortable operating directly with clients.

We're particularly interested in experience across:

  • Modern data engineering and data modelling
  • Cloud data platforms - Databricks, Snowflake, Azure or comparable technologies
  • Databricks experience essential
  • SQL and modern data integration/ELT patterns
  • Data quality, governance and sustainable engineering practices
  • Leading projects or small technical teams
  • Consulting, advisory or client-facing delivery

You don't need to have worked with every technology we use. We're more interested in strong foundations, sound technical judgement and an ability to learn.

The person we're looking for

You enjoy solving ambiguous problems, can challenge thinking respectfully and know when a technically impressive solution isn't necessarily the right business solution.

You'll be comfortable talking architecture with engineers one minute and explaining the value of the solution to an executive stakeholder the next.

title: Blackstone Multi-Asset Investing (BXMA)- Investment Product Specialist, Vice President
description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at . Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

Job Description: Blackstone Multi-Asset Investing (BXMA) - Product Management, Vice President

Business Unit Overview

Blackstone Multi-Asset Investing (BXMA) manages $109 billion across a diversified set of businesses. We strive to generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our clients across market cycles. Our strategies include Absolute Return, Multi-Strategy, Total Portfolio Management, and Public Real Assets.

Product Management Team Overview:

Within BXMA, the Product Management team sits at the intersection of the investment and client-facing organizations and is responsible for producing all investment product content. The team partners closely with various Investment teams, Client Investment Strategy, and Institutional Client Solutions (ICS) to shape how our strategies are understood, positioned, and delivered to the market.

Product Management is responsible for the development, governance, and continuous enhancement of all client- and prospect-facing investment materials - including marketing presentations, portfolio and performance reviews, recurring and customized reporting, due diligence questionnaires, and responses to analytical and product-related inquiries.

The team operates in a high-velocity, deadline-driven environment shaped by both recurring client engagements and ad-hoc commercial needs. The team’s mandate combines portfolio performance and risk analysis with strong data visualization and written communication skills to produce high-quality investor-facing content. Success in this role requires moving seamlessly from portfolio analysis and performance calculations to drafting investor commentary and producing polished client-facing materials.

Role Overview – Vice President, Product Management
The role will lead day-to-day Product Management coverage for the Total Portfolio Management product line, serving as a primary product expert and key partner to commercial and investment stakeholders. This role is central in shaping how the strategy is represented to the market, ensuring that product narratives, performance communication, and client-facing materials are analytically sound, commercially effective, and executed with consistently high quality.

This position is expected to independently execute analytical workstreams and take ownership of high-profile client deliverables. Success in this role requires a balance of product and investment knowledge, hands-on data analytics, written/visual communication, and collaborative partnership.

Key Dimensions of the Role

Data Analysis & Content Creation: Perform hands-on analysis of portfolio performance and risk data to produce client-ready deliverables. Build, update, format, and quality-control portfolio review materials, fundraising presentations, and client reporting decks. Independently investigate large and complex datasets, validate calculations, reconcile discrepancies, and synthesize findings into clear, investor-ready conclusions. Translate quantitative analysis into written commentary, data visualizations, presentations, and reporting materials that accurately communicate portfolio positioning, performance outcomes, and market developments.

Quality Control: Own the review and validation of portfolio analytics, performance attribution, benchmark comparisons, and client reporting metrics. Investigate anomalies, reconcile results across data sources, and ensure analytical integrity before external distribution. Improve templates, data pipelines, and processes, raising the overall consistency and professionalism of deliverables over time.

Product Knowledge: Develop strong expertise across assigned portfolios, performance drivers, and product characteristics to advise stakeholders with credibility and precision. Serve as a primary product partner to Client Service and Sales teams as they address investor inquiries, client situations, and fundraising needs. Work closely with the investment team, commercial leadership, and senior Product Management leadership to translate investment thinking into clear, accurate, and commercially effective materials that communicate the strategy’s positioning and performance story.

Leadership and Collaboration: Manage competing priorities across recurring reporting, fundraising initiatives, and ad hoc client requests to ensure timely delivery. Provide mentorship and knowledge sharing to junior team members and contribute to a collaborative, accountable team culture. Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Operations, and Technology teams to ensure investor-facing materials are accurate, approved, and delivered on time.

Role Requirements & Profile

Experience

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in investment management, product management, portfolio/risk analytics, client portfolio management, or a related analytical or product-adjacent function.

  • Demonstrated experience producing investor-facing materials under deadline-driven conditions.

  • Experience working with both investment professionals and commercial/client-facing teams within an asset management or institutional investment environment.

  • Familiarity with multi-asset or institutional investment products preferred.

  • Experience mentoring or guiding junior team members.

Technical & Analytical Capabilities

  • Strong knowledge of portfolio construction, performance measurement methodologies, attribution analysis, benchmarks, and risk metrics.

  • Advanced Excel skills, including experience performing and validating complex portfolio analyses, investigating data quality issues, and reviewing analytical outputs with a high degree of accuracy.

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with large datasets using Excel. Basic familiarity and comfort working with data tools such as SQL and Python.

  • Strong PowerPoint and presentation-development skills, including experience producing polished investor-facing materials under tight deadlines.

Core Attributes & Leadership Traits

  • Investment Acumen. Demonstrates intellectual curiosity about markets and strategies and can engage credibly with investment professionals.

  • Analytical Rigor. Approaches work with structured thinking and numerical precision.

  • Commercial Awareness. Understands client needs and aligns deliverables with business priorities while maintaining analytical rigor.

  • High Standards for Quality. Maintains strong expectations for accuracy and professional polish.

  • Attention to Detail. Ensures precision in numbers, formatting, and presentation consistency.

  • Organizational Discipline. Effectively manages multiple concurrent priorities in a deadline-driven environment.

title: Acquisition Associate
description:
About Fifteen Group Capital

Formed in 1992, Fifteen Group Capital LLC is a real estate private investment firm with offices in Miami, Florida and Los Angeles, California. We specialize in opportunity-driven, value-added acquisitions across multifamily, commercial, and mixed-use assets in Florida, Texas, California, and the broader Sunbelt. We are not a large institution — we are a lean, high-performing team of investment professionals who move quickly, think creatively, and build lasting value in markets where others see complexity.

Our multifamily portfolio extends across multiple states and includes workforce housing communities in Los Angeles, where our team sits at the center of our investment and asset management activity. If you are looking for a role with real responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership, and a clear path to grow within a platform that is actively expanding, we want to hear from you.

The Opportunity

Fifteen Group Capital is seeking an Acquisitions Associate to play a key role in sourcing, underwriting, and executing real estate acquisition opportunities across our portfolio markets in Florida, California, and Texas. This is a high-impact role for a sharp, deal-driven professional who thrives on financial analysis and transaction execution.

Working directly with the Director of Investments and senior leadership, you will lead underwriting, manage due diligence, cultivate broker relationships, and help drive the firm's acquisition strategy across all three markets. Based at our Miami headquarters, you will evaluate and execute opportunities across our target markets with regular travel for property tours, broker meetings, and due diligence.

What You'll Do

Deal Sourcing & Origination

  • Cultivate and maintain relationships with brokers, owners, and deal flow sources across Florida, California, and Texas.
  • Proactively source acquisition opportunities through market outreach and relationship development across all three target markets.
  • Screen inbound opportunities against investment criteria and prepare initial deal assessments.
  • Monitor target markets for on-market and off-market opportunities and track competitive transactions.
  • Manage the deal pipeline and maintain a database of opportunities and broker contacts.

Underwriting & Financial Analysis

  • Lead financial underwriting and modeling for acquisition opportunities.
  • Develop detailed cash flow projections, sensitivity analyses, and return calculations.
  • Analyze rent rolls, operating statements, and historical financial performance for target acquisitions.
  • Underwrite value-add business plans including renovation budgets and rent growth assumptions.
  • Model various debt structures, joint venture waterfalls, and exit scenarios.

Due Diligence Management

  • Manage the comprehensive due diligence process for acquisitions under contract.
  • Coordinate third-party reports including property condition assessments, environmental reviews, and appraisals.
  • Review and analyze lease files, service contracts, and operating agreements.
  • Conduct physical property inspections, document findings, and identify key risks and opportunities.
  • Prepare due diligence summaries and recommendations for investment committee review.

Market Research & Transaction Execution

  • Conduct in-depth market research and submarket analysis across FL, CA, and TX using CoStar, RealPage, and other data platforms.
  • Develop market intelligence reports and acquisition theses for target submarkets.
  • Support negotiation of letters of intent and purchase and sale agreements.
  • Coordinate the transaction process from contract execution through closing, including lender and legal coordination.
  • Prepare investment committee memoranda, deal presentations, and lender packages.

What We're Looking For

Experience & Education

  • 4–6 years of experience in real estate acquisitions, investment banking, private equity, or commercial real estate.
  • Demonstrated experience underwriting and closing real estate transactions.
  • Expert-level financial modeling and quantitative analysis skills.
  • Deep understanding of real estate acquisition principles, valuation methods, and transaction structures.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Real Estate, Economics, Business Administration, or related field required.
  • Master's degree, MBA, or advanced degree from a top-tier program a strong plus.
  • Experience with multifamily or commercial real estate acquisitions in California, Florida, or Texas preferred.
  • Background with institutional investors, private equity, or family office real estate preferred.
  • CFA, CAIA, or progress toward designation a plus. Argus certification and real estate license in Florida or California a plus.

Skills & Strengths

  • A self-starter with a deal-driven mentality and the ability to manage multiple live transactions simultaneously.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with professional presence in front of brokers, lenders, and senior leadership.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities with rigorous attention to detail.
  • Ability to operate in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with high accountability and minimal oversight.
  • Proven relationship-building skills with brokers, owners, and capital sources across target markets.

Technical Proficiency

  • Expert-level Microsoft Excel for complex financial modeling and investment analysis.
  • Proficiency with real estate data and analytics platforms.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation. Base salary of $125,000–$150,000 commensurate with experience, plus bonus.
  • Direct Deal Exposure. A front-row seat to every acquisition — from initial sourcing through closing — with real ownership over the process.
  • Access to Leadership. Work directly with the Director of Investments and firm principals on live transactions and investment strategy.
  • Comprehensive Benefits. Medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with company match; paid time off and holidays.
  • Market Reach. Active deal pipeline across Florida, California, and Texas with regular travel for property tours, broker meetings, and market visits.
  • Entrepreneurial Culture. A lean, fast-moving team that values decisiveness, smart capital deployment, and giving people real ownership over their work.

About This Search

Please do not contact company principals directly, as this will disqualify you from consideration.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Job Summary

The CNC Programmer II is responsible for the creation of CAD/CAM programs and conversion of files from DXF and PDF formats on AutoCAD, Mastercam, and Zund Cut Center software. The Programmer will set up and run the CNC Mill and Zund digital equipment to process jobs using a variety of materials, such as Q2, Cirlex, Graphfoil, and Copperfoil, while ensuring quality standards are met.

Key Responsibilities

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Under minimal supervision, must be able to perform a variety of job duties including, but not limited to:


  • Create CAD/CAM programs and be able to convert the files from DXF and PDF formats.
  • Create and organize programs and transfer files.
  • Set up machines, operate multiple machining centers and equipment.
  • Perform machine setups, including tooling selection, fixture loading, and program loading.

  • Troubleshoot machining, tooling, and production issues to minimize downtime and scrap.
  • Optimize machining processes, including feeds, speeds, tooling, and setup strategies, to improve performance and throughput.

  • Experience operating and/or setting up CNC Mill or manual machining equipment in a manufacturing environment.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, engineering drawings, and GD&T requirements.
  • Experience using precision measuring instruments including micrometers, calipers, indicators, and height gages.
  • Strong understanding of machining fundamentals, tooling, feeds, speeds, and offsets.
  • Mechanical aptitude with strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to troubleshoot machining and production issues, while optimizing programs and machining efficiency.
  • Ability to deal with and solve problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.
  • Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals
  • Self-motivated with the ability to achieve results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Commitment to workplace safety and maintaining a clean work environment.
  • Experience using Microsoft Suite.
  • Advanced experience with Zund Cut Center software.
  • Experience operating and/or setting up Zund digital cutting equipment (800, 1600, 2500, or comparable models) in a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong understanding of digital cutting fundamentals, including material loading/registration, cut parameter setting, and tool head selection/changeover.

Preferred Skills

  • Previous experience working on 3-spindle or 4-spindle milling equipment and/or CO2 laser machines.
  • Previous experience working on ESI CNC Laser machines, digital cutters, or hybrid laser equipment.
  • Previous experience working with Q2, Cirlex, Graphfoil, Copperfoil, or other specialty materials.
  • Journeyman machinist experience.
  • Previous experience working with digital cutting materials, such as Kapton, Mylar, polyimide, foam, silicone rubber, hard rubber, Fujipoly, laminated materials, cardboard, and coroplast.
  • Experience with Zund tool heads (drag knife, oscillating knife, router, full cut, kiss-cut, creasing wheel) or comparable digital cutting tooling (EOT, POT).
  • Zund Cut Center training highly desired.

Education Requirements

  • High School Degree or General Education Degree; or three (3) to five (5) years of related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Mastercam or CNC programming certificate highly desired.
  • Five (5) + years of CNC programming experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Five (5) to seven (7) years of 3-axis CNC operator in a manufacturing environment.
  • Blueprint reading and/or GDT certificate desired.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to sit and stand for 6 to 8 hours.
  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. occasionally
  • Ability to perform visual inspection to perform close‑up inspection tasks for 4 to 6 hours.

Working Conditions

title: Service to the Armed Forces (SAF) Specialist, Mobile
description:
Please use Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox when accessing Candidate Home.

By joining the American Red Cross you will touch millions of lives every year and experience the greatness of the human spirit at its best. Are you ready to be part of the world's largest humanitarian network?

Join us—Where your Career is a Force for Good!

Job Description:

WHY CHOOSE US?

Joining The American Red Cross is like nothing else – it’s as much something you feel as something you do. You become a vital part of the world’s largest humanitarian network. Joining a team of welcoming individuals who are exceptional, yet unassuming. Diverse, yet uncompromising in unity. You grow your career within a movement that matters, where success is measured in people helped, communities made whole, and individuals equipped to never stop changing lives and situations for the better.

When you choose to be a force for good, you’ll have mentors who empower your growth along a purposeful career path. You align your life’s work with an ongoing mission that’s bigger than all of us. As you care for others, you’re cared for with competitive compensation and benefits. You join a community that respects who you are away from work as much as what you do while at work.


Where Your Career is a Force for Good!

The American Red Cross is currently seeking a Service to the Armed Forces (SAF) Specialist, Mobile at the Fort Meade Army Base in Maryland. This position is part of our mobile staff which requires meeting strict medical and security clearances prior to employment. In this role worldwide deployment is a condition of employment. Mobile staff members typically deploy for 6 months at a time, approximately once every 18-24 months, and can be sent to any military base in the world. This role is not eligible for relocation assistance.

The salary range for this position is (Maryland): $66,220 – 77,000.

Note that American Red Cross salaries are aligned to the specific geographic location in which the work is primarily performed. Other factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills, how many years of experience you have and comparison to other employees already in this role.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW:

Manages and administers the delivery of American Red Cross services to meet the needs of United States military members, veterans, and their families in accordance with Red Cross policies and procedures. Also responsible for the management and administration of American Red Cross Service to the Armed Forces (SAF) and International Services (IS) U.S. programs and services to include International Humanitarian Law (IHL), Youth Action Campaign (YAC), and Restoring Family Links (RFL), within their area of jurisdiction. This is accomplished through managing volunteers and working with other Red Cross departments.

Relationship Management and Community Outreach

  • Build strong and sustained relationships with military leadership, command staff, and installation partners.
  • Conduct outreach through command briefings, education sessions, presentations, and one-on-one engagements.
  • Increase Red Cross visibility using Armed Forces Network, base bulletins, social media, and approved local marketing channels.
  • Represent the Red Cross at official functions, ceremonies, and community events.

Volunteer Management

  • Manage all phases of the volunteer engagement cycle: recruitment, onboarding, training, supervision, recognition, and offboarding.
  • Recruit and mentor leadership volunteers to support Red Cross program delivery across SAF/IS, Disaster Cycle Services, Training Services, and Blood Services.
  • Utilize the Volunteer Connection platform to manage volunteer documentation, communication, and compliance.
  • Promote a positive, inclusive volunteer environment aligned with Red Cross values.

Service Delivery Management

  • Ensure consistent and high-quality delivery of Red Cross programs to service members, veterans, and their families.
  • Supervise volunteer service delivery teams to ensure strong program impact and alignment with mission needs.
  • Coordinate educational briefings, community workshops, and special events supporting SAF/IS objectives.
  • Provide family support services including wellness check-ins, emergency communications, and referrals to community resources.
  • Update emergency communication casework (SAF Hero Care Network Services) rosters, unit contacts, and case logs in alignment with mission guidelines.
  • Promote and implement International Services programs within the local community.

Mobile Deployment Readiness and Operational Support

  • Serve as a deployable member of the SAF Mobile Team for a 6-month overseas assignment.
  • Support U.S. military operations across the Middle East, Africa, and Eastern Europe.
  • Live and work on military installations, following all base policies, customs, and operational requirements.
  • Maintain full deployment readiness, including required medical clearances, training certifications, and security standards.
  • Support emergency, surge, and disaster operations as part of the Hero Care Network Contingency Team.
  • Participate in readiness drills, maintain casework proficiency, and respond to emergency communications and crisis situations as needed.

Financial and Reporting Management

  • Monitor service delivery outcomes and ensure accurate documentation and reporting of program activities.
  • Identify trends, assess service needs, and contribute recommendations for program improvement.
  • Collaborate with Red Cross leadership on deployment feedback, staff mentorship, and onboarding support for mobile team members.
  • Assist with travel coordination, logistics, and reporting as needed for mobile deployments.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED:

Education: Bachelor's degree required or equivalent combination of education and related experience required.

Experience: Minimum 5 years of related experience or equivalent combination of education and related experience required.

Managerial Experience: N/A

* Combination of candidate’s education and general experience satisfies requirements so long as the total years equate to description’s minimum education and general experience years combined (Management experience cannot be substituted).

Skills and Abilities: Requires strong computer skills. Public speaking skills and the ability to communicate effectively verbally and in writing are required. Must have strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work well in an individual or team environment. The ability to balance multiple priorities is essential. Familiarity with military culture, regulations and protocol is strongly desired. Experience with American Red Cross programs and services are desired. Ability to work on a team.

Physical Requirements:

Physical requirements are those present in normal office environment conditions. Operational flexibility is required to meet sudden and unpredictable needs. Ability to use a personal computer, applicable software, and office equipment for sustained periods of time. May include sitting for long periods of time, driving a vehicle, and working under challenging conditions.

In addition to routine job responsibilities, employees may be assigned to deployment activities that require the ability to safely perform the physical demands associated with domestic and international travel and work in austere, remote, or resource-limited environments. Deployment assignments may involve prolonged standing or walking, navigating uneven terrain, climbing stairs, handling equipment and personal gear, extended work hours, exposure to environmental and operational challenges, and the use of required personal protective equipment.

Travel: Travel may be required.

DISCLAIMER: The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified.

Mobility Requirements

To be eligible for selection and maintain employment in this position, candidates must meet the following requirements:

  • U.S. citizenship is required. Must be able to obtain a secret security clearance and a no-fee U.S. passport.
  • Worldwide mobility is a condition of employment and an essential function of this position. The ability to meet the medical and physical requirements for deployment to any international installation where the American Red Cross supports U.S. military operations is a condition of employment and an essential function of this position. Must accept work assignments anywhere in the world, including conflict areas, where the American Red Cross is providing services to members of the military and their families.
  • Must meet strict medical and physical requirements, including immunizations required by the U.S. military (including physical examination, laboratory testing, hearing, vision, and dental examination, and required immunizations). May be required to wear military uniforms and live and work in harsh and stressful environment in conflict areas.
  • Periodically accompanies the military on deployments.

WHAT WILL GIVE YOU THE COMPETITIVE EDGE:

Ideal candidates will have a passion for supporting military members with the physical stamina and emotional capacity to live and work alongside deployed military members in harsh climates and difficult environments.

Core Competencies

  • Adaptability: Successful candidates must adjust to new situations quickly and have the ability to tackle the challenges these situations present.
  • Independent Problem Solving: Successful candidates are capable of handling high-pressure situations by knowing who to engage in dialogue and up with actionable solutions
  • Teamwork: Successful candidates have the ability to collaborate with team members, volunteers, and military personnel to achieve SAF/IS mission.
  • Servant Leader: Successful candidates must be leaders who put others and the mission first. Someone who understands that deployment is a hardship, and our mission is to support our military personnel in uncomfortable situations and circumstances.

BENEFITS FOR YOU:

As a mission-based organization, we believe our team needs great support to do great work. Our comprehensive package includes:
• Medical, Dental Vision plans
• Health Spending Accounts & Flexible Spending Accounts
• PTO: Starting at 15 days a year; based on type of job and tenure
• Holidays: 11 paid holidays comprised of six core holidays and five floating holidays
• 401K with up to 6% match
• Paid Family Leave
• Employee Assistance
• Disability and Insurance: Short + Long Term
• Service Awards and recognition

Apply now! Joining our team will provide you with the opportunity to

make your career a force for good!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, San Diego Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and any other applicable state and local laws.

  • Stay Safe and Compliant: Embrace the physical nature of the role—including lifting, bending, and moving product—while following all safety protocols, operational guidelines, and company vehicle policies to ensure safe and responsible driving across the territory.

Key Competencies Required:

Job Description
Pay: $17.00/Hour
Part-Time (Afternoon)
Reporting to the Clubhouse Director, the Program Aide is responsible for implementing, leading, directing, and evaluating youth programs and activities in one or more program areas. This role involves providing supervision to members, participating in daily functions, and assisting with the smooth operation of the Clubhouse.
The essential job duties for this role include:
Program Management
  • Lead and implement programs and activities that support Youth Development Outcomes.
  • Promote and stimulate members’ interest in core area program participation.
  • Ensure members are encouraged to participate in a variety of program areas/activities and receive respect, recognition, instruction, and constructive feedback to develop skills.
  • Ensure program objectives are completed within club-specific requirements, resources, and timelines under the guidance of the Clubhouse Director, Assistant Clubhouse Director, and/or Specialist staff.
  • Participate in planning programs and activities.
  • Support programs managed by fellow Youth Development Professionals.
Member Management
  • Engage with members, families, Youth Development Professionals, and volunteers to receive and provide information, discuss issues, explain guidelines and instructions, report, and facilitate the implementation of programs.
  • Participate in meetings and training to promote alignment and collaboration with other departments and Clubhouses.
  • Demonstrate leadership in relation to members, parents, Youth Development Professionals, and visitors conduct and safety to ensure a proper environment for member development.
  • Serve as a mentor/role model for members.
  • Provide direction to members by establishing and enforcing standards, expectations, and consequences for inappropriate behavior per organizational guidelines.
  • Apply corrective action that is fair, consistent, and age appropriate and provide written documentation and support when necessary for conduct/behavior issues.
Clubhouse Support
  • Assist in the cleanliness and safe operation of all program areas, Clubhouse, and grounds.
  • Work cohesively with all Youth Development Professionals to foster a positive environment for staff and members.
  • Assist and participate in all aspects of the Clubhouse including, but not limited to all program areas, programs, cleaning, or other scheduled duties as assigned.
  • Enforce and abide by Clubhouse rules, organization policies, procedures and practices.
Administrative Duties
  • Assist with completing required documentation for programs.
  • Assist with compiling and producing accurate tracking of programs and program metrics, including but not limited to, monthly reports, program schedules, and daily attendance.
  • Assist with other Clubhouse administrative duties as needed.
Other Duties
  • Participate in and assist with operational events and training.

title: Lead Endoscopy Tech

This is a Stanford Health Care Tri-Valley job.

A Brief Overview
The Lead Endoscopy Technician serves as the technical and operational lead for Endoscopy Services and functions as an advanced subject matter expert supporting procedural operations, patient care activities, endoscopy equipment management, and workflow coordination. The Lead provides day-to-day guidance to Endoscopy Technicians, promotes standard work, supports staff onboarding and competency validation, and assists leadership with operational readiness and quality initiatives.

Reporting to the Manager of Endoscopy Services, the Lead Endoscopy Technician collaborates with physicians, nursing, anesthesia, sterile processing, infection prevention, scheduling, and support services to ensure safe, efficient, reliable, patient-centered care. The Lead serves as a resource for troubleshooting, training, equipment readiness, procedural support, and continuous improvement activities. This role does not have direct personnel management responsibilities but provides operational leadership and technical direction for the Endoscopy Technician team.

Locations
Stanford Health Care Tri-Valley

What you will do

Daily Operations and Workflow Coordination

  • Coordinate daily technical workflow and assignments in collaboration with nursing leadership and procedural teams.

  • Assist with room utilization, procedural readiness, equipment availability, supply management, and turnaround efficiency.

  • Serve as the primary technical resource for problem-solving and escalation of equipment or workflow concerns.

  • Support daily huddles and communicate operational priorities, staffing needs, and procedural updates.

  • Assist with coordination of add-on cases, schedule changes, and case flow optimization.

Clinical and Procedural Support

  • Perform advanced endoscopy technician functions and provide procedural support during diagnostic and therapeutic endoscopic procedures.

  • Anticipate procedural needs through knowledge of endoscopic anatomy, clinical indications, and physician preferences.

  • Support proper specimen handling, labeling, transport, and documentation according to departmental standards.

  • Assist with specialized procedures, advanced therapeutic interventions, and emerging technologies as appropriate.

  • Monitor the procedural environment and communicate safety concerns, breaks in technique, or equipment issues immediately.

Technical Resource and Staff Development

  • Serve as lead preceptor for orientation and onboarding of new Endoscopy Technicians.

  • Provide day-to-day coaching, mentoring, and technical guidance to staff.

  • Assist leadership with competency validation, skills assessment, and tracking of required education.

  • Reinforce departmental policies, regulatory standards, standard work, and best practices.

  • Model professional behaviors that promote teamwork, accountability, service excellence, and patient-centered care.

Equipment, Reprocessing, and Regulatory Support

  • Monitor readiness and proper functioning of endoscopic equipment, accessories, and procedural technologies.

  • Assist with troubleshooting, reporting, and follow-up of equipment failures and service issues.

  • Promote compliance with endoscope handling, storage, transportation, and high-level disinfection processes.

  • Support inventory management, par-level monitoring, and supply utilization initiatives.

  • Collaborate with Infection Prevention, Sterile Processing, and Quality teams to maintain regulatory compliance and survey readiness.

Quality, Safety, and Performance Improvement

  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives focused on patient safety, workflow efficiency, patient experience, and operational performance.

  • Identify opportunities to improve procedural readiness, room turnover, supply utilization, and staff communication.

  • Support data collection, audits, competency monitoring, and corrective action activities.

  • Assist with investigation and follow-up of safety events, equipment concerns, and process deviations.

  • Promote a culture of safety, transparency, continuous learning, and high reliability.

Key Performance Metrics

  • Procedural readiness and room start-time performance.

  • Endoscopy room turnover efficiency and throughput.

  • Equipment availability and procedural support reliability.

  • Staff onboarding and competency completion.

  • Regulatory readiness and compliance with endoscope handling standards.

  • Supply utilization and inventory accuracy.

  • ·Safety event reporting and issue resolution.

  • Patient experience and procedural team satisfaction.

C-I-CARE: Employee must perform all duties and responsibilities in accordance with the C-I-CARE Standards of the Hospital. C-I-CARE is the foundation of Stanford Health Care Tri-Valley's patient experience and represents a framework for patient-centered interactions.


Education Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED required

  • Associate's Degree preferred


Experience Qualifications

  • Minimum of three (3) years of progressively responsible endoscopy technician experience required.

  • Demonstrated expertise in advanced endoscopic procedures, procedural support, equipment troubleshooting, and workflow coordination.

  • Previous experience serving as a preceptor, mentor, trainer, charge technician, or informal team lead preferred.


Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Advanced knowledge of endoscopy procedures, anatomy and physiology, endoscopic equipment, and procedural workflows.

  • Knowledge of endoscope handling, infection prevention practices, and high-level disinfection standards.

  • Ability to coordinate workflow and prioritize competing operational demands.

  • Strong communication, mentoring, coaching, and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to identify operational issues and recommend effective solutions.

  • Ability to support quality improvement, patient safety, and regulatory compliance initiatives.

  • Proficiency with electronic health record systems and departmental technology platforms.

  • · Ability to work effectively with physicians, nurses, anesthesia providers, and interdisciplinary teams.


Licenses and Certifications

  • BLS - Basic Life Support required

These principles apply to ALL employees:

title: Library Access Services Assistant
description:
ABOUT THE LUCAS MUSEUM OF NARRATIVE ART
Opening in September 2026, the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art is dedicated to illustrated storytelling. Founded by George Lucas and Mellody Hobson, the museum’s collection features works by artists including Norman Rockwell, Kadir Nelson, Jessie Willcox Smith, N. C. Wyeth, Beatrix Potter, Judith F. Baca, Frida Kahlo, and Maxfield Parrish; as well as comic art legends such as Winsor McCay, Jack Kirby, Frank Frazetta, Alison Bechdel, Chris Ware, and R. Crumb; and photographers Gordon Parks, Henri Cartier-Bresson, and Dorothea Lange. The Museum also houses the Lucas Archives, containing models, props, concept art, and costumes from Lucas’s filmmaking career.
Designed by Ma Yansong of MAD with a landscape by Mia Lehrer of Studio-MLA, the Museum is in Exposition Park, Los Angeles, on an 11-acre campus that includes new green space and a 300,000-square-foot building with galleries, two theaters, a library, restaurant, café, retail store, and community spaces.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Library Access Services Assistant is primarily responsible for supporting various aspects of the library’s public and access services activities. This position will be required to work nights, weekends, and holidays as part of the regular schedule

They will play a key public facing role in interacting with a diverse group of library patrons, which include Lucas Museum staff, external researchers, and walk-in visitors.

Working closely with the Access Services Coordinator and reporting to the Library Director, the Library Access Services Assistant will also be responsible for maintaining and organizing library public spaces and materials. They will also perform significant physical duties such as unpacking and packing shipments, shelving books, climbing stairs and ladders, and moving loaded book trucks.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provides patron services to museum staff, external researchers and visitors, including answering routine directional and circulation questions, helping patrons locate or request materials, scanning books for in-house circulation, checking in/out books, paging books and materials, and holds requests
  • Gathers and shelves books and other library materials, including arranging displays and ensuring that all areas are ready for use
  • Accurately shelve, shift, and maintain library materials using both Library of Congress (LC) and Dewey Decimal classification systems
  • Maintains the physical library space by organizing and returning furniture, tidying public and staff areas, removing small amounts of trash, and helping ensure a clean, safe, and welcoming environment for patrons and staff
  • Engage in physical activity: must be able to move heavy items such as boxes of books and equipment, frequently moving boxes weighing up to 50 lbs. Must be able to move about the museum, library and other areas, ascend/descend stairs, and perform tasks that require frequent physical movement throughout the library
  • Monitors and replenishes supplies in assigned service area
  • Opens and closes the library
  • Assists with visitor flow by monitoring and managing lines, directing crowds, and helping maintain a safe, orderly, and welcoming environment during busy periods, events, and peak visitation times
  • Performs other duties related to the day-to-day Library operations as needed

CORE COMPETENCIES

Analytical Rigor: Simplifies complex problems by using critical thinking to evaluate problems, gathering information, incorporating multiple perspectives, understanding causes, and identifying best-possible solutions. Invests time in planning, discovery, and reflection to drive better decisions and more efficient implementations. Adopts an audience-centric approach, understanding the needs of the audience and incorporating them, as appropriate, into the decision.

Courageous Communication: Intentionally works well with others both on the team and cross-functionally to achieve individual, team, department, or organizational goals. Values diverse input and working with others as a way to achieve the best output possible.

Collaborative Excellence: Displays courage when handling difficult conversations and genuinely and intentionally communicates. Relays key messages effectively, targeted to specific audiences. Identifies others' communication styles and perspectives, adjusting language and approach accordingly. Employs active listening to understand, rather than reply. Asks for, integrates, and values feedback from team, peers, and leaders.

Adaptive Resilience: Thrives and grows in a rapidly changing and complex environment. Displays flexibility, activates networks, and adopts a continuous growth mindset to learn from mistakes and bounce back from adversity.

Inclusive Interaction: Actively contributes to an environment in which all employees feel a sense of belonging, valued for their differences and empowered to participate and contribute freely.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The physical demands described below are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods, up to 8 hours per shift.
  • Ability to move throughout multiple Museum locations, including galleries, theaters, outdoor spaces, and other public areas.
  • Ability to maintain an active and visible presence while providing exceptional guest service.
  • Ability to work in a high-volume, public-facing environment with large groups of guests, including school groups, tours, special events, and peak attendance periods, while maintaining professionalism, situational awareness, and composure.
  • Ability to frequently bend, reach, stoop, kneel, crouch, and climb stairs as needed.
  • Ability to occasionally lift, carry, push, and pull items weighing up to 50 pounds, including wheelchairs, stanchions, signage, guest service equipment, and other operational materials.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with guests and colleagues in person, by telephone, and over two-way radio.
  • Ability to work both indoors and outdoors in varying environmental conditions.
  • Ability to maintain awareness of guest activity and surrounding conditions while monitoring galleries, queues, and public spaces.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School graduate or equivalent education
  • 1-2 years or more experience in library, archives, and/or museum best practices
  • Strong customer service skills with the ability to respond to requests and inquiries from a diverse group of patrons in a tactful, courteous and effective way
  • Strong organizational and time-management, punctual and deadline driven
  • Excellent listening skills with the ability to understand and follow directions
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively as a team player, and independently
  • Ability to be responsive to any communications in a timely and professional manner
  • Demonstrated capacity to take direction effectively and contribute positively to a cooperative work environment
  • Adept using computers, including Microsoft Office Suite and library databases, and able to assist others with smartphones, apps, and basic digital tasks
  • Must be able to stand and walk for prolonged periods throughout the workday; ascend and descend stairs; bend; and lift and move boxes of books and other materials weighing up to 50 lbs.
  • Ability to perform tasks that involve repetitive motions, such as scanning barcodes, shelving books, and pushing book carts. Working knowledge shelving in both LC and Dewey call numbers
  • Bilingual ability is a plus, along with a demonstrated sensitivity to and respect for diverse cultures and backgrounds
EQUAL OPPORTUNITY AND OUR COMMITMENT TO DEAIB
The Lucas Museum of Narrative Art embraces diversity and equal opportunity. We are committed to building a team that represents and supports a variety of backgrounds and perspectives. The Lucas Museum fosters a work environment that is free of discrimination and harassment, whether based on race, national origin, gender, gender expression, religion, ethnic background, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other criterion prohibited by applicable federal, state, or local laws. We believe that diversity and inclusion among our team is critical to our success, and we seek to recruit, develop, and retain the best qualified people from a diverse candidate pool. Applications from traditionally underrepresented communities are encouraged.
The statements in this description represent typical elements, criteria, and general work performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required for the job.
***************************************************************************************************************
MISSION AND VISION
The Lucas Museum of Narrative Art is dedicated to the art of illustrated stories. Our mission is to inspire and connect people through the exploration of visual stories and their influences in society.
VALUES
Our internal and external practices are shaped by the following beliefs and behaviors.
People First: We meet people wherever they are (physically, intellectually, emotionally). Our inclusive practice connects who people are and what they find emotional in works of art.
Inspired: We believe that art can move you to feel, think, reflect, and act.
Collaborative: We believe that nimble thinking and working together yield exponential results.
STRATEGIC PRIORITIES
Narrative Art:
Amplify the social impact of storytelling and illustration.
Community:
Connect to a broad and diverse public.
Operational Excellence:
Create a healthy and durable institution.
All staff at the Lucas Museum of Narrative Art lead through a deep commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, both within the Museum and with the communities that we serve.
Salary and titles will be assigned commensurate to the successful candidates’ education and experience. An attractive compensation package will be offered to the successful candidate(s).

title: Network Tier 3 Engineer
description:
Network Tier 3 Engineer

KeenLogic is seeking a Network Tier 3 Engineer to support the U.S. Air Force’s Executive Airlift Communications Network (EACN). EACN provides reliable voice, video, and data communications to senior U.S. Government leaders while airborne. The program includes three operational Air to Global Information Grid Gateways and a Systems Integration Lab used to test upgrades, configuration changes, and new capabilities before deployment to operational environments.

This position will provide advanced network engineering, analysis, design, troubleshooting, and integration support. The engineer will work closely with Government engineers to maintain configuration baselines, evaluate technologies, resolve complex network issues, and support operational gateways at Scott Air Force Base, Joint Base Andrews, and Joint Base Lewis-McChord.

KeenLogic offers Fortune 500-level benefits, including health, dental, and vision insurance, PTO, paid federal holidays, 401(k), and life insurance.

Position Details

  • Anticipated Start: January 2, 2027, with availability required for the beginning of phase-in.
  • Contract Length: Anticipated phase-in from January 2–February 1, 2027, followed by a base period from February 2–September 30, 2027. Four one-year option periods may extend performance through September 30, 2031, with a potential additional six-month extension through March 31, 2032.
  • Location: Scott Air Force Base, Illinois.
  • Onsite Requirements: Onsite support for the operational gateway and Systems Integration Lab.
  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, with an assigned schedule within 6:30 AM–5:30 PM Central Time, excluding federal holidays.
  • Clearance: Active Top Secret security clearance.
  • Operational Designation: Mission-essential support.
  • Travel: Government-approved travel may be required to support other gateway locations, installations, maintenance, or technical coordination.

Required Qualifications

  • Active Top Secret security clearance.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience supporting network engineering and related technical functions.
  • Current Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) certification.
  • Ability to perform duties onsite at Scott Air Force Base.
  • Ability to satisfy applicable DoD workforce, information assurance, and network/computing environment certification requirements associated with assigned duties and privileged access.

Job Expectations

  • Ability to analyze and troubleshoot complex network issues across operational and laboratory environments.
  • Working capability with routing, switching, firewalls, IPv4/IPv6, VLANs, VPNs, encryption, network management, and communications transport technologies relevant to EACN.
  • Ability to maintain configuration control and validate changes in the Systems Integration Lab before operational deployment.
  • Ability to develop technical documentation, support configuration training, and communicate recommendations to Government engineers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform network analysis and design to evaluate new technologies, support emerging requirements, and optimize network performance.
  • Support Government engineers with technical architecture, configuration/change management, and current- and future-state planning.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues affecting operational gateways and the aircraft or platforms accessing them.
  • Establish and maintain gateway baseline configurations and the Systems Integration Lab environment.
  • Install and functionally test software versions, patches, technical orders, and approved configuration changes.
  • Document and test new hardware, software, and configurations in the lab before changes are introduced to operational gateways.
  • Develop and update installation and configuration guides, topology diagrams, checklists, policies, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Support equipment installation, removal, replacement, and configuration training at supported sites.
  • Maintain network and system backups, support fault-tolerant designs and disaster recovery solutions, and perform approved server maintenance.
  • Develop scripts and other technical tools, collect network statistics, and support analysis of availability, utilization, outages, and overall system health.
  • Support VoIP sustainment and integration of approved network transport capabilities, aircraft, and other assets as directed within the awarded scope.

title: Strategic GTM Associate
location: United States - 100% Remote (Must be in Eastern Time Zone)
description:
AI is being run everywhere, by humans and agents. Harmonic Security governs all of it. The AI Governance and Control (AIGC) platform understands user / agent intent and data context in real time, giving security teams visibility and control across every tool and workflow so companies can move faster with AI while minimizing risk.

We operate in one of the fastest-moving spaces in tech: the emerging intersection of AI and cybersecurity. It's a market still being defined, and we're among the first to build natively for it - protecting sensitive data in real time, at the endpoint, with minimal friction for the teams using it. Enterprises get full visibility and control. Their people get to innovate without guardrails slowing them down.

Named to the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, Harmonic is gaining serious recognition and serious traction. We're led by deep cybersecurity expertise and backed by investors who know the space: N47, Ten Eleven Ventures, and In-Q-Tel.

As AI adoption inside the enterprise accelerates, the ability to safely observe, control, and enforce policy in real time isn't a nice-to-have. It's mission-critical infrastructure. That's what we build.

How We Work: AI-First by Design

Harmonic exists to help enterprises adopt AI safely and at scale. We hold ourselves to that same standard. Everyone here actively leverages AI tools to perform their best work — from deep research and writing to building robust processes and automating complex workflows. We expect every new hire to bring a genuine curiosity for AI and a commitment to using it to work smarter, faster, and with greater creativity.

For some, this involves tinkering and remaining open to emerging tools; for others, it means architecting entirely new systems with AI at the core. We will be transparent about expectations for every role and provide the tools and support needed for you to thrive.

About the Team

We are building a Strategic Accounts team focused on Fortune 100 and Fortune 250 Profile of business. Selling to these organizations isn’t the hard part. They have the same AI transformation problems as everyone else.

We don’t get into these organisations through cold email, LinkedIn messages or phone sequences. We get in through high-value interactions and Network: introductions from partners, advisors and investors, executive roundtables, industry panels, peer communities and the occasional well-timed coffee. This role exists to work with the strategic account team to build active, high-value, and exciting campaigns of activity that create those paths and turn them into Meaningful engagements, then help steer opportunities and keep the momentum going once we’re inside.

You’ll work alongside highly experienced Global account sellers. You will learn more about how large, complex enterprise deals really get done in a year here than most people ever learn.

What You'll Do

Find the way in:

  • Map target accounts: who the real decision makers and influencers are, how they’re organized, what they care about right now, and who they already know.

  • Work out the warmest routes to those people through our investors, advisors, channel partners, customers and the team’s own networks.

  • Spot the moments that matter: the conference panel a target CISO is speaking on, the roundtable we should be hosting, the partner who already sits inside the account.

  • Turn all of that into a short, prioritized plan for each account, and then get on with it.

Make it happen:

  • Run the activity, not just the plan. Book the meetings, brief the introducers, draft the notes, chase the follow-ups.

  • Work with our marketing team on targeted, account-based campaigns and executive events for specific accounts.

  • Prepare account briefings before meetings so every conversation starts from real insight.

  • Track signals across target accounts (leadership changes, AI initiatives, regulatory pressure, news) and flag the ones worth acting on.

Keep the momentum:

  • Once we’re engaged with an account, help drive the campaign forward: stakeholder coverage, next steps, content, and making sure nothing stalls.

  • Support all three sellers through a simple weekly prioritization, typically running two to three active account campaigns per seller at any one time.

What This Role is Not

This is not an SDR or BDR role. There are no call targets or email cadences, and we will never ask you to cold message a Fortune 100 CIO. It’s also not a marketing planning role where you design a campaign and hand it to someone else. You are the person who makes it happen. If you like building a plan and then being the one who actually executes it, you’ll love this.

What You Bring

  • One to three years into your career, whether in sales, marketing, consulting, research, events, recruiting, politics or something else entirely. We care far more about how you think than where you’ve been.

  • Genuinely smart and curious. You enjoy figuring out how a large organization works and who really makes the decisions.

  • An executer. When you have an idea, you’ve usually already started on it by the time you mention it.

  • Comfortable working on your own and moving fast, with good judgement about when to ask for help.

  • A clear, concise writer. You can brief a senior executive in five sentences.

  • Confident around senior people without needing to be the loudest person in the room.

  • Interested in AI and security. You don’t need to be an expert, and we’ll teach you what you need to know.

What You’ll Get

  • Hands-on mentoring from people who have spent decades selling to the world’s largest organizations.

  • Direct exposure to executive conversations at some of the most recognisable companies in the world.

  • A real path forward. The skills you build here are exactly the ones that make great enterprise sellers.

Why Join Us

This isn't just a job - it's a chance to help define a category. Harmonic Security was named to the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, and we're just getting started. We're building at the intersection of AI and security, carving out an emerging market where the rules haven't been written yet, and the people who join now will write them.

We believe today's talent is tomorrow's success, and we're committed to creating an environment where you can do the best work of your life.

  • Recognized momentum - We made the Rising in Cyber 2026 list, a signal that the market is taking notice

  • Rare market opportunity - Join early in a category-defining company at the convergence of AI and security, where your work directly shapes how enterprises tackle one of the biggest unsolved problems in tech

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity - A real stake in Harmonic's success, not a token gesture

  • Comprehensive benefits - 401K, pension plan, generous PTO, and flexible hybrid work

  • A small, high-trust team that values transparency, creativity, and continuous learning - no politics, no bureaucracy

  • Thoughtful leadership - that cares deeply about your growth, not just your output

  • Annual global off-sites - past trips include Lisbon, Portugal and Nashville, TN

  • Real ownership - you'll shape the product, the culture, and the direction of the company from day one

Harmonic's Core Values

🌱 Flourish in the Unknown

We embrace new, unfamiliar situations that require initiative and rapid decision-making. We orient ourselves quickly and deliver results with minimal guidance.

🔥 Never Full

We raise our hands, take on challenges, and assist others whenever possible. We hunger for opportunities to learn and do more.

🤝 Perfect Harmony

We support one another to create cohesion and unity. We collaborate openly, share feedback honestly, and help everyone produce their best work

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer | AI-Driven HealthTech | London | £60k-£90k + Equity

I’m working with a fast-growing, early-stage HealthTech business building a data intelligence platform for the pharmaceutical and life sciences industry.

They’re now hiring a permanent Data Engineer to join a small engineering team and take real ownership of the data pipelines that sit behind the product.

This isn’t a role maintaining an established warehouse or simply working through a backlog of tickets. You’ll be working with large volumes of messy, complex healthcare data, building and refactoring production pipelines, and using AI within those workflows to extract, classify, clean and validate information.

What they’re looking for:

  • Strong Python and SQL
  • Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines in production
  • Comfortable working with structured and unstructured data
  • Experience with LLM APIs / AI-powered data workflows would be highly relevant
  • Exposure to scraping, data acquisition, schema design, deduplication or entity resolution
  • Healthcare, pharma or life sciences data experience is a big advantage
  • Someone autonomous, curious and comfortable figuring things out in an early-stage environment

They’re much more interested in what you’ve owned and built than a specific number of years’ experience.

London, minimum 4 days a week on site

Equity available

They’re looking for someone who genuinely wants to help build a company, take on responsibility and be part of a high-growth startup environment.

A really good opportunity for a Data Engineer who wants more ownership, direct product impact and exposure to applied AI rather than being one engineer in a huge data function.

title: Software Engineer, Manufacturing Infrastructure
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER, MANUFACTURING INFRASTRUCTURE

The application software team is the central nervous system of SpaceX – we create mission critical applications that are used throughout SpaceX to accelerate launch vehicle production and flight as well as systems that allow Starlink to grow into a worldwide fast, reliable Internet service. We are looking for engineers who treat fellow teammates with fairness, respect, and support.

Our team is currently creating and evolving systems to enable rapid build and reuse of Starship as well as designing the next generation manufacturing software that will be used in high throughput factories for Starlink. Other applications range from platforms that support concurrent streams of data from many always-on assets to manage the world’s largest satellite constellation to public facing systems where customers can join our Starlink network globally. We work closely with engineers throughout the company to create and update our systems with respect to crewed launches, Starship flights, changes to the Starlink network and much more.

Aerospace experience is not required to be successful here - rather we look for smart, motivated, respectful, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on a super inspiring mission. You will have full ownership of challenging problems, working with a team of enthusiastic engineers with diverse perspectives to design and produce solutions that enable SpaceX to move towards our goals at a rapid pace. The success of the missions at SpaceX depends on the software that you and your team produce.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop highly reliable software solutions that are used across SpaceX
  • Create new applications that improve how SpaceX operates
  • Build prototypes to prove out key design concepts and quantify technical constraints
  • Own all aspects of software engineering and product development
  • Deep dive into your users’ problems to find and create efficient solutions
  • Bring your voice to the table in team collaborations on architecture, design, and code reviews

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or scientific discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree
  • Experience in full stack development

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Programming experience in Python, C#.NET, Go, Scala, Java, or similar object-oriented language
  • 1+ years of rigorous experience building single page web applications
  • Experience with version control, continuous integration, and continuous delivery concepts
  • Expertise in designing software systems
  • Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment & monitoring
  • Expertise in profiling and improving application performance
  • Experience with build systems (Make, Bazel/Pants/Buck, Gradle) and package management tools (pip, npm)
  • Experience with UNIX-like operating systems and tools like Terraform, Ansible, Puppet for managing them
  • Experience working with in-stream data processing using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, or similar technologies
  • Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Front-end experience in Angular, React, or similar JavaScript framework
  • Database experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar database technologies

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed
  • This role requires you to be onsite. Remote and/or hybrid work will not be considered

ITAR REQUIREMENTS:

  • To conform to U.S. Government export regulations, applicant must be a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (aka green card holder), (iii) Refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) Asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. title: Sports Science Intern
description:
Who We Are:

UFC® is the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization (MMA), with more than 700 million fans and approximately 300 million social media followers. The organization produces more than 40 live events annually in some of the most prestigious arenas around the world while broadcasting to over 950 million households across more than 170 countries. UFC’s athlete roster features the world’s best MMA athletes representing more than 80 countries. The organization’s digital offerings include UFC FIGHT PASS®, one of the world’s leading streaming services for combat sports. UFC is part of TKO Group Holdings (NYSE: TKO) and is headquartered in Las Vegas, Nevada. For more information, visit UFC.com and follow UFC at Facebook.com/UFC and @UFC on X, Snapchat, Instagram, and TikTok: @UFC.

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.



Position Summary:

At the UFC Performance Institute (UFCPI), we deliver performance-impacting physical preparation, sport science, and medical services to the world's best MMA and combat athletes. Our core values are aligned with maximizing the health and wellbeing of UFC athletes and supporting athletes and coaches as they optimize training, preparation, and performance in the Octagon.

The Sport Science Intern will support the Senior Manager, Performance Science & Strength & Conditioning and the UFCPI – Shanghai team with the delivery of sport science services, research projects, data collection, and athlete-facing initiatives. Under the guidance of experienced staff, this role will gain practical exposure to working with the Strength & Conditioning, Nutrition, and Sports Medical teams. The intern will assist with sport science testing, equipment upkeep, data organization, reports, and educational activities while learning how evidence-based practices support athlete health, wellbeing, and performance. This individual will work in a collaborative, high-performance environment and contribute to cross-disciplinary initiatives within the Performance Institute.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist with sport science activities at the UFCPI - Shanghai under the direction of the performance team, with the objective of supporting athlete health, wellness, and performance.
  • Support data collection and identified sport science projects or research activities addressing key performance questions.
  • Collaborate with staff members on sport science applications and help translate findings into practical support for athletes and coaches.
  • Assist with the maintenance, calibration, and upkeep of sport science equipment and technologies within the UFCPI - Shanghai.
  • Research emerging sport science technologies, methods, and industry practices that may support the work of the Performance Institute.
  • Maintain appropriate databases, organize datasets, and assist with basic data analysis and the review of objective performance metrics.
  • Help prepare reports, presentations, and data feedback materials that communicate performance insights clearly.
  • Participate in educational workshops and continue developing an understanding of the theory, research, and scientific applications relevant to elite MMA athletes.

Skills & Experience:

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Exercise Science, Sport Science, Kinesiology, Biomechanics, Data Science, or a related field; or a recent graduate.
  • Coursework or academic exposure to exercise physiology, biomechanics, performance analysis, research methods, or related areas.
  • Previous internship, practicum, research, laboratory, or applied experience in sport science, human performance, or a related field is preferred.
  • Experience working with athletes, coaches, or in a high-performance environment is preferred.
  • Personal or academic interest in combat or contact sport is preferred, but not required.
  • Basic familiarity with sport science technologies, testing protocols, data collection, and evidence-based research practices.
  • Basic data analysis skills and familiarity with Excel or similar data organization tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to communicate technical or complex information in terms that are easily understood by a wide range of audiences.
  • Highly organized, dependable, detail-oriented, and motivated to learn in a collaborative environment.
  • A willingness to accept feedback, entertain new ideas, and approach challenges with a positive and open-minded attitude.
