title: PATIENT ACCT RES SPEC
description:
At Accendra Health, we understand that healthcare is complex, and we’re here to make it easier. We help deliver care beyond traditional settings, making essential products and services more accessible through every stage of life. As part of the care team, our teammates play a critical role in delivering personalized, long-term care for the patients we serve.

With deep expertise promoting health outside the hospital and a presence in communities nationwide through our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health does more than just deliver the essentials.

If you’re interested in meaningful work with impact, explore our career opportunities and join us in our purpose of Bringing Care To Life™.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $18 - $25 hourly. The actual compensation offered may vary based on job related factors such as experience, skills, education and location.


ABOUT THE COMPANY

Apria Healthcare’s mission is to improve the quality of life for our patients at home. We are looking for empathetic, thoughtful and compassionate people, to meet the needs of our patients. Already an industry leader in healthcare services, we provide home respiratory services and select medical equipment to help our patients sleep better, breathe better, heal faster, and thrive longer.


JOB SUMMARY

The Individual Contributor will provide excellent customer service and product information, solutions and relevant details to patients and providers. Most importantly, this position provides above and beyond communication with our patients so that they feel heard, understood, valued and more connected with Apria. Key responsibilities for creating a positive, patient-centric environment include:

  • Evangelize our customers and turn our disgruntled patients into our biggest fans.
  • Support our Field teams, Operations and Sales, by delivering timely feedback that empowers our teams to deliver exceptional patient experiences.
  • Critically problem-solve common complaints by flagging trends and partnering cross-functionally to recommend and implement preventative measures.
  • Proactively create a better patient experience.
  • Be a champion of the employee experience and drive our unique company culture.
  • Support the development and implementation of employee programs that nurture our company's core values to engage employees and create a positive culture.



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for supporting branches across a designated market
  • Review of new and recurring patient accounts to obtain the documentation from the referral source required to bill the individual health insurance plans, allowing our patients to maximize their available health plan benefits and to receive the much-needed care as soon as possible.
  • Research and secure required information from the customer to continue coverage of equipment through the health insurance plan
  • Manage collaborative relationships with field leadership, referrals and patients through effective outreach to drive account resolution
  • Evaluate all documentation received to ensure that it meets compliance criteria to the relevant standards and regulations
  • Perform follow-up to achieve timely reimbursement
  • Performs other duties as required.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • N/A

MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS


Education and/or Experience

  • High school degree or equivalent
  • 3-5 years’ experience in healthcare/health insurance industry

SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES

  • Patient-Focused: You start with the patient and work backwards. You invest the time and energy to understand the patients’ objectives, then tie all your activities directly to the achievement of those objectives.
  • Action-Oriented: You thrive as a self-starter who proactively senses and responds to problems and opportunities and requires minimal supervision.
  • Collaborative: You love teamwork. Your colleagues love having you on the team. You work well across functions and groups.
  • An Effective Communicator: You write and speak clearly, concisely and with a spirit of partnership. You actively inform and inspire with your messaging. You speak plainly and are transparent with your business colleagues.
  • Energetic & Passionate: Your passion and energy for health and well-being is deeply founded in your desire to help others and to be a positive role model.
  • Relationship Builder: You excel in getting people involved and building a network of contacts that allow you to multiply your influence on the organization.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations or Professional Designations

  • N/A

Computer Skills

  • Intermediate skills in Access, Excel, PowerPoint, MS Project, Visio, Word

Language Skills

  • English (reading, writing, verbal)

Mathematical Skills

  • Intermediate level mathematical proficiency, with a strong ability to understand, interpret and develop spreadsheet data.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

This is a stationary position that requires frequent sitting or standing, repetitive wrist motions, grasping, speaking, listening, close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus. It also may require occasional lifting, carrying, walking, climbing, kneeling, bending/stooping, twisting, pulling/pushing, walking, bending, stooping, and reaching above the shoulder. This position also may require the occasional lifting of equipment up to 50 lbs.


OTHER INFORMATION

The essential duties and responsibilities, physical requirements, and work environment described above are representative of those typically required for this position but may vary depending on staffing and business needs at specific locations. The inclusion or omission of a specific duty or physical requirement is, therefore, not determinative of whether that function is essential to a specific individual’s position. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to assist or enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.



PLEASE NOTE: This is a remote position which is US-based. This role requires individuals to physically reside and work within the United States. Company systems and equipment are monitored for security and other purposes and removal of Company equipment outside of the United States is not permitted without prior authorization.

Teammate Benefits

As an Accendra Health employee, you have choices to fit your life. Our comprehensive benefits program is designed to meet you where you are — through all of life’s stages. We’ve got you and your family covered with benefits that support your health, finances, and overall wellness.

title: Engineer III, Network Operations
description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What you’ll be doing...


Join Verizon as we continue to expand our industry-leading network to improve the ways people, businesses, and things connect. As a Network Operations Engineer, you will provide technical expertise on a critical role involving network transformation, network outages, service issues, network optimization, and maintenance. You will be responsible for providing support to keep things running smoothly and change the way that our customers live, work, and play. We are a 24x7 highly visible Operations environment that performs troubleshooting, configuration changes, drive issues to resolution, and related functions.

  • Performing optimization, troubleshooting, and maintenance of network systems and applications to identify overall system availability and performance.
  • Evaluating network coverage to find gaps, making recommendations to improve coverage, and helping to implement those recommendations.
  • Performing triage, fault isolation, and remediation of network events.
  • Generating, driving, and updating problem-tracking tickets via multiple systems and continuously improving business practices.
  • Escalating issues to the appropriate internal/external engineer teams for resolution.

What we’re looking for...


Being the first one to encounter and solve a problem is enjoyable to you. You’re great at following an established process or procedure to complete tasks. Experience navigating and working well at all levels in a fast-paced, ever-changing network environment. You are dependable and enjoy supporting the rotational needs of a technical environment.


You’ll need to have:

  • Associate’s degree or two or more years of work experience.
  • Three or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience.
  • Ability to work rotating shifts including weekends and holidays.
  • Valid drivers license and ability to operate a company vehicle

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • A technical degree in Electronics, Telecommunications, Computer Science, Engineering, Business or a related discipline.
  • Knowledge of telecommunications equipment and technologies like Telephony Switching, Data Communications and Network Routers.
  • Computer support experience, including troubleshooting PC hardware and configurations.
  • Vendor management experience.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this worksite-based role, you'll work onsite at a defined location(s).

Scheduled Weekly Hours

40

Equal Employment Opportunity

Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics.

Benefits and Compensation

Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home & auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances.

The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours.

title: Becario Analista de promociones (RGM)
description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Matter.

Joining us at an early career stage in our fast paced and ever changing environment will enable you to do more, learn more and grow more. You will be encouraged to step outside your comfort zone– you may even surprise yourself! We will ensure you are given the support you need to be at your best and enable you to be yourself and bring passion and personality. Here you can lean in and speak up and bring your own flavor.

Formarás parte del equipo de Revenue Growth Management (RGM), apoyando el análisis y ejecución de nuestra estrategia promocional y generando insights que contribuyan a mejores decisiones de negocio.

Principales responsabilidades:

● Apoyar al equipo de RGM Promo en la ejecución, seguimiento y análisis del proceso promocional.
● Analizar el desempeño de promociones a través de indicadores como elasticidad, uplift, ROI e inversión promocional.
● Dar seguimiento a resultados reales vs. estimados, identificando desviaciones, aprendizajes y oportunidades de mejora.
● Gestionar y mantener actualizadas bases de datos de clientes, productos, precios y promociones, asegurando la calidad de la información.
● Elaborar cierres mensuales, reportes y análisis de desempeño por categoría.
● Dar seguimiento a la correcta implementación de precios y promociones aprobadas.
● Transformar datos en insights y recomendaciones que apoyen la toma de decisiones del equipo de RGM.
● Participar en proyectos de mejora continua y optimización de la estrategia promocional.
● Colaborar con diferentes áreas del negocio para desarrollar una visión integral de cómo las decisiones de precio y promoción impactan el crecimiento y la rentabilidad.

¿Qué buscamos?

● Estudiantes de últimos semestres de Economía, Actuaría, Ingeniería Industrial, Finanzas, Business Analytics, Administración o carreras afines, con interés en desarrollar una carrera en áreas comerciales y analíticas.
● Perfil analítico y numérico, con capacidad para trabajar con información, identificar tendencias y generar conclusiones.
● Manejo de Excel intermedio-avanzado.
● Inglés intermedio-avanzado.
● Pensamiento estructurado, atención al detalle y orientación a resultados.
● Curiosidad por entender el negocio y cómo las decisiones de precio y promoción impactan las ventas y rentabilidad.
● Capacidad de aprendizaje, iniciativa y disposición para trabajar de manera colaborativa.

Será un plus contar con conocimientos de Power BI, SQL, herramientas de visualización de datos o estadística aplicada.

No es necesario contar con experiencia previa en RGM: buscamos personas con potencial, curiosidad y ganas de desarrollar habilidades analíticas y comerciales.

Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.



Group/Division

The KLA Services team consists of Service Sales, Marketing, Spares Supply Chain Management, Field Operations, Engineering, Product Training, Digital Solutions and Analytics, and Technical Product Support. description:
Interested in a career that matters?




At Novonesis, we believe biology holds the key to solving some of the world's biggest challenges. To accelerate this mission, we are strengthening our digital and AI capabilities across Product & Process Development (PPD).


You will join the newly formed Digital Enablement Team within PPD, an organization of more than 400 employees across six director areas and more than 10 geographical locations. The team brings together expertise in digital implementation, data engineering, AI and the wider PPD data landscape to support scientists and business functions across the organization.


Together, we will build a strong digital foundation, establish new ways of working and create practical solutions that help scientists work more efficiently and effectively. By partnering closely with local digital teams, scientists and platform experts, we enable the adoption of scalable digital and AI solutions that create value across PPD.

The role & your impact

As an AI Engineer, you will develop and implement AI-enabled scientific workflows that help transform how research and development is conducted across Novonesis. This role combines hands-on execution with innovation, requiring both strong technical capabilities and close collaboration with scientific stakeholders. You will play a key role in translating scientific challenges into practical AI solutions that are scalable, maintainable and aligned with Novonesis enterprise platforms and data foundations.


Your key responsibilities in this role

  • Build and implement AI-enabled scientific workflows that improve research activities and create measurable value for scientists.
  • Design and develop solutions using enterprise AI platforms, models, data foundations and reusable components.
  • Contribute to next-generation R&D initiatives that connect data, models, tools and AI capabilities into integrated end-to-end workflows.
  • Work closely with scientists and local digital teams to understand user needs and iteratively develop solutions that fit real-world scientific processes.
  • Support adoption, integration and lifecycle management of AI solutions to ensure long-term impact and sustainability.

What you'll need to be successful in this role

  • BSc or MSc degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, Bioinformatics, or a related technical or scientific discipline, combined with professional working proficiency in English.
  • Experience developing and implementing AI, machine learning, or LLM-enabled solutions in operational or user-facing environments.
  • Strong programming skills, preferably in Python, with practical experience working with models, APIs, data pipelines, and modern software development practices.
  • Experience taking AI solutions beyond proof-of-concept through testing, integration, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with scientists, software specialists, data engineers, and platform teams to develop, validate, and operationalize AI solutions.

We are looking for someone who demonstrates:

  • Strong AI problem-solving and engineering judgment, with the ability to identify where AI creates meaningful value and build reliable, maintainable solutions that deliver lasting impact.
  • An experimental and learning-oriented mindset, using evidence, user feedback, and technical results to iteratively improve solutions and adapt approaches when needed.
  • Excellent collaboration, curiosity, and learning agility, working effectively across scientific and technical disciplines while continuously exploring new technologies and ways of working.

Additional skills & interests we value

Experience working in scientific R&D or laboratory environments would be an advantage, as would hands-on experience with agentic AI, generative AI, and LLM-based workflows. Familiarity with enterprise AI platforms and large-scale AI implementations is beneficial, particularly when combined with an understanding of data platforms that support scientific and research operations. Candidates with an interest in applying emerging AI technologies to solve complex scientific challenges will thrive in this environment.


What we offer you

This is an opportunity to help shape a newly established team at the intersection of science, data, and AI. You will work alongside talented colleagues across multiple disciplines while contributing to initiatives that have impact on a global R&D organization.

In this role, you will have a unique opportunity to influence how AI is applied within scientific research and development while collaborating closely with scientists, digital specialists, AI experts, and data engineers across Novonesis. You will be part of a collaborative environment focused on learning, innovation, and continuous improvement, with access to enterprise-scale platforms and capabilities that support your professional growth. As the team continues to evolve, you will also play an important role in defining new ways of working and establishing best practices for AI adoption across PPD.

Working conditions

The position is based in Bagsværd, Denmark, and operates within an office-first hybrid work model. Onsite collaboration plays an important role in understanding scientific workflows, building strong stakeholder relationships, and working closely with colleagues across the organization. At the same time, we offer flexibility to work from home when compatible with team and project needs. Limited travel may be required depending on project activities and stakeholder engagement.

Application deadline: 16 October 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

Contact Information: For more information, please contact Christian Munk, PPD Digitalization Lead, at crmu@novonesis.com or +45 30 77 04 33.

Our purpose guides the way

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. title: Visiting Brand Designer
description:

title: Facilities Specialist 3
description:
Job Description

Position: Facilities Specialist 3

Department: Facilities

Job Summary:

Performs work related to construction, maintenance, and repair of the Gaming Enterprise Division's (GED) buildings and facilities. This is the third in a series of three (3) classifications. Incumbents work at a high level of expertise, exercise judgement and independence in performance of duties, and will be assigned the responsibility to lead or instruct others.

Duties and Responsibilities (specific areas of responsibility include but are not limited to):

  • Performs the duties of Facilities Specialist 1 and 2.

  • Oversees the maintenance of logs, records, preventive maintenance schedules, and other records.
  • Responds to after-hours emergency calls, as needed.
  • Prepares job cost estimates for major, complex projects.
  • Completes work orders with minimal or no direction and in cooperation with other team members, when necessary.
  • Provides on-the-job training for assigned crew members in skills requirements of specific job tasks and compliance with regulations i.e.; electrical, plumbing, sheetrock, painting and masonry.
  • Enforces health and safety standards rigorously; ensures work related injuries or incidents are reported to supervisor and Security but also ensures accurate and timely records are maintained for purposes of assessing training needs and taking corrective action.
  • Ensures that an inventory of equipment is maintained to be able to respond to work requests in a timely manner.
  • Ensures uniform and personal appearance is clean and professional.
  • Identify, order, and install correct parts needed to repair and maintain equipment properly.
  • Consults with supervisor on status of current and future projects.
  • Confers with department head to review achievements and discuss needed changes in goals or objectives resulting from current or projected future status or conditions.
  • Demonstrates continuous effort to improve operations, decrease turnaround times, streamline work processes, and work cooperatively and jointly to provide quality seamless guest service.
  • Follows instructions regarding the use of chemicals and supplies; uses as directed.

  • Required to use proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
  • Supports and enforces departmental as well as the GED’s policies and procedures, and applicable regulatory policies, such as completion of Safety Data Sheets (SDS)
  • Turns in found articles in accordance with Facilities and GED policies and procedures.
  • Work proactively with a forward‑looking, innovative approach to property maintenance and problem‑solving.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision, scheduling daily tasks and prioritizing work activities.
  • Support property operations by responding promptly to maintenance requests and emergencies.
  • Collaborate effectively with team members and uphold Casino Del Sol customer service standards.
  • Attends periodic departmental and GED meetings; attends professional and personal development training programs.
  • Ensures uniform and personal appearance is clean and professional.
  • Supports and enforces departmental as well as the GED’s policies and procedures, and applicable regulatory policies, such as completion of Safety Data Sheets (SDS)
  • Performs other job-related duties as assigned.

Essential functions of the position:

  • Must be able to independently push, pull, and turn a tool car (maximum weight up to 300 pounds) with or without a reasonable accommodation, and wear fitted tool belt (maximum weight up to 20 pounds).
  • Must be able to move heavy objects (100 pounds or more) long distances (more than 20 feet), with or without a reasonable accommodation.
  • Must be able to sit, walk, or stand for extended periods of time.
  • Must be able to reach above shoulder height, handle, pull, kneel, stoop, squat, grip, crouch, crawl, twist, and bend for duties, including inspections and work in confined or cramped spaces.
  • Must be able to work indoor and outdoor environment and walk on uneven surfaces, up and downstairs, and higher than ten feet.
  • May be exposed to chemical, fumes, cleaning agents and other hazardous materials.
  • Must be able to drive/travel to or work at all CDS properties or any other events necessary for this specific role.
  • Must be able to perform primary job duties while exposed to inclement weather, including extreme heat, cold, heavy rain, or high-humidity environments for extended durations.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision (electrical wires), peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Must be able to follow both verbal and written directions.
  • Must be able to read, write, and effectively communicate with all guests, team members and internal/external vendors positively and professionally.
  • Must be able to work in environments with high noise levels, flashing lights, smoking areas, and large crowds.
  • Must be able to respond to aural cues in full audible range in high noise conditions and be able to respond to visual cues and possess color perception.
  • Must be able to work in a high-pressure/fast-paced environment.
  • Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively in person, by telephone, and written correspondence, and occasionally use a two-way radio.
  • Requires 24-hour response availability seven days per week for emergency situations.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of equipment, products, techniques and standards used for construction, maintenance, and repair of facilities to include electrical, plumbing, sheetrock, painting and masonry.
  • Knowledge of standard hand and power tools and equipment used in the trades.
  • Knowledge of chemicals used in the trades.
  • Knowledge of occupational hazards and necessary safety precautions.
  • Knowledge of safety standards and precautions pertaining to the trades.
  • Knowledge of all relevant laws, regulations, and codes.
  • Proficiency in soldering, brazing, welding, electrical and plumbing.
  • Skill in the care and use of hand tools and equipment necessary to perform tasks.
  • Skill in coordination and dexterity to work with power and hand tools, such as, drills, electric saws, hammers, sewer snakes, etc. in a safe and efficient manner.
  • Skill in locating and adjusting defects in systems and equipment.
  • Strong organizational, planning, and time management skills.
  • Skill in working courteously with the public as well as developing and maintaining good working relationships.
  • Ability to soft solder and silver solder.
  • Ability to work with minimal or no supervision.
  • Ability to effectively communicate as well as understand and follow specific instructions and procedures.
  • Ability to work cooperatively with, and make decisions based on information received from team members or guests.
  • Ability to exercise independent judgment and be fiscally prudent in choosing materials, tools, and procedures in finishing assigned tasks.
  • Ability to estimate labor or material costs from blueprints or work plans.
  • Ability to observe, monitor, or compare data to determine compliance with prescribed operating or safety standards.
  • Ability to quickly maneuver around casino and hotel areas.
  • Ability to think clearly and respond calmly in emergency situations.
  • Ability to learn and retain locations, operation and repair procedures of the property’s equipment, mechanical systems and life safety systems.
  • Ability to perform mathematical and geometric computations pertaining to the position.
  • Ability to measure distances with a tape measure or other measuring device.
  • Ability to use graphic instructions such as blueprints, schematic drawings, layouts, or other visual aids as well as interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
  • Ability to work safely without presenting a direct threat to self or others.
  • Ability to lift, carry, and climb ladders to reach work areas as well as push and pull scaffolds when required to complete the job task.
  • Ability to read blueprints as well as interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
  • Ability to learn and follow departmental as well as the GED’s internal controls, policies, and procedures, and applicable regulatory policies, such as completion of Safety Data Sheets (SDS).
  • Ability to complete and obtain required program Training Courses or Certifications within a timely manner.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Seven (7) years’ experience in building maintenance, commercial building trade, or facilities maintenance/engineering, to include electrical, plumbing, sheetrock, painting and masonry, AND six (6) months lead or supervisory experience OR any combination of education and experience. Must successfully pass a written exercise.
  • Computer proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite software, especially word processing and spreadsheets.
  • Must have a valid Arizona Driver’s License.
  • Demonstrated track record of reliability, responsiveness, and creativity,
  • Demonstrated track record of providing excellent guest service.
  • Must be able to work (may require shift changes), weekends, holidays, and special events), including overtime, as needed.
  • Must be able to successfully pass a pre-employment drug/alcohol screening in accordance with company policy.
  • Must have employment eligibility in the U.S.
  • Must be able to obtain, and retain a valid gaming license/background check.

  • Journeymen Plumber

title: 4/26 TEMPLATE Child Welfare Specialist I/II/III
description:
This position is located in Miami, Oklahoma.

Working in Child Welfare for Oklahoma's largest state agency means having the opportunity to positively impact the safety and well-being of children and families for generations to come. If you have a passion for social work and making a difference in your local community, OKDHS has a place for you! Join our team and create pathways to hope for all Oklahomans.

Extensive training will be provided to new employees.

Annual Salary

  • Level I H23A - $37,280.75 + Full State Employee Benefits
  • Level II H23B - $40,077.79 + Full State Employee Benefits
  • Level III H23C - $43,968.62 + Full State Employee Benefits

Applicants who possess a Master's Degree in Social Work will be entitled to a salary incentive of an additional 5%.

On-call positions will receive an additional bonus ranging from $100 to $150 every two weeks, depending on responsibilities.

Hours worked may include on-call, extended and/or weekend hours.

Minimum Qualifications

Child Welfare Specialist, Level I

  • Completion of 90 hours from an accredited college or university;
  • OR 3 years of experience related to child welfare work;
  • OR A combination of education and experience.

Child Welfare Specialist, Level II

  • A bachelor's degree (in any field) to qualify;
  • OR One year of experience as a Child Welfare Specialist.

Child Welfare Specialist, Level III

  • A Master's degree;
  • OR a Bachelors Degree plus one year of experience as a Child Welfare Specialist;
  • OR Two years of experience as a Child Welfare Specialist.

Job Duties

This position job responsibilities may be in one or more of the following, within Child Welfare Programs.

Child Protective Services (CPS)

*Investigates allegations of child abuse or neglect.

*Protects the safety of children and provides services to help families with any barriers that can result in the safety of their children to be at risk.

Family Centered Services (FCS)

*Preserves and strengthen protective capacities of the parents to keep the child in their own home with a focus on increasing safety for the child and family to prevent unnecessary out-of-home placements.

Permanency Planning (PP)

*Provides services to families that include involving family members as participants in their own treatment plan.

*Provides placements for children which will meet their medical, educational, and physical needs.

*Returns children to their own homes as soon as their needs can be met in the home of their parent(s), and arranges a permanent plan when return to the home is not possible.

All New Employees will complete the Child Welfare Core Academy Training Program

  • Learn treatment and preventive services;
  • Visit children in placement and conduct assessments of children and families;
  • Refer families and children to services in the community;
  • Participate in investigations of abuse and neglect of children, and prepare case reports and other documentation;
  • Attends court hearings and provides testimony;
  • Consults with the District Attorney and other attorneys, and tribal partners regarding efforts to protect the child, reunite the family or other permanent plans for the child;
  • Provides direct services to children in placement,
  • And other duties as assigned.

________________________________________________________________
Travel is EXTENSIVE - Must possess a valid driver's license and must maintain required car insurance. State vehicles will be available for use to carry out the duties of the position.

title: Projekti-insinööri raitiotiehankkeille, pääkaupunkiseutu
description:
Olemme NRC Group – Pohjoismaiden kunnianhimoisin infrarakentaja. Rakennamme ja kunnossapidämme kriittistä infraa ja työllistämme noin 2 000 ammattilaista Suomessa, Ruotsissa ja Norjassa. Yhdistämme ihmisiä ja yhteisöjä päivittäin ja teemme sen ketterästi ja innovatiivisesti. Haemme rohkeita ihmisiä rakentamaan kanssamme infraa vastuullisesti ja vaikuttavasti – näytä meille rohkeutesi!

Haemme nyt sähkötaustaista infra-alan projekti-insinööriä raitiotiehankkeille pääkaupunkiseudulle!

Meillä on parhaillaan käynnissä useita erikokoisia ratikkahankkeita. Näistä suurin on Infraohjelma Helsinki -allianssi, johon kuuluvat Länsi-Helsingin ratikka-, Länsisataman pikaratikka- sekä Viikki-Malmi-ratikka-allianssit. Ratikkahankkeet muovaavat merkittävästi Helsingin kaupunkikuvaa ja kehittävät pääkaupunkiseudun liikkumista tuleville vuosikymmenille.

Työtehtäviisi projekti-insinöörinä kuuluu

  • Työskentelet osana suurta allianssiorganisaatiota yhdessä rakentajakumppanimme, alihankkijoiden, suunnittelijoiden ja tilaajien kanssa
  • Olet ratkaisukeskeinen ja oma-aloitteinen työmaan tuki ja toimintaedellytysten varmistaja
  • Tehtävääsi kuuluu esimerkiksi aikatauluohjausta, laadunhallintaa, turvallisuustehtäviä, projektin taloudellisen kehityksen seurantaa ja sidosryhmäyhteistyötä
  • Toimit tekniikkalajien järjestelmäpäälliköiden kanssa sujuvasti yhteistyössä saavuttaaksenne allianssin tavoitteet
  • Olet mukana ohjaamassa myös työkokonaisuutesi työturvallisuutta, ympäristöasioista, hankintojen valmistelua kohti yhteistä päämäärää
  • Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä alueen toimijoiden kanssa, mukaan lukien työmaan läheisyydessä sijaitsevat kiinteistöt sekä heidän tarpeidensa huomiointi ja yhteensovitus työmaahan
  • Työtehtävien menestyksekäs hoitaminen edellyttää läsnäoloa allianssin Big Roomilla ja työmaalla

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • Tehtävään soveltuvaa sähköalan koulutusta (esim. sähköinsinööri)
  • Hyviä tiimi- ja ihmissuhdetaitoja sekä kykyä toimia joukkuepelaajana
  • Kokemusta infra- tai radanrakentamisesta ja kokemusta infrarakentamisesta vaativassa katuympäristössä
  • Toivomme, että olet oma-aloitteinen ja rehdillä asenteella varustettu tekijä ja sinulla on taitoa sekä tahtoa vetää vaativia projekteja pitäen jatkuva parantaminen mielessä
  • Arvostamme aiempaa kokemusta raitiotierakentamisesta
  • B-ajokorttia
  • Suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

Tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä voidaan tehdä hakijan suostumuksella perusmuotoinen henkilöturvallisuusselvitys (turvallisuusselvityslaki 726/2014). Menettelystä ja selvityksen kohteen oikeuksista löytyy tarkempia tietoja täältä.

Palkitsemme hyvin tehdystä työstä ja lisäksi tarjoamme kattavat ePassin henkilöstöedut. Toivomme, että olet valmis aloittamaan tehtävässä mahdollisimman pian.

Kiinnostuitko? Jätäthän hakemuksesi 18.10. mennessä rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa projektipäällikkö Juha Rasinmäki, sähköpostitse juha.rasinmaki@nrcgroup.fi, sekä puhelimitse 0405490509.

Rekrytointiprosessi etenee siten, että otamme yhteyttä haastatteluihin valittuihin henkilöihin viimeistään viikolla 42.

title: Operatør til produktionslaboratorium
description:
Hos Eurofins Milk Testing Denmark A/S analyserer vi råmælksprøver for en række forskellige parametre, som bruges i forbindelse med mejeriets afregning til mælkeproducenten samt af den enkelte landmand. Hver dag håndterer og analyserer vi tusindvis af mælkeprøver ved hjælp af automatiseret udstyr og avanceret teknologi, herunder FT-IR, flowcytometri, PCR og ELISA. Derudover udfører Eurofins Milk Testing Denmark A/S serologiske analyser, enten som led i nationale zoonose- og sygdomsbekæmpelsesprogrammer eller som service for landmænd og dyrlæger.

I mælkelaboratoriet søger vi en ny kollega, der sammen med resten af teamet vil være med til at sikre et godt flow i vores produktion.

Arbejdsopgaverne vil være meget varierende og du vil derfor opleve en alsidig arbejdsdag. Du vil bl.a. stå for registrering af prøver i kølerum, håndtering af forskellige højteknologiske apparater, hvor kvalitetskontrol er en vigtig parameter, samt hjælpe med forefaldende arbejde i laboratoriet.

Faglige kvalifikationer

Da du vil få en grundig oplæring i arbejdsopgaverne, vægtes dine personlige kompetencer højere end dine faglige kvalifikationer. Det forventes dog, at du har gode IT-kundskaber og nemt ved at sætte dig ind i nye systemer, samt at du taler og skriver dansk.

Personlige kompetencer

  • Du trives i en travl hverdag, hvor præcision, systematik og effektivitet er vigtig
  • Du har en positiv indstilling, udviser fleksibilitet og er villig til at hjælpe, hvor der er behov
  • Du får energi af at have flere igangværende opgaver og evner at prioritere dem
  • Du er lærenem og har gode samarbejdsevner
  • Du forstår vigtigheden af hygiejne og rengøring

Det vil både være stående og gående arbejde og derfor er det vigtigt, at du er fysisk mobil.

Arbejdstid
Dine arbejdstider vil primært ligge i tidsrummet 06.00-18.00 på hverdage, men der vil forekomme weekendarbejde og senvagter/lukkevagter.

Løn iht. overenskomst og evt. tillæg iht. kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Arbejdssted
Ladelundvej 85, 6600 Vejen

Tiltrædelse
Snarest muligt

Ansøgning
Send dit CV og ansøgning med relevante bilag ved at klikke på "Jeg er interesseret". Vi afholder løbende samtaler og ansætter så snart, den rette kandidat er fundet. Du skal søge online – det er eneste måde. Ansøgninger på mail medtages ikke.

Vil du vide mere om stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte teamleder Andrea Lauridsen på Andrea.Lauridsen@ftn.eurofins.com

Udvælges du som en af de kandidater, vi ønsker at invitere videre i rekrutteringsprocessen, vil du modtage et link til en kort videobesvarelse af udvalgte spørgsmål forud for en eventuel samtale.

Du kan læse mere om Eurofins på www.eurofins.dk.

I forbindelse med ansættelsen vil du blive bedt om at fremvise straffeattest.

Eurofins Scientific er en international life science virksomhed, som tilbyder et unikt udvalg af analyser til kunder inden for mange forskellige industrier, med det formål at gøre livet og vores miljø mere sikkert, sundere og mere bæredygtigt. Fra den mad du spiser, til vandet du drikker, til medicinen du anvender, arbejder Eurofins sammen med de største virksomheder i verden, for at understøtte, at de produkter virksomhederne udbyder er sikre, deres ingredienser er autentiske og at mærkningen på produkterne er korrekte. Eurofins er verdensledende inden for test af fødevarer, miljø, farmaceutiske og kosmetiske produkter, samt agro-science CRO services. Eurofins er ydermere en af de globale markedsledere inden for specifikke test og laboratorieservices inden for genomics, farmakologi, retsmedicin, CDMO, avanceret materialevidenskab, samt support til kliniske studier.

På lidt mere end 30 år er Eurofins vokset fra at været et enkelt laboratorium i Nantes i Frankrig, til at bestå af 65.000 medarbejdere i et netværk af mere end 1000 selvstændige selskaber og over 950 laboratorier i 60 lande. Eurofins tilbyder en portefølje af mere end 200.000 analytiske metoder, til at evaluere sikkerhed, identitet, sammensætning, ægthed, oprindelse, sporbarhed og renhed af biologiske stoffer og produkter. Som en af de førende spillere inden for specialiseret klinisk diagnostisk test, tilbyder vi endvidere vi innovative klinisk diagnostiske testydelser.

I 2025 genererede Eurofins en samlet indtægt på 7,296 milliarder Euro og er i blandt de aktier, som har performet bedst i Europa over de sidste 20 år.

title: Office Services Administrator
description:

Who we are:

Canaccord Genuity (CG) is a leading independent full-service financial services firm, with operations in two principal segments of the securities industry: wealth management and capital markets. CG is driven by an unwavering commitment to build lasting client relationships – we achieve this by generating value for our individual, institutional, and corporate clients through comprehensive wealth management solutions and investment banking services. We are a leading independent wealth management firm in Canada, and the leading mid-market provider of investment banking advisory, equity research, sales and trading services for corporations and institutions.


We pride ourselves on understanding our clients’ needs and providing innovative, bespoke solutions. Our entrepreneurial and friendly team will challenge you to learn and grow every day. We value excellence and collaboration. We’re looking for talented people who thrive in a dynamic environment and want to have an impact with innovative ideas and best practices.


At CG, we believe that diversity across our business strengthens our client relationships and enables more innovative solutions. We strongly encourage applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. CG provides an accessible candidate experience. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process and beyond, please let us know.


Our Canadian operations are currently looking for an enthusiastic individual with excellent organizational, communication and multi-tasking skills along with the ability to prioritize and manage a diverse workload to join our Office Services team. The ideal candidate will be managing the mailroom counter and covering reception as needed. This role requires the candidate to be in the office from 8am – 5pm.



Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and process all incoming and outgoing mail, courier shipments, and specialized deliveries, including domestic and international shipments.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for courier providers, ensuring timely delivery, tracking, and resolution of shipment-related issues.
  • Maintain accurate records of all incoming and outgoing mail, courier packages, cheques, security certificates, and confidential documents.
  • Program, issue, and maintain security access cards while ensuring records remain current and accurate.
  • Manage office services inventory, including stationery, supplies, and mailroom materials, proactively monitoring stock levels and placing orders as required.
  • Process invoices and expenses through Concur, ensuring accurate coding, supporting documentation, and timely submission.
  • Assist with invoice validation, expense reconciliation, and administrative support for office operations.
  • Support facilities-related requests, liaise with internal teams and vendors, and help coordinate office maintenance activities.
  • Maintain and update departmental procedures, manuals, and documentation to ensure processes remain current and efficient.
  • Oversee mailroom and copy room operations, ensuring equipment, supplies, and workspaces are maintained to a high standard.
  • Coordinate meeting room bookings and catering requests, ensuring rooms are properly set up and prepared when required.
  • Assist with the upkeep of meeting rooms, kitchens, and shared spaces by replenishing supplies, resetting rooms, loading and unloading dishwashers when needed, and maintaining a professional and welcoming environment for employees and clients.
  • Provide reception coverage and support as needed, including greeting visitors, managing calls, and delivering a professional client experience.
  • Respond to inquiries from employees, clients, vendors, and couriers in a professional and customer-focused manner.
  • Maintain detailed and accurate records of visitor access, deliveries, and office service activities.
  • Assist with special projects, events, and other operational initiatives as required.
  • Support the Office Services team with day-to-day operations while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and service delivery.
  • Safely lift, move, and transport boxes, packages, and office supplies as required throughout the office.


Skills & Qualifications:

  • Previous working experience in a similar role would be an asset;
  • Experience coordinating domestic and international courier shipments.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent customer service and communication skills;
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills;
  • Ability to problem solve and take initiative;
  • Detail oriented, professional, polished, corporate presentation;
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment;
  • Intermediate knowledge of MS Office (Outlook, Word & Excel).


#LI-SK1 #LI-Onsite #INDHP

All applications will be held in strict confidence.

In order to be considered for employment, candidates selected for interviews will be required to show proof of citizenship, permanent residence or eligibility to work in Canada with no restrictions.

Protecting your online safety:

Canaccord Genuity and its affiliates do not use text messages for recruitment purposes. If you have received a text message claiming to be from CG or an authorized representative regarding job recruitment, please treat as fraudulent and do not respond.

We wish to thank all candidates for their interest but only those applicants selected for an interview will be contacted. No phone calls please. Thank you for your understanding.

title: Director, Commercial Performance Insights
description:
For more than 70 years, MasterBrand has been shaping the places where people come together, enriching lives and creating meaningful memories for our customers. We are the #1 manufacturer of residential cabinets in North America, and our associates produce the most comprehensive portfolio of superior cabinetry products for the kitchen, bath and other parts of the home. Come see why our associates love working at MasterBrand.



Job Description:

The Director, Commercial Performance Insights is a strategic business partner to MasterBrand’s Builder and Distributor leadership, responsible for identifying, quantifying, and driving initiatives that improve commercial performance and profitability. This role will leverage data, analytics, and business insights to uncover opportunities across account productivity, pricing effectiveness, customer profitability, sales force performance, incentive compensation, and broader commercial operations.


As a commercial strategy and business performance role, the Director will develop analytical frameworks, dashboards, and recommendations that enable leadership to make fact-based decisions, optimize investments, and accelerate profitable growth. This individual will work cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Pricing, Customer Experience, Sales Operations, Field Operations, Continuous Improvement, and Executive Leadership to establish a culture of performance management and continuous improvement.


The Director will advance the organization from descriptive reporting to predictive, prescriptive, and action-oriented analytics; integrate internal and external data; strengthen commercial forecasting and scenario planning; and translate insights into executable actions with measurable financial impact.


Responsibilities


  • Unlock analytics as a competitive advantage: Develop and lead a comprehensive performance analytics strategy supporting the Builder and Distributor channels.
  • Pinpoint improvement opportunities: Identify and recommend actions that will improve revenue growth, expand gross margins, and drive commercial team effectiveness. Evaluate pricing strategies and how those translate to revenue growth and portfolio profitability. Assess sales force productivity at the rep, territory, and account level, and verify the accuracy and effectiveness of compensation and incentive plans.
  • Foster communication on business outcomes: Establish KPIs, scorecards, and reporting frameworks that drive accountability and informed decision-making.
  • Support channel strategy development: Develop predictive and prescriptive analytics, early-warning indicators, and scenario models that identify market opportunities and emerging risks.
  • Contextualize execution and performance: Integrate internal performance data with external market, customer insights, and competitive intelligence to validate decision making and distinguish market-driven results from execution-driven performance.
  • Offer relevant insights and recommendations: Translate complex data into actionable business recommendations and executive-level insights. Serve as a trusted advisor to Builder and Distributor leadership teams.
  • Strengthen core processes: Support annual planning, forecasting, budgeting, and sensitivity modeling with rigorous analysis. Pressure test assumptions, risks, resource allocation decisions, and alternative business strategies.
  • Facilitate business curiosity and creativity: Lead ad hoc analyses and executive requests related to commercial performance. Structure ambiguous business problems, develop hypotheses, and synthesize complex findings.
  • Support implementation: Partner with business leaders to convert insights into action plans, establish initiative owners and milestones, track execution, and validate realized financial and operational benefits.
  • Innovate the foundation: Build and manage advanced reporting, dashboards, and performance monitoring tools.
  • Foster sustainability: Partner with IT, Finance, and Sales Operations to improve data quality, accessibility, and governance. Establish and govern standard KPI definitions, business rules, reporting hierarchies, data lineage, and trusted sources of truth across Builder and Distributor performance reporting.
  • Evolve our approach: Drive adoption of self-service analytics and data-driven decision-making throughout the organization. Embed analytics into account reviews, forecasting, pricing decisions, sales coaching, strategic planning, and recurring business-performance routines through structured change management and capability building.
  • Develop a team: Lead, develop, and mentor analytics team members as the function grows. Build a high-performing analytics capability through organizational design, talent development, performance management, capability planning, and succession development.
  • Harness new technology: Evaluate and responsibly deploy emerging analytics, automation, machine-learning, and generative-AI capabilities that improve decision quality, speed, and scalability.

Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Analytics, or related field.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in commercial analytics, sales operations, finance, business intelligence, or related disciplines, including experience leading teams and enterprise-level, cross-functional initiatives from problem definition through implementation and benefit realization.
  • Experience supporting Builder, Distributor, Manufacturing, Building Products, or B2B sales organizations.
  • Demonstrated experience analyzing complex business problems using advanced analytical methods, including experience with large datasets and statistical analysis, forecasting, predictive modeling, and optimization. Can connect operational actions to business outcomes.
  • Expertise in Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Excel, or similar analytics platforms. Experience working with CRM, ERP, cloud data platforms, data warehouses, and commercial planning systems, with working knowledge of data architecture, dimensional modeling, master data, and data quality.
  • Proven ability to communicate complex findings to executive leadership. Demonstrated ability to simplify ambiguity, challenge assumptions constructively, and influence decisions without direct authority.
  • Customer-back mindset and a strong desire to help the team grow sales.
  • Willingness to use MasterBrand Business System tools as a foundational approach to complex problem solving.

Preferred


  • MBA or advanced degree.
  • Knowledge of pricing analytics, customer segmentation, and profitability modeling.
  • Experience with CRM and sales performance platforms such as Salesforce.
  • Familiarity with machine learning, optimization, or AI-enabled analytics.

description:
Why AIS?

What are we looking for?

At AIS, we're looking for more than just skills - we're looking for driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference, eager to grow, and aligned with our core principles.

Working@AIS

At AIS, we are dedicated to providing our employees with diverse opportunities to grow their careers while supporting a variety of impactful projects. For this position, we are seeking a talented individual to join AIS as a DevOps Engineer.


  • Core Knowledge & Skills: Proficient with branching strategies, CI/CD automation, Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform/Ansible), and intermediate scripting; improves monitoring and security practices.

  • Work & Complexity: Manages and optimizes pipelines for multiple projects, automates deployments, and resolves moderately complex infrastructure issues.

  • Quality & Independence: Conducts thorough testing, enhances reliability and performance, documents changes, and works independently on routine projects.

  • Teamwork & Communication: Coordinates with developers and operations teams, shares knowledge, provides clear updates, and helps align team efforts.

  • Consulting & Engagement: Advises on DevOps process improvements, offers technical recommendations, and participates in cross-functional initiatives.


As your initial project assignment, you will support the unique needs of our client as a Devops Engineer.



Project Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior DevOps Engineer with over 8 years of experience to join our innovative team. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in Azure cloud services, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipeline development, automation, and security best practices. You will play a key role in building, managing, and optimizing cloud-based production environments, enabling high-performance, secure, and scalable applications.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as subject-matter expert regarding DevSecOps related areas, tools and processes both in Azure cloud.
  • Develop Azure cloud-based and internal tools and processes to maintain stability and performance of our infrastructure.
  • Build, maintain, and troubleshoot several internal applications and respond to and resolve production issues.
  • Gather, analyze, and report system monitoring.
  • Deploy, maintain, and manage Azure cloud-based production systems ensuring high availability, performance, and security.
  • Build and scale web-based tools and solutions tailored for business needs.
  • Conduct security reviews and implement improvements to meet compliance and governance standards.
  • Operate effectively in an Agile environment, collaborating cross-functionally with development and operations teams.
  • Design, build, and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines for reliable delivery of applications and services.
  • Leverage container orchestration frameworks (e.g., Kubernetes) to manage deployment workflows.
  • Mentor team members and promote knowledge sharing and collaborative problem-solving.
  • Conduct regular security reviews and retrospectives to continuously improve security processes.
  • Use container orchestration technologies to manage production-level deployments.
  • Work collaboratively with software development teams across disciplines.

Required For This Opportunity

  • 8+ years of experience in DevOps or cloud engineering roles.
  • Strong experience with Azure infrastructure, tools, and services.
  • 3+ years of experience using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Bicep, ARM, etc.
  • Proficient in source code management tools: GitHub, Azure DevOps, GitLab, Bitbucket.
  • Hands-on experience with container-based infrastructure and production deployments.
  • Proficient in monitoring and logging tools such as AppInsights.
  • Strong programming/scripting experience with Bash, PowerShell, Python, or similar.
  • Familiarity with automation tools like Selenium, Playwright, etc.
  • Frontend/backend development experience is a plus (React, Angular, C#, Java, .NET).
  • In-depth understanding of cloud security, application security, SAST, and DAST practices.
  • Experience with incident response, troubleshooting, and participating in on-call rotations.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work independently with minimal oversight.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or other related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Strong work ethic, attention to detail, and zero-defect mentality. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision or assistance.
  • Strong problem-solving skills: innovation, collaboration, analysis, inductive reasoning.
  • Good understanding of technology and its application to any business process.
  • Proven experience supporting container-based infrastructure and managing production deployments.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience in Azure, Azure DevOps, Run books and automation   
  • Languages & Tools: PowerShell, PowerBI
  • Technologies: Cloud Architecture, ARM templates, Bicep, SQL

title: DWS - Solution Architect (m/f/d)
description:

Employer: DWS Group

Title: Solution Architect (m/f/d)

Location: Frankfurt

About DWS:

At DWS, we’re capturing the opportunities of tomorrow. You can be part of a leading, client-committed, global Asset Manager, making an impact on individuals, communities, and the world.

Join us on our journey, and you can shape our transformation by working side by side with industry thought-leaders and gaining new and diverse perspectives. You can share ideas and be yourself, whilst driving innovative and sustainable solutions that influence markets and behaviours for the better.

Every day brings the opportunity to discover a new now, and here at DWS, you’ll be supported as you overcome challenges and reach your ambitions. This is your chance to lead an extraordinary career and invest in your future.

Read more about DWS and who we are here.

Team / division overview

The Chief Technology Office (CTO) within the DWS COO division is responsible for shaping and delivering the firm's technology strategy, transformation agenda and innovation priorities. Working across business and technology functions, the CTO Office enables the delivery of scalable, secure and efficient technology solutions that support DWS's strategic objectives, operational effectiveness and long-term growth.

The Solution & Data Architecture team shape the architecture standards, patterns, and guidance that enable delivery teams to build scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions. They work closely with Domain Architects, Security specialists, Data SMEs, platform teams, and delivery squads to ensure that solutions are aligned with DWS strategy, architecture principles, and policy requirements.

The team supports delivery from early requirements shaping through to solution design, design governance, and implementation support. This includes defining data ingestion, transformation, and consumption approaches, designing application and service architectures, and contributing reusable patterns, decision trees, and architecture decision records. The team also explores emerging technologies and develop practical guidance to continuously improve the DWS technology landscape.

Your responsibilities

As a Solution Architect, you will be responsible for:

  • Translate functional and non-functional requirements into solution designs, building blocks, services, data pipelines, integrations, and user-facing components.

  • Own and drive end-to-end solution design, ensuring alignment with DWS architecture principles, technology strategy, security requirements, and design governance.

  • Work closely with data architects to define effective approaches for data ingestion, transformation, management, and consumption.

  • Guide and coach engineering teams during implementation to ensure designs are understood, practical, and delivered as intended.

  • Collaborate with Domain Architects and fellow Solution and Data Architects to create architecture decision records, reusable patterns, and practical guidance for recurring design challenges.

  • Support delivery teams in presenting and defending solution designs through relevant architecture and design authorities.

  • Evaluate, prototype, and assess new technologies, deriving practical usage patterns that help modernize and continuously improve the DWS technology estate.

We are looking for:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Typically 5+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or a comparable technology role.

  • Strong understanding of modern application architecture, distributed systems, APIs, integration patterns, and cloud-native design principles.

  • Experience in designing and building or integrating with ABAC or RBAC controls or systems (IAM)

  • Strong Java experience, including the Java ecosystem, Spring Boot, J2EE/Jakarta EE, and modern JDKs.

  • Ability to break down complex problems into clear, actionable, and implementable solution components.

  • Experience working with engineers, product teams, business stakeholders, and architecture or governance forums.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Experience in financial services, asset management, or another regulated environment.

  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform.

  • Experience with .NET, TypeScript, Python, or modern front-end and service development approaches.

  • Understanding of data architecture, data pipelines, data governance, and data consumption patterns.

  • Experience with TOGAF, SAFe, or comparable architecture and delivery frameworks.

  • Experience defining reusable architecture patterns, decision trees, architecture decision records, and design standards.

  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with the ability to assess their practical relevance for enterprise adoption.

  • Confident conversational and professional proficiency (B2)—you can comfortably negotiate, present, and collaborate with German-speaking clients.

  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

Posting Period: 08.09.2026 until further notice

What we’ll offer you:

Without the ambitions of our people, our achievements wouldn’t be possible. And it’s important to us that you enjoy coming to work - feeling healthy, happy and rewarded. At DWS, you’ll have access to a range of benefits which you can choose from to create a personalised plan unique to your lifestyle. Whether you’re interested in healthcare, company perks or are thinking about your retirement plan, there’s something for everyone.

Some of our core benefits:

  • Physical and Mental Health Well-Being benefits including (but not limited to) Statutory Health Insurance (BKK), sickness benefit allowance and support helplines for employees

  • Family friendly benefits including generous parental leave packages (supporting all variations of family set-ups) and support in finding childcare options including DWS’s own kindergarten service

  • A wide selection of pension plans, Personal Budget Accounts to enable sabbaticals or early retirement and capital-forming benefits

  • The opportunity to support our CSR strategy which is focused on combatting climate change & achieving greater social justice. You can make donations to our partnered organisations or take part in corporate volunteering opportunities in your local communities by providing on hand support.

DWS’ Hybrid Working model is designed to find the right balance between in-person collaboration and engagement in the office, which is core to our working culture, and working from home. Each business group varies on the split between time spent in the office and at home, but this will be discussed and made clear as part of your application and interview process. We will continue to review and evolve our working environments and methods to ensure that we are working in the best way possible for our people.

If you require any adjustments or changes to be made to the interview process for any reason including, or related to a disability or long-term health condition, then please contact your recruiter and let us know what assistance you may need. Examples of adjustments include providing a change to the format of the interview or providing assistance when at the DWS office. This will not affect your application and your recruitment team will discuss options with you.

Do these words resonate with you? They are our company values.

At Wepoint, we are looking for committed talents who are ready to share their expertise within open and collaborative teams, and who are not afraid to take initiative. We also value people who are able to challenge themselves and continuously improve.

At the heart of relationships at Wepoint are authenticity and the constant pursuit of excellence for our clients — this is what we expect from our future colleagues.

Descriptions du poste

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un(e) Tech Lead Guidewire pour rejoindre notre équipe.


À titre de Tech Lead Guidewire, vous vous joindrez à une équipe de développement contribuant à un programme stratégique de transformation en assurance de dommages. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'évolution de la plateforme Guidewire en assurant le leadership technique des équipes de livraison. Vous agirez comme référence technique auprès des équipes de développement et collaborerez étroitement avec les partenaires d'affaires, architectes et spécialistes qualité afin de concevoir et livrer des solutions performantes, évolutives et alignées sur les besoins d'affaires. Vous contribuerez à l'évolution des pratiques de développement, à la qualité des solutions et aux orientations technologiques de la plateforme Guidewire. Plus spécifiquement, vous serez amené(e) à :

    • Assurer le leadership technique de la plateforme Guidewire et agir comme expert de référence auprès des équipes de développement;
    • Traduire les besoins d'affaires, les requis fonctionnels et les orientations d'architecture en solutions technologiques robustes, évolutives, sécuritaires et maintenables;
    • Concevoir les stratégies de réalisation, participer aux décisions d'architecture applicative et guider les équipes dans l'implantation des solutions;
    • Encadrer, coacher et soutenir les développeurs afin de favoriser leur développement professionnel, l'autonomie des équipes et l'adoption des meilleures pratiques de développement;
    • Participer activement aux activités de conception détaillée, de développement, d'intégration, d'essais, de déploiement et de support applicatif;
    • Réaliser des revues de conception, de configuration et de code afin d'assurer le respect des standards de qualité, de sécurité, de performance, d'évolutivité et de maintenabilité;
    • Collaborer étroitement avec les architectes, analystes d'affaires, spécialistes qualité, équipes d'exploitation et partenaires technologiques afin d'assurer la cohérence des solutions et le succès des livraisons;
    • Analyser les enjeux techniques complexes, diriger les activités de résolution d'incidents majeurs, effectuer les analyses de causes racines et recommander les correctifs appropriés;
    • Participer à la planification des livraisons, à l'estimation des efforts, à la gestion des risques, des dépendances et des impacts techniques associés aux initiatives;
    • Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la plateforme en proposant et en mettant en œuvre des optimisations liées à la performance, à la stabilité, à l'automatisation, à l'observabilité et aux pratiques DevSecOps.

Qualifications

    • Certificat universitaire en informatique, génie logiciel ou dans une discipline appropriée;
    • Un minimum de huit (8) ans d’expérience pertinente en développement logiciel, dont six années avec la plateforme Guidewire et trois années dans un rôle de leadership technique, de chef(fe) développeur(euse) ou d'architecte applicatif;
    • Veuillez noter que d’autres combinaisons de formation et d’expérience pertinentes pourraient être considérées;
    • Certification Guidewire ACE obligatoire;
    • Connaissance du français nécessaire;
    • Maitrise de l’anglais de niveau avancé en raison de la nature des tâches, des outils de travail ou d'interactions avec des partenaires ou membres et client(e)s anglophones;
    • Expertise avec les services REST/SOAP, XML et JSON;
    • Expertise dans la livraison de solutions Guidewire complexes;
    • Maîtrise de Guidewire, Gosu et Java;
    • Maîtrise des architectures applicatives, de l'intégration et des environnements infonuagiques;
    • Connaissance des pratiques Agile, DevOps, CI/CD et des outils de gestion de code source;
    • Connaissance du domaine de l'assurance de dommages.

Position Summary:

  • This position collects data in the feed conversion houses and dissection laboratory by using measuring instruments and electronic devices. Other duties may be assigned.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Collect Data and Perform House Checklist within Feed Conversion Houses performing the following duties: weigh chickens into and out of their cages; record and add feed to feeders as needed; collect data with pen and paper and/or on a computer or tablet; dispose of dead birds as instructed; feed birds according to schedules; clean and disinfect equipment; house set-up; perform routine housekeeping duties; segregate birds according to line and sex as instructed; remove and place birds in cages according to schedules; examine birds for signs of illness and report any problems to lead or manager; monitor controls and thermostats that regulate temperature and humidity of the poultry house; perform simple math as part of recording information according to instructions such as bird weight, feed, added feed, and mortality; repair, align, and construct cages, pens or equipment (feeders, water lines, lights, vents, etc); Set up and prepare house for incoming flocks. (60%)
  • Collect Data within Dissection Laboratory performing the following duties: euthanize birds; use scalpel to dissect birds into specific parts to accepted protocols; visually score for defects in physiology; use a caliper to collect data; enter weights and defects into tablet or computer; dispose of dead dissect birds into incinerators (30%)

Other duties, responsibilities, and activities:

  • Collect lab samples; clean, disinfect, and haul coops; maintain foot bath, hand sanitizer, hydro-foamer, sweep, mop, and other general cleaning; properly euthanize birds in accordance with company (10%)

Biosecurity/Animal Welfare:

  • The jobsite is a biosecure environment which requires showering, changing clothing and footwear before entering the facility. Appropriate clothing and footwear are provided by the Company. No jewelry may be worn on the jobsite except for medical ID jewelry and body piercings covered by appropriate clothing. Must be willing to sign an agreement to avoid any avian species (chickens, ducks, birds, etc.). Must be willing to sign and abide by the Company Biosecurity and Company Animal Welfare Guidelines.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

  • The successful candidate(s) must be willing and able to perform the physical requirements of the job with or without reasonable accommodation.
  • Physical: Must use safe lifting techniques. Must regularly lift and/or move 25 pounds, and occasionally up to 50 pounds, items such as cases of Synergize, supplies, etc; required to occasionally use wheeled dollies to lift and/or move up to 500 pounds of feed, supplies, etc. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand majority of shift on concrete; walk; sit; use hands to handle or feel objects and controls; reach with hands and arms; balance; climbing/ladder usage; stoop/bend up to 1000 times per day; repetitive hand/wrist movements while dissecting birds with scalpel, knife or other cutting instrument; talk or hear; drive a vehicle within the farm complex. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision; distance vision; color vision; peripheral vision; depth perception; and the ability to adjust focus. Must have good communication skills to accurately convey opinions and concerns.
  • Tools and Equipment: Scale, Tablet, Scanner, Oximeter, Scalpel, Drill, Safety Knife, Pressure Washer
  • Environment: Required to work on wet, slippery surfaces and work in hot, dry, extreme dusty, wet and cold environments.
  • Personal Protective Equipment Required: Safety goggles, safety glasses, face shield, chemical gloves, cutting gloves, waterproof apron, and rubber boots are required. Must wear company provided facial covering. Ear plugs will be used as needed. NIOSH approved N95 particulate respirators will be worn as needed.
  • Chemicals Commonly Used: Disinfectants such as Synergize, Viricide, Simple Green, Lysol, etc.
  • Safety: TM is expected to follow all applicable safety policies and procedures. These include but are not limited to Hazard Communication, Respiratory Protection, LOTO and Personal Protective Equipment. TM is expected to identify, address and mitigate safety related risks.

title: Senior Data Center Engineer

description:
The West Kowloon Cultural District Authority welcomes exceptional talent with a passion to realise the vision and mission of making the West Kowloon Cultural District a prime local and international destination for arts, culture and entertainment.



The Ticketing Assistant (BOH) provides day‑to‑day administrative and technical support for the ticketing platform’s backend. This role assists with event data entry, reconciliation checks, system testing, and user access management. Working closely with the Ticketing Officer and Senior Ticketing Officer, you will help ensure smooth backend operations for both WKCDA‑owned and hirers’ events.


Key Responsibilities

System Configuration & Event Setup (Back End)

  • Assist in setting up user accounts and permissions under guidance.
  • Conduct pre-go-live checks to verify product listing accuracy.

Data Integrity & Reconciliation

  • Support daily reconciliation between ticket sales, payment gateway reports, and bank settlements.
  • Identify and help resolve system discrepancies (e.g., double bookings, inventory mismatches, refund errors).
  • Prepare settlement statements for hirers and finance teams, ensuring commission and fee structures are correctly applied.

Data Integrity & Reconciliation

  • Assist daily reconciliation by extracting sales reports and payment gateway logs.
  • Flag discrepancies (e.g., inventory mismatches, refund errors) to the Ticketing Officer.
  • Help prepare settlement summaries for hirers and finance teams.

System Maintenance & Testing

  • Execute test cases during user acceptance testing (UAT) and document outcomes.
  • Report system bugs or anomalies to the Ticketing Officer.
  • Maintain simple system health logs.

Process & Documentation

  • Follow BOH SOPs for event setup, reconciliation, and access control.
  • Support training sessions by preparing materials and system access for hirers.
  • Ensure handling of backend data complies with data privacy regulations (PDPO, PIPL, GDPR).

Reporting & Analytics

  • Generate basic sales reports and inventory snapshots as requested.
  • Provide ad‑hoc data extracts to marketing, finance, or curatorial teams.
  • Perform any other duties from time to time as reasonably assigned by the Authority.

You should

  • possess a Higher Diploma or Associate Degree in Information Systems, Business, Finance, or related field;
  • have 1+ year of experience in ticketing, box office, or administrative support (fresh graduates with strong intern experience may be considered);
  • be familiar with ticketing platforms or CRM systems is preferred;

  • have experience in following test scripts or UAT – an advantage;

  • be detail-oriented and able to follow processes accurately;
