title: Senior Data Engineer II - Scalable Growth
description:
Wise

Employment: full time

London

Job Description

Company Description

Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.

Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
For everyone, everywhere.

We’re looking for a seasoned, senior Data Engineer with a strong software engineering background to join our Scalable Growth team within the Global Product Tribe.

In this role, you’ll report directly to the Scalable Growth Engineering Lead while embedding day-to-day with the Marketing Platform team. You will serve as the technical authority on data architecture, bridging the gap between platform engineering and analytics engineering. You’ll bring maturity, resilience, and scalability to our data infrastructure—building and shaping systems that handle high-volume streaming and batch data to fuel our global marketing engine.

If you thrive in an environment where you can scope complex problem spaces, mentor engineers in data best practices, and directly impact how Wise attracts millions of customers globally, this is the role for you.

How we work

Scalable Growth is dedicated to building enabling technology that helps Wise acquire customers at the lowest possible cost.

Within this space, the Marketing Platform team owns the data pipelines, internal tools, and integrations with third‑party vendors (e.g., Meta, Google) that power our acquisition channels. As our dedicated data lead, you’ll work cross‑functionally with engineers, product managers, digital analytics leads, and marketing stakeholders (Paid, Organic, CRM) to transform our marketing data infrastructure into a true platform product.

What will you be working on?

  • Drive Data Architecture & Resilience: Audit, map out, and elevate our current data pipelines and streaming architectures. Establish best practices for monitoring, reliability, and scale across our data ecosystem (using Python, dbt, Airflow, Kafka, and Trino/Iceberg).

  • Build the Unified Customer View: Productionize PoCs into scalable Airflow/dbt data workflows to lay the groundwork for our Customer Data Platform (CDP) datasets.

  • Bridge Engineering & Analytics: Partner with analytics leads to define clear boundaries and standards for data ingestion, cleansing, and transformation—bringing a strong analytics engineering mindset (specifically via dbt) to raw data landing.

  • Own MarTech Infrastructure: Work alongside Engineering Leads to bring technology ownership of MarTech systems (e.g., Braze, HighTouch reverse ETL) in-house, building end‑to‑end solutions rather than isolated data plumbing.

  • Technical Scoping & Discovery: Take ownership of broad, ambiguous problem spaces. Uncover hidden challenges, propose robust architectural designs, and execute your own roadmap.

  • Coach & Mentor: Elevate the data capabilities of software engineers in the squad through code reviews, architectural guidance, and hands‑on mentoring.

Qualifications

What do you need?

We are fully aware that it is uncommon for a candidate to have all skills required, and we fully support everyone in learning new skills with us. So if you have some of those listed below and are eager to learn more, we do want to hear from you!

  • Python & Big Data Expertise: Advanced proficiency in Python and proven experience architecting, deploying, and maintaining Big Data and streaming/batch pipelines (e.g., Kafka Streams, Event Streaming, Trino, Iceberg).

  • dbt & Airflow Proficiency: Hands‑on experience using dbt for scalable data transformations and Airflow for workflow orchestration.

  • Data Architecture Mastery: A strong background in designing scalable, fault‑tolerant data architectures, implementing data quality frameworks, and establishing production best practices.

  • Product & Discovery Mindset: Ability to take a vague problem statement, independently uncover the requirements, scope project milestones, and drive solutions end‑to‑end.

  • Cross‑functional Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication skills with the ability to bridge tech, marketing, and analytics, turning marketing needs into crisp engineering roadmaps.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with MarTech tooling or reverse ETL setups (e.g., HighTouch, Braze, vendor API integrations).

  • Familiarity with modern AI/ML data integration practices.

  • Background in fintech or fast‑scaling tech platform environments.

Additional Information

Interested? Find out more:

  • Wise Tech Stack

  • Wise Engineering Blog

  • Engineering career map

We’re proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.

Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

title: DEX & IT Operations Senior Manager
description:
We’re looking for a Senior Manager, DEX & IT Operations to join our team on a permanent basis. This hybrid role offers the flexibility to be based from either our Leeds or Bradford office, with two days in the office and three days working remotely each week.

This is an exciting opportunity to play a key role in shaping and leading Blume’s internal technology landscape as we continue to grow and evolve as an independent business. Supporting colleagues across multiple geographies and time zones, you’ll be responsible for ensuring our core enterprise systems are secure, reliable, and positioned to support future growth.

Reporting to the Director of IT Operations, you’ll lead the day-to-day delivery of IT Operations, managing a specialist team and overseeing our managed service partners. You’ll drive critical migration and transformation initiatives, helping consolidate and modernise our technology estate while maintaining high standards of service, security, and governance.

Working across platforms including Workday, Microsoft 365, Atlassian, and ERP systems, you’ll ensure business-critical services remain resilient, compliant, and operationally effective, enabling our people to do their best work and supporting the continued success of the business.

What will you be doing?

  • Lead, coach and develop a high-performing IT Operations team, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee the day-to-day operation, support and optimisation of core enterprise platforms, including Workday, Microsoft 365, Atlassian and ERP systems.
  • Own user access, system configuration, integrations and data integrity, ensuring reliable and efficient business operations.
  • Drive system migrations, upgrades and technology transformation initiatives, supporting the move to a streamlined and well-governed technology estate.
  • Manage and direct third-party IT service providers, ensuring delivery against agreed service levels and operational objectives.
  • Maintain strong security, compliance and governance standards across all managed systems, ensuring audit readiness and regulatory compliance.
  • Monitor system performance, availability and service metrics, identifying opportunities to enhance reliability and user experience.
  • Act as the senior escalation point for critical incidents and service issues, coordinating timely resolution and minimising business impact.
  • Oversee software licensing, vendor relationships and operational budgets within agreed frameworks and roadmaps.
  • Ensure robust documentation, change management, business continuity and disaster recovery processes are maintained and regularly reviewed.

We tend to look for people with:

Essential:

  • Proven experience leading IT Operations or enterprise systems within a complex, multi-site organisation.
  • Strong hands-on experience managing business-critical platforms such as Microsoft 365, Workday, ERP, or Atlassian environments.
  • Expertise in system integrations, data flows, and ensuring data accuracy across interconnected platforms.
  • Solid knowledge of Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), Intune, and identity and access management.
  • Experience leading, coaching and developing technical teams to deliver high-quality services and outcomes.
  • Demonstrated success managing third-party IT service providers and vendors, ensuring delivery against agreed service levels.
  • Track record of delivering system implementations, migrations, upgrades, and transformation initiatives.
  • Good understanding of IT security, governance, compliance, data protection, and audit requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritise effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Desirable

  • Experience with integration and automation technologies such as Power Automate, Workato, MuleSoft, REST APIs, or webhooks.
  • Background working within professional services or other regulated environments.
  • Experience consolidating and modernising complex technology estates.
  • Familiarity with ITIL or similar service management frameworks, including SLA and KPI reporting.
  • Experience managing software licensing, renewals, and vendor relationships.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, Azure, Workday, Atlassian, ITIL, or project management qualifications.
  • Experience using scripting or low-code automation to improve operational efficiency.
  • Previous experience supporting a rapidly growing organisation across multiple regions or time zones.


What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive salary + Bonus
  • 25 days annual leave + buy 5 days
  • Access to wellbeing and mental health benefits such as the Calm app, personal medical, critical illness cover and dental insurance, plus many more.
  • Matched pension contribution up to 10%
  • Life assurance & income protection
  • Exclusive Virgin Media O2 products, employee discounts and cashback offers on thousands of brands
  • Access to electric car scheme
  • 24 hours paid volunteering leave

Who we are:

#LibertyBlume a Liberty Global company, is a rapidly growing business services provider, specialising in tech-enabled back-office solutions. Our mission is to deliver efficiency, scale and value to our customers through Business, Procurement and Financial Solutions. If you’re curious, customer centric and enjoy being one step ahead, join us on our scale up journey and unlock your freedom to grow!

Liberty Global is an equal opportunity employer, committed to an inclusive environment and accommodating all candidates. We’re eager to hear from you, no matter your background.

title: Staff Data Engineer Engineering · Sydney · Full time · Hybrid
description:
Staff Data Engineer

Full-time | Hybrid | Sydney

Reports to: VP of Engineering

About Us:

Checkbox is a Series A technology company building AI-native SaaS for in-house legal teams. Our platform helps legal teams manage how work is raised, understood, routed, actioned and resolved across the business.

We are now transforming our SaaS ecosystem into agentic-first products, using AI agents and intelligent workflow automation to change how legal work gets done. To support this, we are investing deeply in the data, context and retrieval foundations that power reliable AI product experiences.

This is a critical next chapter for Checkbox. Our data platform needs to become more than infrastructure. It needs to become a competitive moat.

The Role

We are looking for a Staff Data Engineer / Data Architect to own Checkbox's data strategy and the architecture that delivers it.

This role reporting directly to the VP of Engineering. You will join our tier-one Data team, being deeply hands-on in the design and delivery of the systems you define.

The Data team exists to serve the product engineering streams building AI agents, so close day-to-day partnership with Product, Engineering, AI and Platform teams is central to the role.

You will own the data and AI reference architecture that underpins our agentic product direction. This includes base data sources, intelligence services, context and retrieval layers, API and MCP surfaces, and the secure data access patterns required to give AI agents compliant, tenant-isolated context.

This is not a role for someone who only wants to design from a distance. We need someone who has built data and context foundations for AI products in production, can make pragmatic architecture decisions, and can lead by building.

What You'll Own

Data and AI Reference Architecture

  • Own the data and AI reference architecture across Checkbox's product ecosystem

  • Define how base data sources, intelligence services, APIs, MCP surfaces, context engines and retrieval layers fit together

  • Design patterns that allow product engineering streams to build AI features on shared foundations rather than reinventing data access each time

  • Establish clear architectural principles for storage, retrieval, serving, tenancy, observability and compliance

  • Work hand in glove with the Principal Engineer on architecture that spans application, platform, eventing, data and AI systems

Context, Retrieval and AI Data Foundations

  • Architect and build the context and retrieval layers that power AI agents and GenAI product experiences

  • Design secure, tenant-isolated data access patterns for AI systems

  • Define how customer, matter, workflow, document, event and operational data should be modelled, retrieved and served

  • Evaluate and select the right data patterns for each problem, including transactional stores, operational data stores, warehouses, vector stores, semantic layers, knowledge graphs, event streams and APIs

  • Make buy-vs-build decisions layer by layer rather than defaulting everything to in-house development

  • Ensure AI agents receive the right context at the right time, with appropriate controls around access, relevance, latency, cost and compliance

Data Platform, Integrations and Eventing

  • Own architecture across integrations, eventing, operational data, transactional data and AI-ready data

  • Define data contracts, event models, ingestion patterns and transformation approaches that scale across multiple products

  • Partner with product engineering teams to ensure new product capabilities generate usable, reliable and well-governed data

  • Build shared data capabilities that support analytics, AI agents, workflow automation and customer-facing product experiences

  • Improve data quality, lineage, observability and reliability across the data lifecycle

Security, Tenancy and Compliance

  • Treat security, tenancy and data isolation as first-order architectural concerns

  • Ensure data access patterns are compliant, auditable and appropriate for enterprise customers

  • Design systems that support tenant isolation, data segregation, least privilege access and secure retrieval

  • Partner with Platform, Security and Engineering teams on encryption, decryption, access control, auditability and production readiness

  • Ensure data and context systems can support customer trust, compliance requirements and future audit needs

Team Leadership and Technical Direction

  • Set technical direction while staying close to implementation

  • Partner with 1 other Staff Engineer in our Greenfield Data Platform, sharing the load across Analytics, Warehousing, AI & ML.

  • Mentor engineers on data architecture, AI data foundations, retrieval patterns and pragmatic systems design

  • Build operating rhythms, standards and documentation that help the Data team scale

  • Act as the senior technical voice for data architecture across engineering leadership discussions

What Success Looks Like

  • Product engineering streams can build AI features on a dependable, shared data and context layer

  • The data and AI reference architecture is real, documented, actively used and continuously improved

  • Storage, retrieval and serving choices genuinely fit the problem rather than forcing every use case through one pattern

  • Data access is compliant, secure and tenant-isolated by default

  • AI agents can access relevant context reliably, with clear controls around quality, latency, cost and permissions

  • Data contracts, event models and retrieval patterns reduce duplication across product teams

  • The Data team becomes a strategic enabler for AI product development rather than a bottleneck

  • Checkbox's data and context capability becomes visibly stronger as a competitive moat

About You

  • Significant experience as a senior data engineer, principal data engineer, data architect, staff engineer or similar technical leadership role

  • Proven experience building data and context foundations that power AI products in production

  • Strong experience designing data architectures across transactional, operational, analytical and AI-ready systems

  • Deep understanding of modern data platform patterns, including data contracts, event-driven architecture, ingestion, transformation, observability, lineage and governance

  • Strong understanding of AI data patterns such as retrieval systems, embeddings, semantic modelling, vector search, knowledge graphs, context engineering or agentic workflows

  • Experience working with multi-tenant SaaS systems where data segregation, tenancy and access control matter

  • Ability to make pragmatic architecture decisions and select the right tool or pattern for each problem

  • Strong judgement around buy-vs-build decisions across data infrastructure, retrieval, orchestration and AI platform layers

  • Comfortable leading technical direction while still building, reviewing and shipping

  • Experience mentoring engineers or leading small technical teams

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work closely with product engineering streams, platform teams and senior engineering leadership

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where systems are being built, scaled and refined at the same time

Bonus Points

  • Experience working on AI agents, agentic workflows, GenAI platforms or AI-native SaaS products

  • Experience designing MCP or API surfaces for data and context access

  • Experience with legal tech, workflow automation, enterprise SaaS or document-heavy products

  • Experience with AWS-based data and platform infrastructure

  • Experience with event-driven systems, queues, Pub/Sub patterns or streaming architectures

  • Experience with data security, compliance, auditability and enterprise customer requirements

  • Experience growing a small data function from early foundations into a scalable team

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary

  • Hybrid working with team days in our Sydney CBD office

  • Direct reporting line to the VP of Engineering

  • High ownership over a tier-one engineering function

  • Opportunity to shape the data and AI architecture behind agentic-first products

  • Personal learning and development budget

  • Flexible leave policy

  • Expense policy and salary sacrifice options

  • CBD start-up hub with snacks, drinks, premium coffee and team socials

  • Company-wide social events and annual off-sites

  • Transparent, flat culture where questions and feedback are welcomed

title: VPK Part-Time After School Program Assistant
description:
VPK After School Care Program Assistant

Location: 1201 S Goodman Rd. Championsgate, FL 33896

Position Type: Part-Time, Hourly

Pay Rate: $15.00 – $18.00 per hour

About Us

SMART Management is a mission-driven education management organization supporting high-quality Pre-K–12 charter schools across Florida. We partner closely with school leaders and governing boards to build strong academic, operational, and cultural systems that help schools — and educators — thrive long term.

Creative Inspiration Journey School (CIJS), supported by SMART Management, serves students through an innovative, inquiry-based approach and is united by a bold mission: to inspire lifelong learning through a Reggio Emilia-inspired, student-centered academic experience enriched by project-based learning and natural surroundings. At CIJS, educators are part of a collaborative, growth-oriented community where high expectations, strong support, and a deep belief in every child’s potential guide our work each day.

Position Overview

The Part Time After School Program Assistant member is responsible for supervising and supporting students during after-school programming in a safe, structured, and engaging environment. Reporting to the After School Care Director, this role ensures students remain safe, active, and productive after the regular school day ends.

This position is ideal for energetic individuals who enjoy working with youth, excel at maintaining classroom structure, and take pride in fostering a positive, supportive setting.

Key Responsibilities

Student Supervision & Safety

  • Supervise students at all times to maintain a secure environment.

  • Execute accurate attendance tracking and enforce strict student check-in and dismissal protocols.

  • Follow all safety protocols, including emergency procedures and incident reporting.

  • Monitor behavior and intervene proactively to maintain campus structure and decorum.

Program Implementation

  • Facilitate structured after-school routines, including dedicated homework time, physical recreation, and enrichment activities.

  • Assist with activity setup, game facilitation, and smooth operational transitions between spaces.

Culture & Behavior Management

  • Reinforce school-wide behavior expectations and core values.

  • Build positive, respectful relationships with students while upholding clear boundaries.

  • Address behavioral concerns promptly and escalate issues to leadership when necessary.

Family & Community Interaction

  • Maintain a professional, welcoming presence for parents and guardians during student pickup.

  • Communicate basic student updates clearly and professionally.

  • Strictly enforce authorized pick-up procedures to guarantee student safety.

Key Success Metrics (Year 1)

  • Zero major safety incidents during after-school program hours.

  • Consistent 100% accuracy in daily attendance and dismissal procedures.

  • Positive parent and family feedback regarding after-school experiences.

  • Seamless adherence to program schedules and operational expectations.

Core Values & Cultural Fit

  • And How Are the Children?: Prioritize student safety, well-being, and overall experience above all else.

  • Big Rocks First: Focus relentlessly on active supervision, safety, and structural integrity.

  • Own It: Take full ownership and personal responsibility for the students under your supervision.

  • Expect More: Hold high standards for student behavior, engagement, and mutual respect.

  • Results Matter: Recognize that delivering a safe, structured, and enriching after-school care environment is essential to our school's mission.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Education: High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • Experience: Prior experience supervising or managing groups of children (school, daycare, camp, or youth sports setting) strongly preferred.

  • Attributes: Punctual, dependable, highly attentive, and effective at managing student behavior.

  • Mission Alignment: Shared commitment to SMART Management & CIJS core values.

  • References: Candidates must be able to provide three professional references, including at least one direct supervisor.

title: Braiding and Extrusion Center of Excellence Strategy Leader
location: Danvers, Massachusetts, United States of America
description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 11 Oct 2026


Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

A Day in the Life

The Braiding and Extrusion Center of Excellence Strategy Leader is part of the Manufacturing Technology and Engineering organization, supporting enterprise-wide advancement of braiding and extrusion manufacturing capabilities across Medtronic. The team partners with Operating Units, Research and Development, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and manufacturing sites to develop manufacturing strategies, establish technology standards, and accelerate adoption of new production capabilities that support current and future product portfolios.

This position is based onsite at the Medtronic facility in Danvers, Massachusetts, with an expectation of working onsite four days per week. Up to 25% travel is required to support collaboration with manufacturing sites, technology partners, suppliers, and cross-functional stakeholders.

The Braiding and Extrusion Center of Excellence Strategy Leader is responsible for defining and executing enterprise manufacturing technology strategies for braiding and extrusion processes. This role leads cross-functional collaboration to develop technology roadmaps, establish manufacturing standards, evaluate emerging technologies, and drive deployment of new capabilities that improve manufacturing performance, scalability, and product quality.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead the Braiding and Extrusion Center of Excellence, including enterprise strategy, capability development, and technology roadmap planning.
  • Define and maintain manufacturing strategies for braiding and extrusion technologies to support network capacity, site capabilities, and future growth objectives.
  • Establish enterprise standards for equipment, tooling, materials, automation, process controls, and quality systems.
  • Partner with Operating Units, Research and Development, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to align technology investments with business and product needs.
  • Provide technical leadership to manufacturing sites through process optimization, yield improvement, defect reduction, equipment enhancement, and capability expansion initiatives.
  • Identify, assess, and prioritize emerging braiding and extrusion technologies through collaboration with suppliers, academic institutions, and industry partners.
  • Drive feasibility assessments, proof-of-concept activities, and industrialization efforts that accelerate manufacturing technology readiness and deployment.
  • Ensure manufacturing technologies, standards, and processes support regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and scalable production.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree with 10+ years of manufacturing, engineering, or advanced manufacturing experience OR advanced degree with 8+ years of manufacturing, engineering, or advanced manufacturing experience.
  • Experience with braiding technologies, extrusion technologies, or both in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience developing and deploying manufacturing processes, equipment, or production technologies.
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving engineering, manufacturing, quality, and operational stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous Medtronic experience.
  • Experience with wire or polymer braiding, braid angle optimization, tension control, pick count optimization, or textile structure development.
  • Experience with single-lumen, multi-lumen, multi-layer, reinforced, or specialty polymer extrusion technologies.
  • Experience defining long-range manufacturing technology roadmaps and deploying new technologies into production environments.
  • Experience supporting global organizations and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

JOB SUMMARY

The Delivery Technician is responsible for delivering durable medical equipment to Apria patients in the home.



ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

c) Animals in the home that cause unsanitary conditions

description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. What you’ll be doing...


The Transformation Data Science team addresses high-impact, analytically driven projects focused within three core pillars: Forecasting, Involuntary Churn & Bad Debt and Credit optimization. In the role of AI Workflow Engineer, you will be:


  • Developing and deploying autonomous AI agentic workflows to streamline complex financial planning and analytical processes.
  • Implementing and optimizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems to provide accurate, context-aware insights for financial decision-making.
  • Integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into existing financial data pipelines to enhance forecasting accuracy and reduce manual processing time.
  • Ensuring all AI-driven financial workflows are auditable, explainable, and meet strict financial data governance and compliance standards.
  • Designing and building autonomous agents using LLMs and applying advanced prompt engineering techniques to solve complex financial problems.

title: Managing Director of Corporate Relations
description:
Managing Director of Corporate Relations

Ducks Unlimited National Headquarters - Memphis, TN

Ducks Unlimited, Inc., the continent’s leader in waterfowl and wetlands conservation, seeks a Managing Director of Corporate Relations to lead national corporate engagement strategy and strengthen DU’s brand through organization-wide partnerships. Working with internal teams, volunteers, corporate partners, retailers, licensees, sponsors, and other stakeholders, this role will coordinate corporate partnerships, sponsorships, licensing, affinity marketing, national promotions, retail relations, cause-related marketing, and partner stewardship. The Managing Director will leverage DU’s trusted brand to expand visibility, revenue, influence, and conservation impact while helping shape strategic direction as opportunities evolve.

This position reports to the National Director of Corporate and Foundation Partnerships and is expected to reside in Memphis, TN, the site of Ducks Unlimited National Headquarters.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, marketing, communications, nonprofit management, or related field.
  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in corporate relations, business development, brand partnerships, sponsorship sales, or similar revenue development role.
  • Proven success in identifying, cultivating, soliciting, securing, and stewarding complex corporate partnerships, sponsorships, or contracts.
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, relationship-building, and travel flexibility, including overnight travel and non-traditional hours as needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master’s degree in business, marketing, communications, nonprofit management, or related field.
  • Experience in conservation, outdoor recreation, nonprofit fundraising, or a mission-driven organization.
  • Familiarity with brand management, product development/distribution, trademark licensing, retail relations, sponsorship sales, and corporate culture.
  • Experience leading teams, coordinating cross-functional initiatives, managing budgets, and using Microsoft Office, Power BI, and CRM systems; Blackbaud CRM preferred.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive national corporate relations strategy that aligns with DU’s national objectives, advances an aggressive and relevant conservation mission, and leverages coordinated internal and external partnerships to expand reach, revenue, influence, and conservation impact.
  • Grow and coordinate DU’s brand awareness and partnership opportunities through sponsorships, licensing, promotions, retail relations, cause-related marketing, and related corporate programs, ensuring every extension of the brand is consistent, unified, and mission-aligned.
  • Cultivate, structure, and steward substantial, multi-layered relationships with corporate partners, community organizations, industry leaders, volunteers, and internal stakeholders that strengthen DU’s brand presence, expand public engagement, and help shape strategic direction as opportunities evolve.
  • Lead, mentor, and coordinate professional staff and cross-functional teams to ensure corporate engagement, licensing, sponsorship, retail, promotional, and partner stewardship initiatives operate as integrated extensions of DU’s brand and deliver measurable mission value.
  • Partner closely with the Sr. Advisory Vice President of Corporate Relations and provide strategic guidance to the volunteer Corporate Relations Committee, ensuring volunteer leadership, corporate engagement priorities, and national relationship strategies are aligned with DU’s broader mission and revenue objectives.

Skills:

  • Relationship-building, communication, writing, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Strategic thinking and analytical ability to assess market trends, partner objectives, stakeholder feedback, and revenue opportunities.
  • Leadership, collaboration, sound judgment, attention to detail, deadline management, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Knowledge of conservation values, outdoor traditions, corporate partnerships, sponsorship sales, product development, CRM systems, and corporate culture.


Benefits/Salary: Salary will be based on experience. DU offers an exceptional benefit package, including comprehensive group medical, prescription, dental and vision insurance, including spouse and dependent coverage; three weeks paid vacation, paid sick leave, and ten paid holidays; 401(k) plan (including partial employer match); and tuition reimbursement.

title: Assistant to the Editor, The World of Interiors

London, GB

title: Senior I&C Engineer II
description:
About NECI

NECI?is the leading Automation solutions provider transforming manufacturing,?lab operations, process development and process control across a range of process industries in Northeast.?NECI?relentlessly seeks to drive the outcomes that ‘change the game’ for our clients and is seeking team members to join in our mission.

Here’s What You’ll Get

  • Highly competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending or Health Savings Accounts
  • Unlimited Vacation Time
  • 10 Paid Holidays
  • 12 Paid Weeks Birthing Parent Leave
  • Pet Insurance
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) and Employee Stock Ownership Plan
  • Employee Referral Bonus
  • Professional Development Reimbursement
  • Company Paid STD, LTD, and Life Insurance

The Role

The NECI Senior I&C Engineer II role owns the largest and most complex I&C scopes in the portfolio with limited oversight. This role reports to the Manager, I&C Engineering and is expected to be a technical subject matter expert inside the team and in front of customers.

You will lead control system hardware design and field execution scopes and act as the escalation point for difficult technical problems. You will direct the technical work of other engineering staff assigned to your projects, even though this role does not have direct reports.

This is not a task execution role. You are responsible for technical outcomes, design quality, customer confidence, and the accuracy of the engineering basis used for proposals, estimates, bills of material, and project execution.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Authority and Leadership

  • Serve as an internal and external technical authority for one or more core I&C technology areas.
  • Lead the most complex control system hardware, panel, instrumentation, and industrial network scopes assigned to the team.
  • Support definition of engineering standards, design approaches, calculation methods, and review expectations that are adopted by the broader I&C Engineering group.
  • Act as the escalation point for difficult design issues, field problems, vendor questions, and commissioning defects.
  • Review work prepared by my junior roles and provide clear technical direction.
  • Mentor engineers in hardware design, field troubleshooting, customer communication, and technical decision making.

Design and Specification

  • Own design packages for DCS and PLC control system hardware, including controllers, redundant remote I/O, communication interfaces, gateways, redundancy schemes, and power distribution.
  • Produce and review UL 508A panel designs, including enclosure layouts, SCCR calculations, component selection, grounding, labeling, wiring, and compliance requirements.
  • Design and troubleshoot industrial communication networks, including PROFIBUS DP/PA, PROFINET, Modbus TCP/RTU, Ethernet/IP, HART, Foundation Fieldbus, DeviceNet, and AS-i.
  • Develop industrial network architectures, switch selections, ring topologies, and physical-layer diagnostic approaches.
  • Specify field instrumentation, including thermocouples, RTDs, pressure, flow, level, and analytical devices.
  • Use and review electrical CAD deliverables in AutoCAD Electrical, SolidWorks Electrical, EPLAN, or similar tools.
  • Apply NFPA 70, UL 508A, UL 698A, IEC, ISA, and IEEE standards to real project designs.

Project Execution

  • Lead engineering execution from design basis through turnover.
  • Coordinate with panel fabrication subcontractors while retaining Stellix ownership of the design, HFAT, commissioning support, and turnover package.
  • Own technical decisions during design reviews, fabrication questions, hardware testing, commissioning, and closeout.
  • Identify technical risk early and drive it to closure before it affects schedule, cost, or field execution.

Customer and Commercial Support

  • Support sales and project development for complex opportunities through FEED studies, site walkdowns, scope definition, hours estimates, BOM generation, compliance tables, and proposal write-ups.
  • Develop proposal content for major I&C opportunities with enough detail that the scope, assumptions, exclusions, and technical basis are clear.
  • Communicate directly with customers, vendors, subcontractors, project managers, and internal leadership on assigned work.
  • Maintain billable utilization consistent with a senior engineering services role.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related experience.
  • 8+ years of I&C, controls, electrical, automation, or process instrumentation engineering experience.
  • 2 to 4+ years in a senior, lead, or technical owner capacity.
  • SME level knowledge in controls theory and advanced working knowledge of control system hardware, UL 508A panel design, instrumentation, and industrial networks.
  • Proven ability to lead large, complex engineering scopes from early definition through turnover.
  • Strong written and verbal communication with customers, vendors, and internal teams.
  • Ability to travel 30 to 50%, primarily within New England.

Preferred

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • Professional Engineer license or active path toward licensure.
  • Deep experience in cGMP, validated, pharmaceutical, biopharma, or life sciences environments.
  • Experience developing engineering standards, templates, design guides, or review methods used by other engineers.
  • Strong background with HFAT, commissioning, troubleshooting, and project closeout.

Here’s What You’ll Get

  • Highly competitive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending or Health Savings Accounts
  • Unlimited Vacation Time

  • 12 Paid Weeks Birthing Parent Leave

title: Instructional Coach
description:
Instructional Coach


Date Posted: 9/25/26

Campus: BridgePrep Broward, 1100 Hillcrest Dr.Hollywood, FL 33021

Reports To: Principal

Compensation: $54,500 – $62,500 Base Salary + Up to $10,000 in Performance Pay


About Us

SMART Management is a mission-driven education management organization supporting high-quality Pre-K–12 charter schools across Florida. We partner closely with school leaders and governing boards to build strong academic, operational, and cultural systems that help schools — and educators — thrive long term.

BridgePrep Academy, the largest network supported by SMART Management, serves students across 21 schools and is united by a bold mission: to provide a rigorous, student-centered academic experience enriched by an extended Spanish language program. At BridgePrep, educators are part of a collaborative, growth-oriented community where high expectations, strong support, and a deep belief in every child’s potential guide our work each day.

Position Overview

The Instructional Coach is a key instructional leader responsible for accelerating teacher effectiveness and student achievement through high-touch coaching, modeling, and data-driven support. Reporting directly to the Principal, you will work side-by-side with teachers to strengthen classroom execution, ensure rigorous curriculum implementation, and drive measurable academic gains.

This role focuses on developing educators through weekly coaching cycles, actionable real-time feedback, and targeted professional development to ensure every classroom delivers engaging, standards-aligned instruction.

Key Responsibilities

Instructional Leadership & Coaching

  • Lead weekly coaching cycles for assigned teachers, including observations, actionable feedback, demonstration lessons, and co-teaching.

  • Conduct frequent classroom walkthroughs to provide real-time feedback and ensure consistent implementation of instructional frameworks.

  • Assist teachers with lesson internalization and planning to ensure high cognitive demand and standards alignment.

Curriculum & Data-Driven Instruction

  • Support faithful execution of core curriculum, pacing guides, and assessments across all grade levels.

  • Facilitate weekly data meetings to analyze student performance, identify learning gaps, and create targeted re-teach plans.

  • Monitor progress toward schoolwide academic goals and adjust instructional strategies accordingly.

Staff Development & School Culture

  • Design and deliver high-impact professional development based on teacher observation data and student trends.

  • Model a growth-oriented, high-expectations mindset and foster trust across the instructional team.

  • Partner with the Principal to maintain strong teacher retention, accountability, and professionalism.

Year 1 Success Indicators

  • Instructional Quality: 80%+ of coached teachers meet or exceed instructional expectations on observations.

  • Student Growth: Demonstrated progress toward schoolwide academic achievement goals and 90% student persistence.

  • Team Retention: 85%+ teacher retention rate achieved in partnership with school leadership.

Core Values & Cultural Fit

  • And How Are the Children?: Every instructional decision prioritizes student impact and outcomes.

  • Big Rocks First: Focus relentlessly on the highest-leverage instructional and cultural priorities.

  • Own It: Take full ownership of teacher growth, student results, and follow-through.

  • Expect More: Hold an unwavering belief in high achievement for all students and staff.

  • Results Matter: Use data continuously to reflect, adapt, and drive improvement.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required (Master’s degree in Education/Leadership preferred).

  • Experience: 3+ years of successful K–12 teaching experience with a proven track record of strong student achievement gains.

  • Skills: Deep knowledge of Florida state standards, curriculum execution, coaching frameworks, and data analysis.

  • Clearance: Successful completion of a Level 2 background screening through the Florida Care Provider Background Screening Clearinghouse (HB 531).

  • References: Candidates must be able to arrange 3 professional reference checks, including at least one former direct supervisor.
